mf-skill-7ff7f2609bf44a11.Prerequisite Names: Probability rules; Integer powers; Sequences and finite sums; Probability Mass Functions of Discrete Random Variables; Sigma Notation
mf-skill-7ff7f2609bf44a11.Skill Description: Cumulative Distribution Functions for Discrete Random Variables — Build and use F(x) = P(X ≤ x), the running total of a discrete distribution's probabilities.

mf-skill-6b3ac53658ae53d6.Subject: Probability
mf-skill-6b3ac53658ae53d6.Skill Name: Expected Values of Discrete Random Variables
mf-skill-6b3ac53658ae53d6.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-PRS-003, MTH-NUF-013, MTH-CAL-001, MTH-STA-001, MTH-PRO-008, MTH-SEQ-004

mf-skill-6b3ac53658ae53d6.Skill Description: Expected Values of Discrete Random Variables — Compute the long-run average E(X) of a discrete random variable by weighting each value by its probability.

mf-skill-044e682a5af6f573.Subject: Quadratics
mf-skill-044e682a5af6f573.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Solving quadratic equations; Squaring Rational Numbers; Graphs of Functions
mf-skill-044e682a5af6f573.Skill Description: Graphing Elementary Quadratic Functions — Sketch basic parabolas such as y = x², y = ax² and y = x² + k from a table of values and their key features.

mf-skill-b67ed42dccf584c2.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-b67ed42dccf584c2.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Integer powers; Recursive Sequences
mf-skill-b67ed42dccf584c2.Skill Description: Fibonacci Sequences — Generate and analyse the Fibonacci sequence, where each term is the sum of the two terms before it.

mf-skill-5a7e0b4ab0615599.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-5a7e0b4ab0615599.Skill Name: Finding the Common Difference of an Arithmetic Sequence
mf-skill-5a7e0b4ab0615599.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Sequences and finite sums; Arithmetic Sequences
mf-skill-5a7e0b4ab0615599.Skill Description: Finding the Common Difference of an Arithmetic Sequence — Calculate the common difference of an arithmetic sequence by subtracting consecutive terms or reading it from a formula.

mf-skill-7249a37dee5a15d4.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-7249a37dee5a15d4.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; Sequences and finite sums; Introduction to Sequences; Arithmetic Sequences
mf-skill-7249a37dee5a15d4.Skill Description: Introduction to Geometric Sequences — Identify geometric sequences, in which each term is multiplied by the same nonzero common ratio to get the next.

mf-skill-cddf4aee7b7c2515.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-cddf4aee7b7c2515.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Integer powers; Sigma Notation
mf-skill-cddf4aee7b7c2515.Skill Description: Properties of Finite Series — Use rules for splitting, scaling and evaluating finite sums written in sigma notation, including standard sum formulas.

mf-skill-28495dd44682c0c8.Subject: Statistics
mf-skill-28495dd44682c0c8.Prerequisite Names: Mean, median, and mode; Slope and intercept; Sample variance and standard deviation; Scatter Plots
mf-skill-28495dd44682c0c8.Skill Description: Linear Correlation — Describe whether paired data follow a straight-line pattern by its direction and strength, without confusing correlation with causation.

mf-skill-51edbba77246c347.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-51edbba77246c347.Skill Name: Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-51edbba77246c347.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Radians and arc length; Right-triangle trigonometry; Calculating Reference Angles; Properties of the Unit Circle in the First Quadrant
mf-skill-51edbba77246c347.Skill Description: Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using the Unit Circle — Define sine, cosine and tangent for any angle using the coordinates of a point on the unit circle.

mf-skill-8d7f2cf242e41458.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-8d7f2cf242e41458.Skill Name: Using the Pythagorean Identity in the First Quadrant
mf-skill-8d7f2cf242e41458.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Radians and arc length; Right-triangle trigonometry; Calculating Trigonometric Ratios Using the Pythagorean Theorem; Properties of the Unit Circle in the First Quadrant
mf-skill-8d7f2cf242e41458.Skill Description: Using the Pythagorean Identity in the First Quadrant — Use sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 to find cosine from sine, or sine from cosine, for an acute angle.

mf-skill-d57e67827a36fbce.Subject: Absolute Value
mf-skill-d57e67827a36fbce.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-NUF-004, MTH-ALF-006, MTH-ALF-010, MTH-NUS-009, MTH-ABV-002, MTH-EQI-025
mf-skill-d57e67827a36fbce.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Linear inequalities and intervals; Absolute Value; Rules of Absolute Value; Solving Two-Step Equations
mf-skill-d57e67827a36fbce.Skill Description: Absolute Value Equations — Solve equations such as |x − 3| = 5 by splitting them into a positive case and a negative case.

mf-skill-fac4869b3719cf09.Subject: Complex Numbers
mf-skill-fac4869b3719cf09.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; Polar form and Euler's formula; The Polar Form of a Complex Number; Exponential Functions
mf-skill-fac4869b3719cf09.Skill Description: Euler's Formula — Use e^(iθ) = cos θ + i sin θ to write complex numbers in exponential form and simplify products and powers.

mf-skill-d9e2a5c21a7b81c5.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-d9e2a5c21a7b81c5.Skill Name: Approximating Areas With the Right Riemann Sum
mf-skill-d9e2a5c21a7b81c5.Prerequisite Names: Perimeter and planar area; Functions, domains, and ranges; Sequences and finite sums; Approximating Areas With the Left Riemann Sum
mf-skill-d9e2a5c21a7b81c5.Skill Description: Approximating Areas With the Right Riemann Sum — Estimate the area under a curve by adding rectangles whose heights come from the right endpoint of each subinterval.

mf-skill-b56611976c7e9a36.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-b56611976c7e9a36.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; The Intersection of Sets; Interval Notation; Unbounded Intervals
mf-skill-b56611976c7e9a36.Skill Description: Intersections of Intervals — Find the intersection of two intervals: the numbers belonging to both, corresponding to conditions joined by 'and'.

mf-skill-4907a4cb18e837a8.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-4907a4cb18e837a8.Prerequisite Names: Variables and expressions; Adding unlike fractions; Adding Fractions With Unlike Denominators; Simplifying Linear Expressions Using the Distributive Law
mf-skill-4907a4cb18e837a8.Skill Description: Simplifying Linear Expressions Containing Fractions — Simplify linear expressions whose coefficients or terms are fractions by distributing and combining over common denominators.

mf-skill-49ca49963f2897cb.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-49ca49963f2897cb.Skill Name: Simplifying Linear Expressions When a Group of Terms Is Subtracted
mf-skill-49ca49963f2897cb.Prerequisite Names: Variables and expressions; Adding unlike fractions; Distributing the Negative Sign in a Linear Expression; Simplifying Linear Expressions Using the Distributive Law
mf-skill-49ca49963f2897cb.Skill Description: Simplifying Linear Expressions When a Group of Terms Is Subtracted — Simplify an expression in which a bracketed group is subtracted, by removing the brackets and then collecting like terms.

mf-skill-3a7ee089e871e70d.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-3a7ee089e871e70d.Skill Name: Solving Equations Using the Square Root Method
mf-skill-3a7ee089e871e70d.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Roots and radicals; The Square Root of a Perfect Square; Solving Two-Step Equations
mf-skill-3a7ee089e871e70d.Skill Description: Solving Equations Using the Square Root Method — Solve equations of the form x² = k, or (x − h)² = k, by isolating the square and taking both square roots.

mf-skill-dd13f93280b65441.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-dd13f93280b65441.Skill Name: Solving Linear Equations With Decimal Coefficients
mf-skill-dd13f93280b65441.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Dividing With Negative Decimals and Fractions; Solving Two-Step Equations
mf-skill-dd13f93280b65441.Skill Description: Solving Linear Equations With Decimal Coefficients — Solve linear equations with decimal coefficients, often by multiplying through by a power of 10 to clear the decimals.

mf-skill-856bbaac6cd226f8.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-856bbaac6cd226f8.Skill Name: Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides
mf-skill-856bbaac6cd226f8.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Simplifying Linear Expressions Using the Distributive Law; Solving Two-Step Equations
mf-skill-856bbaac6cd226f8.Skill Description: Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides — Solve linear equations with the unknown on both sides by collecting variable terms on one side, and recognize identities and contradictions.

mf-skill-3f0733644b5442e7.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-3f0733644b5442e7.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Solving One-Step Linear Inequalities; Solving Two-Step Equations
mf-skill-3f0733644b5442e7.Skill Description: Solving Two-Step Inequalities — Solve inequalities such as −2x + 3 < 11 in two steps, reversing the inequality sign whenever you multiply or divide by a negative number.

mf-skill-687df10fdbf60dcf.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-687df10fdbf60dcf.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; The Union of Sets; Linear equations in one unknown; Interval Notation; Unbounded Intervals
mf-skill-687df10fdbf60dcf.Skill Description: Unions of Intervals — Combine intervals using union to describe numbers in at least one of them, matching conditions joined by 'or'.

mf-skill-f2e29f252d8ed2c9.Subject: Exponential Functions
mf-skill-f2e29f252d8ed2c9.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Exponential Functions
mf-skill-f2e29f252d8ed2c9.Skill Description: Graphing Exponential Growth Functions — Sketch graphs of growth functions y = a·bˣ with b > 1 by plotting key points and drawing the horizontal asymptote.

mf-skill-611f670a1fa27d5b.Subject: Exponential Functions
mf-skill-611f670a1fa27d5b.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Exponential Functions
mf-skill-611f670a1fa27d5b.Skill Description: Modeling Exponential Growth With Functions — Build a growth function such as f(x) = a·bˣ or a compound-interest formula from a verbal description or from two data points.

mf-skill-1eac32291e8e56d2.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-1eac32291e8e56d2.Skill Name: Converting From Exponential to Logarithmic Form
mf-skill-1eac32291e8e56d2.Prerequisite Names: Inverse functions; Exponential models; Exponential Functions
mf-skill-1eac32291e8e56d2.Skill Description: Converting From Exponential to Logarithmic Form — Rewriting an exponential statement such as b^y = x as the equivalent logarithm log_b(x) = y.

mf-skill-b4781e45308e5994.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-b4781e45308e5994.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Variables and expressions; Graphs of Functions; Unbounded Intervals
mf-skill-b4781e45308e5994.Skill Description: End Behavior of Functions — Describe what a function's outputs do as the input grows very large in the positive or negative direction.

mf-skill-c10288830d3bdfcf.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-c10288830d3bdfcf.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; Vertical Translations of Functions
mf-skill-c10288830d3bdfcf.Skill Description: Horizontal Translations of Functions — Shift a graph left or right by replacing x with x − h, which moves every point h units horizontally.

mf-skill-25980b9e0faa7a65.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-25980b9e0faa7a65.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Variables and expressions; The Domain of a Function
mf-skill-25980b9e0faa7a65.Skill Description: The Range of a Function — Find the set of all output values a function can produce, using its formula or its graph.

mf-skill-7cfb18c952d97d6b.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-7cfb18c952d97d6b.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Variables and expressions; Graphs of Functions; Solving Two-Step Equations
mf-skill-7cfb18c952d97d6b.Skill Description: The Roots of a Function — Find the inputs that make a function equal zero, which are the x-intercepts of its graph.

mf-skill-35d3a4912ac1cbaa.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-35d3a4912ac1cbaa.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; Vertical Translations of Functions
mf-skill-35d3a4912ac1cbaa.Skill Description: Vertical Stretches of Functions — Stretch or compress a graph vertically by multiplying the function's output by a constant factor.

mf-skill-df2d9c32930256ae.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-df2d9c32930256ae.Skill Name: The Average Rate of Change of a Function over a Varying Interval
mf-skill-df2d9c32930256ae.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Limits of functions; The Average Rate of Change of a Function
mf-skill-df2d9c32930256ae.Skill Description: The Average Rate of Change of a Function over a Varying Interval — Express the average rate of change over [a, a + h] as an algebraic formula in h and simplify it.

mf-skill-54908be4b7dc7802.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-54908be4b7dc7802.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Vector components and arithmetic; Matrix arithmetic; Linear Combinations of Vectors and Their Properties; Multiplying a Matrix by a Column Vector
mf-skill-54908be4b7dc7802.Skill Description: Introduction to Linear Transformations — Decide whether a transformation of the plane is linear and write a linear transformation as a 2×2 matrix.

mf-skill-2621a8cc4f4f0d19.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-2621a8cc4f4f0d19.Prerequisite Names: Multiplication and division; Matrix arithmetic; Multiplying a Matrix by a Column Vector
mf-skill-2621a8cc4f4f0d19.Skill Description: Multiplying Square Matrices — Multiply two n×n matrices, noting that both orders are defined but AB and BA usually differ.

mf-skill-94ecf2aadf8febd8.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-94ecf2aadf8febd8.Prerequisite Names: Matrix arithmetic; Polynomial arithmetic; Zero, Square, Diagonal and Identity Matrices
mf-skill-94ecf2aadf8febd8.Skill Description: The Determinant of a 2x2 Matrix — Compute ad − bc for a 2×2 matrix and use it to decide whether the matrix is invertible.

mf-skill-2e5bd94ee2957df5.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-2e5bd94ee2957df5.Skill Name: Limits of Power Functions, and the Constant Rule for Limits
mf-skill-2e5bd94ee2957df5.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; The Finite Limit of a Function
mf-skill-2e5bd94ee2957df5.Skill Description: Limits of Power Functions, and the Constant Rule for Limits — Use the basic results lim x→a c = c and lim x→a xⁿ = aⁿ as building blocks for evaluating limits.

mf-skill-86ce2c9c435b6b96.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-86ce2c9c435b6b96.Skill Name: The Left and Right-Sided Limits of a Function
mf-skill-86ce2c9c435b6b96.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; The Finite Limit of a Function
mf-skill-86ce2c9c435b6b96.Skill Description: The Left and Right-Sided Limits of a Function — Find the one-sided limits lim x→a⁻ f(x) and lim x→a⁺ f(x) by approaching a point only from the left or only from the right.

mf-skill-a52e7f1ba31bdbe4.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-a52e7f1ba31bdbe4.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Exponent rules; Combining the Rules of Exponents; Simplifying Linear Expressions Using the Distributive Law
mf-skill-a52e7f1ba31bdbe4.Skill Description: Introduction to Polynomials — Recognise polynomials and name their parts: terms, coefficients, constants, and the leading term.

mf-skill-5de67a7a5d99d7ef.Subject: Probability
mf-skill-5de67a7a5d99d7ef.Prerequisite Names: Probability rules; Integer powers; Sequences and finite sums; The Binomial Distribution; Expected Values of Discrete Random Variables
mf-skill-5de67a7a5d99d7ef.Skill Description: Modeling With the Binomial Distribution — Decide when a real situation fits the binomial conditions, then use B(n, p) to answer questions about it.

mf-skill-54099d048cfe9f80.Subject: Probability
mf-skill-54099d048cfe9f80.Prerequisite Names: Roots and radicals; Expectation and variance; Continuous probability densities; The Z-Score; Cumulative Distribution Functions for Discrete Random Variables
mf-skill-54099d048cfe9f80.Skill Description: The Standard Normal Distribution — Work with Z ~ N(0, 1), the reference normal distribution, and its cumulative probabilities Φ(z).

mf-skill-3c4b3e3c36dbd4ae.Subject: Quadratics
mf-skill-3c4b3e3c36dbd4ae.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Solving quadratic equations; Graphing Elementary Quadratic Functions
mf-skill-3c4b3e3c36dbd4ae.Skill Description: Vertical Reflections of Quadratic Functions — Reflect a parabola across the x-axis by negating the function, turning y = x² into the downward-opening y = −x².

mf-skill-17c15aa834d8333b.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions
mf-skill-17c15aa834d8333b.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Roots and radicals; Graphs of Functions; The Domain of a Function
mf-skill-17c15aa834d8333b.Skill Description: Graphing the Square Root Function — Sketch y = √x from key points, recognizing its starting point, domain x ≥ 0, and range y ≥ 0.

mf-skill-1941c4e04701b125.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-1941c4e04701b125.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Sequences and finite sums; Recursive Sequences; Finding the Common Difference of an Arithmetic Sequence
mf-skill-1941c4e04701b125.Skill Description: Recursive Formulas for Arithmetic Sequences — Write and use a recursive rule for an arithmetic sequence: a first term plus a rule adding the common difference.

mf-skill-43067a687516517c.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-43067a687516517c.Skill Name: The Nth Term of a Geometric Sequence
mf-skill-43067a687516517c.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; Sequences and finite sums; The Power Rule for Exponents With Algebraic Expressions; Introduction to Geometric Sequences
mf-skill-43067a687516517c.Skill Description: The Nth Term of a Geometric Sequence — Use the explicit formula an = a1·r^(n−1) to find any term of a geometric sequence directly.

mf-skill-a4efa9e43d49467e.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-a4efa9e43d49467e.Skill Name: The Nth Term of an Arithmetic Sequence
mf-skill-a4efa9e43d49467e.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Sequences and finite sums; Arithmetic Sequences; Finding the Common Difference of an Arithmetic Sequence
mf-skill-a4efa9e43d49467e.Skill Description: The Nth Term of an Arithmetic Sequence — Write and use an = a1 + (n − 1)d to find any term of an arithmetic sequence without listing the earlier terms.

mf-skill-60a874409d6f9254.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-60a874409d6f9254.Skill Name: The Recursive Formula for a Geometric Sequence
mf-skill-60a874409d6f9254.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; Sequences and finite sums; Recursive Sequences; Introduction to Geometric Sequences
mf-skill-60a874409d6f9254.Skill Description: The Recursive Formula for a Geometric Sequence — Describe a geometric sequence recursively with a first term and the rule that each term is r times the previous one.

mf-skill-ebdb30e192a65aab.Subject: Statistics
mf-skill-ebdb30e192a65aab.Prerequisite Names: Mean, median, and mode; Slope and intercept; Sample variance and standard deviation; Covariance; Linear Correlation
mf-skill-ebdb30e192a65aab.Skill Description: The Linear Correlation Coefficient — Calculate and interpret Pearson's r, a number from −1 to 1 measuring the direction and strength of a linear relationship.

mf-skill-4ac01653bfb76e80.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-4ac01653bfb76e80.Skill Name: Extending the Pythagorean Identity to All Quadrants
mf-skill-4ac01653bfb76e80.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Radians and arc length; Right-triangle trigonometry; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using the Unit Circle; Using the Pythagorean Identity in the First Quadrant
mf-skill-4ac01653bfb76e80.Skill Description: Extending the Pythagorean Identity to All Quadrants — Apply sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 to angles in any quadrant, choosing the sign of the square root from the quadrant.

mf-skill-c494218b1ea742f7.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-c494218b1ea742f7.Skill Name: Extending the Trigonometric Ratios to Large Angles
mf-skill-c494218b1ea742f7.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Radians and arc length; Right-triangle trigonometry; Coterminal Angles; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-c494218b1ea742f7.Skill Description: Extending the Trigonometric Ratios to Large Angles — Evaluate trigonometric functions of angles bigger than 360° by removing full turns, then using reference angles and quadrant signs.

mf-skill-40cf6d9ac846d8ec.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-40cf6d9ac846d8ec.Skill Name: Extending the Trigonometric Ratios to Negative Angles
mf-skill-40cf6d9ac846d8ec.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Radians and arc length; Right-triangle trigonometry; Negative Angles in the Coordinate Plane; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-40cf6d9ac846d8ec.Skill Description: Extending the Trigonometric Ratios to Negative Angles — Evaluate trig functions of negative angles using the symmetry rules sin(−θ) = −sin θ and cos(−θ) = cos θ.

mf-skill-25dcb6aa5cb4b55e.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-25dcb6aa5cb4b55e.Skill Name: Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using Angles in Radians
mf-skill-25dcb6aa5cb4b55e.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Radians and arc length; Right-triangle trigonometry; Trigonometric Ratios With Radians; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-25dcb6aa5cb4b55e.Skill Description: Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using Angles in Radians — Evaluate trigonometric functions of radian angles in any quadrant, such as 7π/6 or 5π/3, using reference angles.

mf-skill-b22629dd8fab7684.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-b22629dd8fab7684.Skill Name: Finding Trigonometric Ratios of Quadrantal Angles
mf-skill-b22629dd8fab7684.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle distances; Unit-circle trigonometry; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-b22629dd8fab7684.Skill Description: Finding Trigonometric Ratios of Quadrantal Angles — Find sine, cosine and tangent of angles on the axes, such as 0°, 90°, 180° and 270°, from unit-circle coordinates.

mf-skill-27efc140811be662.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-27efc140811be662.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle trigonometry; Solving quadratic equations; Calculating Angles in Right Triangles Using Trigonometry; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-27efc140811be662.Skill Description: The Law of Sines — Use a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C to find missing sides or angles when a side and its opposite angle are known.

mf-skill-593106c39b07c066.Subject: Vectors
mf-skill-593106c39b07c066.Skill Name: Calculating the Dot Product Using Angle and Magnitude
mf-skill-593106c39b07c066.Prerequisite Names: Vector components and arithmetic; Right-triangle trigonometry; Calculating the Magnitude of Cartesian Vectors in 2D; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-593106c39b07c066.Skill Description: Calculating the Dot Product Using Angle and Magnitude — Find a · b as |a||b| cos θ when the lengths of two vectors and the angle between them are known.

mf-skill-f1f4eb8d68f9e5da.Subject: Absolute Value
mf-skill-f1f4eb8d68f9e5da.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-NUF-004, MTH-ALF-006, MTH-ALF-010, MTH-NUS-009, MTH-EQI-032, MTH-ABV-005
mf-skill-f1f4eb8d68f9e5da.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Linear inequalities and intervals; Absolute Value; Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides; Absolute Value Equations
mf-skill-f1f4eb8d68f9e5da.Skill Description: Further Absolute Value Equations — Solve harder absolute value equations, including ones with variables outside the bars or absolute values on both sides.

mf-skill-d23bd106b769fddd.Subject: Absolute Value
mf-skill-d23bd106b769fddd.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Linear inequalities and intervals; Absolute Value Graphs; Vertical Stretches of Functions
mf-skill-d23bd106b769fddd.Skill Description: Stretches of Absolute Value Graphs — See how y = a|x| becomes narrower or wider than y = |x| as the positive factor a changes.

mf-skill-20604a5c05b6ff19.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-20604a5c05b6ff19.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Equations of Circles Centered at the Origin; Horizontal Translations of Functions
mf-skill-20604a5c05b6ff19.Skill Description: Equations of Circles — Write and interpret the standard equation (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r² for a circle with any center.

mf-skill-2b95a7f094b8ddcd.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-2b95a7f094b8ddcd.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Equations of Circles Centered at the Origin; Vertical Stretches of Functions
mf-skill-2b95a7f094b8ddcd.Skill Description: Introduction to Ellipses — Understand an ellipse as the points whose distances to two foci sum to a constant, and name its axes, vertices and foci.

mf-skill-3eef8e1b4c9ebb0f.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-3eef8e1b4c9ebb0f.Skill Name: Approximating Areas With the Trapezoidal Rule

mf-skill-adab4374cb1d8762.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-adab4374cb1d8762.Skill Name: Left and Right Riemann Sums in Sigma Notation
mf-skill-adab4374cb1d8762.Prerequisite Names: Perimeter and planar area; Functions, domains, and ranges; Sequences and finite sums; Sigma Notation; Approximating Areas With the Right Riemann Sum
mf-skill-adab4374cb1d8762.Skill Description: Left and Right Riemann Sums in Sigma Notation — Write left and right Riemann sums compactly with sigma notation using a general subinterval width and sample points.

mf-skill-d15cb15d360e572d.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-d15cb15d360e572d.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Solving Two-Step Inequalities; Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides
mf-skill-d15cb15d360e572d.Skill Description: Further Solving Linear Inequalities — Solve multi-step linear inequalities, including those with brackets, variables on both sides, and negative coefficients.

mf-skill-34b37e57be5ccf6a.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-34b37e57be5ccf6a.Skill Name: Linear Equations With Infinitely Many Solutions
mf-skill-34b37e57be5ccf6a.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides
mf-skill-34b37e57be5ccf6a.Skill Description: Linear Equations With Infinitely Many Solutions — Recognise a linear equation that is an identity, true for every value of the variable, when simplification yields a true statement.

mf-skill-3549d48174f26c3b.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-3549d48174f26c3b.Prerequisite Names: Variables and expressions; Linear equations in one unknown; Interpreting Linear Expressions; Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides
mf-skill-3549d48174f26c3b.Skill Description: Modeling With Linear Equations — Set up and solve a linear equation that describes a word problem, then interpret and check the answer in context.

mf-skill-3fad086925f21c48.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-3fad086925f21c48.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Compound Inequalities; Solving Two-Step Inequalities
mf-skill-3fad086925f21c48.Skill Description: Solving Compound Inequalities — Carry out the algebra to solve AND and OR compound inequalities, then state the solution as an interval or union.

mf-skill-6f3750482821bc67.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-6f3750482821bc67.Skill Name: Solving Equations With Odd Exponents Using the Nth Root Method
mf-skill-6f3750482821bc67.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Roots and radicals; The Cube Root of a Perfect Cube; Solving Equations Using the Square Root Method
mf-skill-6f3750482821bc67.Skill Description: Solving Equations With Odd Exponents Using the Nth Root Method — Solve equations like xⁿ = k with n odd by taking the nth root, which gives exactly one real solution.

mf-skill-a64208d72a819f06.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-a64208d72a819f06.Skill Name: Solving Linear Equations With Fractional Coefficients
mf-skill-a64208d72a819f06.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Solving Two-Step Equations; Simplifying Linear Expressions Containing Fractions
mf-skill-a64208d72a819f06.Skill Description: Solving Linear Equations With Fractional Coefficients — Solve linear equations whose coefficients or constants are fractions, usually by first clearing denominators with the least common denominator.

mf-skill-31c82c3fe3e3a747.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-31c82c3fe3e3a747.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides
mf-skill-31c82c3fe3e3a747.Skill Description: Solving Two-Variable Equations — Work with equations in two variables, such as 2x + 3y = 12, by finding solution pairs or isolating one variable in terms of the other.

mf-skill-16e67f58d4a8f8ac.Subject: Exponential Functions
mf-skill-16e67f58d4a8f8ac.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Creating Exponential Decay Expressions; Graphing Exponential Growth Functions
mf-skill-16e67f58d4a8f8ac.Skill Description: Graphing Exponential Decay Functions — Sketch graphs of decay functions y = a·bˣ with 0 < b < 1, showing their falling shape and horizontal asymptote.

mf-skill-87587927117a371a.Subject: Exponential Functions
mf-skill-87587927117a371a.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Modeling Exponential Growth With Functions
mf-skill-87587927117a371a.Skill Description: Interpreting Exponential Growth — Explain what the initial value, growth factor and growth rate of an exponential growth model mean in a real situation.

mf-skill-4efe913edec8e4b9.Subject: Exponential Functions
mf-skill-4efe913edec8e4b9.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Creating Exponential Decay Expressions; Modeling Exponential Growth With Functions
mf-skill-4efe913edec8e4b9.Skill Description: Modeling Exponential Decay With Functions — Build a decay function f(t) = a·bᵗ from a description or data points, choosing the variables, units and a sensible domain.

mf-skill-c438bba8766d8778.Subject: Exponential Functions
mf-skill-c438bba8766d8778.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Exponent rules; Combining the Rules of Exponents With Algebraic Expressions; Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides
mf-skill-c438bba8766d8778.Skill Description: Solving Exponential Equations — Solve equations with the unknown in an exponent by writing both sides as powers of the same base and equating the exponents.

mf-skill-d819e8b24fd4c19d.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-d819e8b24fd4c19d.Skill Name: Converting From Logarithmic to Exponential Form
mf-skill-d819e8b24fd4c19d.Prerequisite Names: Inverse functions; Exponential models; Converting From Exponential to Logarithmic Form
mf-skill-d819e8b24fd4c19d.Skill Description: Converting From Logarithmic to Exponential Form — Rewriting a logarithmic statement log_b(x) = y as b^y = x, often to evaluate a log or solve for an unknown.

mf-skill-ef4027fde612a081.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-ef4027fde612a081.Skill Name: Vertical Translations of Exponential Growth Functions
mf-skill-ef4027fde612a081.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Vertical Translations of Functions; Graphing Exponential Growth Functions
mf-skill-ef4027fde612a081.Skill Description: Vertical Translations of Exponential Growth Functions — Shifting an exponential growth graph up or down by adding a constant, which moves its horizontal asymptote and range.

mf-skill-2c39fadcb621d28d.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-2c39fadcb621d28d.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Variables and expressions; The Range of a Function
mf-skill-2c39fadcb621d28d.Skill Description: Global Extrema of Functions — Find the absolute highest and lowest output values a function reaches across its entire domain.

mf-skill-2443662fc0088608.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-2443662fc0088608.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; Vertical Stretches of Functions; Horizontal Translations of Functions
mf-skill-2443662fc0088608.Skill Description: Horizontal Stretches of Functions — Stretch or compress a graph horizontally by replacing x with bx, where the effect is a scale by 1/b.

mf-skill-fef733f1684b0632.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-fef733f1684b0632.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Graphs of Functions; The Range of a Function
mf-skill-fef733f1684b0632.Skill Description: One-To-One Functions — Recognize one-to-one functions, where each output comes from exactly one input, using algebra or the horizontal line test.

mf-skill-187cea111ef6a836.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-187cea111ef6a836.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Graphs of Functions; Horizontal Translations of Functions
mf-skill-187cea111ef6a836.Skill Description: Periodic Functions — Recognize functions whose values repeat at regular intervals and find the length of one repeating cycle, the period.

mf-skill-890e884506f88b79.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-890e884506f88b79.Skill Name: Unbounded Behavior of Functions Near a Point
mf-skill-890e884506f88b79.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; The Domain of a Function; End Behavior of Functions
mf-skill-890e884506f88b79.Skill Description: Unbounded Behavior of Functions Near a Point — Describe how a function's values grow without bound as the input approaches a point, producing a vertical asymptote.

mf-skill-c6fd3718850fcfa9.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-c6fd3718850fcfa9.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; Vertical Stretches of Functions
mf-skill-c6fd3718850fcfa9.Skill Description: Vertical Reflections of Functions — Reflect a graph across the x-axis by multiplying the function's output by −1.

mf-skill-c3e746546f910616.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-c3e746546f910616.Prerequisite Names: Multiplication and division; Matrix arithmetic; Multiplying Square Matrices
mf-skill-c3e746546f910616.Skill Description: Conformability for Matrix Multiplication — Check whether two matrices can be multiplied by comparing inner dimensions, and predict the size of the product.

mf-skill-270b08fa8d68d893.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-270b08fa8d68d893.Prerequisite Names: Multiplication and division; Matrix arithmetic; Multiplying Square Matrices
mf-skill-270b08fa8d68d893.Skill Description: Powers of Matrices — Compute A², A³ and higher powers of a square matrix by repeated matrix multiplication.

mf-skill-b321001e1f5709b8.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-b321001e1f5709b8.Skill Name: The Geometric Interpretation of the 2x2 Determinant
mf-skill-b321001e1f5709b8.Prerequisite Names: Matrix arithmetic; Polynomial arithmetic; Addition and Scalar Multiplication of Cartesian Vectors in 2D; The Determinant of a 2x2 Matrix
mf-skill-b321001e1f5709b8.Skill Description: The Geometric Interpretation of the 2x2 Determinant — Interpret the 2×2 determinant as the signed factor by which a linear transformation scales areas.

mf-skill-70d8702af009e63a.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-70d8702af009e63a.Prerequisite Names: Matrix arithmetic; Polynomial arithmetic; The Determinant of a 2x2 Matrix
mf-skill-70d8702af009e63a.Skill Description: The Minors of a 3x3 Matrix — Find the minor of each entry in a 3×3 matrix by deleting its row and column and taking the remaining 2×2 determinant.

mf-skill-601eda55091250c2.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-601eda55091250c2.Skill Name: The Standard Matrix of a Linear Transformation
mf-skill-601eda55091250c2.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Vector components and arithmetic; Matrix arithmetic; Introduction to Linear Transformations
mf-skill-601eda55091250c2.Skill Description: The Standard Matrix of a Linear Transformation — Build the matrix of a linear transformation by using the images of the standard basis vectors as its columns.

mf-skill-98b7ca3df53cade9.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-98b7ca3df53cade9.Skill Name: Finding the Existence of a Limit Using One-Sided Limits
mf-skill-98b7ca3df53cade9.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; The Left and Right-Sided Limits of a Function
mf-skill-98b7ca3df53cade9.Skill Description: Finding the Existence of a Limit Using One-Sided Limits — Decide whether a two-sided limit exists by checking that the left-hand and right-hand limits both exist and are equal.

mf-skill-1e695a3f9a9bb3c5.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-1e695a3f9a9bb3c5.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; The Finite Limit of a Function; End Behavior of Functions
mf-skill-1e695a3f9a9bb3c5.Skill Description: Limits at Infinity from Graphs — Use a graph's far-left and far-right behaviour to find limits as x → ∞ or x → −∞ and identify horizontal asymptotes.

mf-skill-10679e8fb9ea75e3.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-10679e8fb9ea75e3.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; Limits of Power Functions, and the Constant Rule for Limits
mf-skill-10679e8fb9ea75e3.Skill Description: The Sum Rule for Limits — Find the limit of a sum or difference by adding or subtracting the individual limits, when each one exists.

mf-skill-d7f265b14492751c.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-d7f265b14492751c.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Exponent rules; Collecting Like Terms in Linear Expressions; Introduction to Polynomials
mf-skill-d7f265b14492751c.Skill Description: Simplifying Polynomials — Simplify a polynomial by combining like terms and writing the result in standard descending order.

mf-skill-5588406fc1ac2000.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-5588406fc1ac2000.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Exponent rules; Introduction to Polynomials
mf-skill-5588406fc1ac2000.Skill Description: The Degree of a Polynomial — Find the degree of a term or polynomial from its highest power, and use degree to name polynomials.

mf-skill-d1e970831ba51ed6.Subject: Parametric & Polar Coordinates
mf-skill-d1e970831ba51ed6.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Radians and arc length; Right-triangle trigonometry; Coterminal Angles; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using Angles in Radians
mf-skill-d1e970831ba51ed6.Skill Description: Introduction to Polar Coordinates — Describe points by a distance r from the origin and an angle θ from the positive x-axis, and relate them to Cartesian coordinates.

mf-skill-b1f01dd219c17853.Subject: Probability
mf-skill-b1f01dd219c17853.Skill Name: Symmetry Properties of the Standard Normal Distribution
mf-skill-b1f01dd219c17853.Prerequisite Names: Roots and radicals; Expectation and variance; Continuous probability densities; Applying the Addition Law With Event Complements; The Standard Normal Distribution
mf-skill-b1f01dd219c17853.Skill Description: Symmetry Properties of the Standard Normal Distribution — Use the symmetry of the standard normal curve about 0 to find negative-z, upper-tail, and central-interval probabilities.

mf-skill-dd9e7cc25cafbef6.Subject: Probability
mf-skill-dd9e7cc25cafbef6.Prerequisite Names: Probability rules; Integer powers; Sequences and finite sums; The Binomial Distribution; The Nth Term of a Geometric Sequence
mf-skill-dd9e7cc25cafbef6.Skill Description: The Geometric Distribution — Use Geo(p), with P(X = r) = (1 − p)^(r − 1) p, to find the probability that the first success occurs on trial r.

mf-skill-94f387ad54fbc7e4.Subject: Radical & Rational Expressions
mf-skill-94f387ad54fbc7e4.Prerequisite Names: Fraction products and quotients; Polynomial arithmetic; Equivalent Fractions With Negative Numbers; Simplifying Linear Expressions Containing Fractions
mf-skill-94f387ad54fbc7e4.Skill Description: Equivalent Expressions With Fractions — Rewrite a fraction or rational expression in an equivalent form by multiplying or dividing its numerator and denominator by the same nonzero factor.

mf-skill-00c5235deb9c4482.Subject: Radical & Rational Expressions
mf-skill-00c5235deb9c4482.Skill Name: Writing Radical Expressions Using Fractional Exponents
mf-skill-00c5235deb9c4482.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Roots and radicals; Radicals as Fractional Exponents; Introduction to Polynomials
mf-skill-00c5235deb9c4482.Skill Description: Writing Radical Expressions Using Fractional Exponents — Convert between radical notation and rational exponents using ⁿ√(x^m) = x^(m/n).

mf-skill-364369cd31c75695.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions
mf-skill-364369cd31c75695.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Roots and radicals; The Cube Root of a Perfect Cube With Algebraic Expressions; Graphing the Square Root Function
mf-skill-364369cd31c75695.Skill Description: Graphing the Cube Root Function — Sketch y = ∛x from key points, noting it is defined for all real numbers and symmetric about the origin.

mf-skill-c586687a8ac29236.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-c586687a8ac29236.Skill Name: Determining Indexes of Terms in Arithmetic Sequences
mf-skill-c586687a8ac29236.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Sequences and finite sums; The Nth Term of an Arithmetic Sequence
mf-skill-c586687a8ac29236.Skill Description: Determining Indexes of Terms in Arithmetic Sequences — Find the position of a given value in an arithmetic sequence, or show that the value is not a term.

mf-skill-c5bfc06715ae81f5.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-c5bfc06715ae81f5.Skill Name: Translating Between Explicit and Recursive Formulas for Arithmetic Sequences
mf-skill-c5bfc06715ae81f5.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Sequences and finite sums; Recursive Formulas for Arithmetic Sequences; The Nth Term of an Arithmetic Sequence
mf-skill-c5bfc06715ae81f5.Skill Description: Translating Between Explicit and Recursive Formulas for Arithmetic Sequences — Convert an arithmetic sequence's recursive rule into an explicit nth-term formula, and convert explicit formulas back.

mf-skill-ad96e106034dea6c.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-ad96e106034dea6c.Skill Name: Translating Between Explicit and Recursive Formulas for Geometric Sequences
mf-skill-ad96e106034dea6c.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; Sequences and finite sums; The Nth Term of a Geometric Sequence; The Recursive Formula for a Geometric Sequence
mf-skill-ad96e106034dea6c.Skill Description: Translating Between Explicit and Recursive Formulas for Geometric Sequences — Move between the recursive rule and the explicit formula of a geometric sequence by identifying its first term and ratio.

mf-skill-f41a1a1afba1e15b.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-f41a1a1afba1e15b.Skill Name: Expressing an Arithmetic Series in Sigma Notation
mf-skill-f41a1a1afba1e15b.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Sequences and finite sums; Sigma Notation; The Nth Term of an Arithmetic Sequence
mf-skill-f41a1a1afba1e15b.Skill Description: Expressing an Arithmetic Series in Sigma Notation — Rewrite an arithmetic series written out term by term as a compact sum using sigma notation and limits.

mf-skill-e4ef7963acff9a44.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-e4ef7963acff9a44.Skill Name: The Sum of a Finite Geometric Series
mf-skill-e4ef7963acff9a44.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Geometric series; Properties of Finite Series; The Nth Term of a Geometric Sequence
mf-skill-e4ef7963acff9a44.Skill Description: The Sum of a Finite Geometric Series — Derive and use the formula Sn = a(1 − r^n)/(1 − r) for adding the terms of a finite geometric series.

mf-skill-ee3158e12de79233.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-ee3158e12de79233.Skill Name: Writing Geometric Series in Sigma Notation
mf-skill-ee3158e12de79233.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Geometric series; Sigma Notation; The Nth Term of a Geometric Sequence
mf-skill-ee3158e12de79233.Skill Description: Writing Geometric Series in Sigma Notation — Express a geometric sum compactly in sigma notation by identifying its first term, common ratio, and number of terms.

mf-skill-91cdda3ab98a8e35.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-91cdda3ab98a8e35.Skill Name: Finding Trigonometric Ratios of Special Angles Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-91cdda3ab98a8e35.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle distances; Unit-circle trigonometry; Special Trigonometric Ratios; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios Using Angles in Radians
mf-skill-91cdda3ab98a8e35.Skill Description: Finding Trigonometric Ratios of Special Angles Using the Unit Circle — Read exact trig values for multiples of 30° and 45°, such as 150° or 225°, from symmetric points on the unit circle.

mf-skill-65e2637efa3f399d.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-65e2637efa3f399d.Skill Name: The Area of a General Triangle
mf-skill-65e2637efa3f399d.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle trigonometry; Solving quadratic equations; Calculating Areas of Right Triangles Using Trigonometry; The Law of Sines
mf-skill-65e2637efa3f399d.Skill Description: The Area of a General Triangle — Calculate the area of any triangle from two sides and their included angle using Area = ½ab sin C.

mf-skill-3b9071627ab22020.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-3b9071627ab22020.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle trigonometry; Solving quadratic equations; Calculating Trigonometric Ratios Using the Pythagorean Theorem; The Law of Sines
mf-skill-3b9071627ab22020.Skill Description: The Law of Cosines — Use c² = a² + b² − 2ab cos C to find a missing side or angle in any triangle from SAS or SSS information.

mf-skill-6e25f78fa8a48911.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-6e25f78fa8a48911.Skill Name: Trigonometric Ratios of Quadrantal Angles Outside the Standard Range
mf-skill-6e25f78fa8a48911.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle distances; Unit-circle trigonometry; Finding Trigonometric Ratios of Quadrantal Angles; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios to Large Angles
mf-skill-6e25f78fa8a48911.Skill Description: Trigonometric Ratios of Quadrantal Angles Outside the Standard Range — Find exact sine, cosine, and tangent values of quadrantal angles beyond 0° to 360°, such as 450° or −90°, using coterminal angles.

mf-skill-c27a0d1b612bec7c.Subject: Vectors
mf-skill-c27a0d1b612bec7c.Skill Name: Calculating the Dot Product Using Components
mf-skill-c27a0d1b612bec7c.Prerequisite Names: Vector components and arithmetic; Right-triangle trigonometry; Addition and Scalar Multiplication of Cartesian Vectors in 3D; Calculating the Dot Product Using Angle and Magnitude
mf-skill-c27a0d1b612bec7c.Skill Description: Calculating the Dot Product Using Components — Multiply matching components of two vectors and add the products to get their scalar dot product.

mf-skill-40ad33562e75a1bf.Subject: Vectors
mf-skill-40ad33562e75a1bf.Skill Name: The Cross Product of Two Vectors
mf-skill-40ad33562e75a1bf.Prerequisite Names: Vector components and arithmetic; Right-triangle trigonometry; Addition and Scalar Multiplication of Cartesian Vectors in 3D; Calculating the Dot Product Using Angle and Magnitude
mf-skill-40ad33562e75a1bf.Skill Description: The Cross Product of Two Vectors — Understand a × b as a vector perpendicular to both inputs, with length |a||b| sin θ and direction given by the right-hand rule.

mf-skill-995b0994814470bb.Subject: Absolute Value
mf-skill-995b0994814470bb.Skill Name: Vertical Reflections of Absolute Value Graphs
mf-skill-995b0994814470bb.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Linear inequalities and intervals; Absolute Value Graphs; Vertical Reflections of Functions
mf-skill-995b0994814470bb.Skill Description: Vertical Reflections of Absolute Value Graphs — Reflect absolute value graphs across the x-axis, turning y = |x| into the downward-opening V of y = −|x|.

mf-skill-7edc9f6d337297e4.Subject: Complex Numbers
mf-skill-7edc9f6d337297e4.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; Polar form and Euler's formula; The Polar Form of a Complex Number; The Roots of Unity; The Sum of a Finite Geometric Series
mf-skill-7edc9f6d337297e4.Skill Description: Properties of Roots of Unity — Use the structural facts about nth roots of unity: equal spacing on the unit circle, cyclic powers, closure, and a zero sum.

mf-skill-13bb5116f1271d68.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-13bb5116f1271d68.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Solving Equations Using the Square Root Method; Equations of Circles
mf-skill-13bb5116f1271d68.Skill Description: Calculating Circle Intercepts — Find where a circle crosses the x- and y-axes by setting one coordinate to zero and solving.

mf-skill-e4d0f0cd53d90970.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-e4d0f0cd53d90970.Skill Name: Equations of Ellipses Centered at the Origin
mf-skill-e4d0f0cd53d90970.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Introduction to Ellipses
mf-skill-e4d0f0cd53d90970.Skill Description: Equations of Ellipses Centered at the Origin — Read the axes, intercepts and foci of an ellipse from x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 when its center is the origin.

mf-skill-5f2980eec239207f.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-5f2980eec239207f.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Equations of Circles
mf-skill-5f2980eec239207f.Skill Description: Parametric Equations of Circles — Describe a circle with x = h + r cos t, y = k + r sin t and relate the parameter t to position and direction.

mf-skill-76ba4987185b3cf0.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-76ba4987185b3cf0.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Intersections of Intervals; Solving Compound Inequalities
mf-skill-76ba4987185b3cf0.Skill Description: Compound AND Inequalities — Solve and describe inequalities joined by AND, whose solution is the overlap of both conditions.

mf-skill-b937dd4fd37b6a42.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-b937dd4fd37b6a42.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Unions of Intervals; Solving Compound Inequalities
mf-skill-b937dd4fd37b6a42.Skill Description: Compound OR Inequalities — Solve and describe inequalities joined by OR, whose solution includes every value satisfying at least one condition.

mf-skill-f97cf62ae2d0ca73.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-f97cf62ae2d0ca73.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Linear Equations With Infinitely Many Solutions
mf-skill-f97cf62ae2d0ca73.Skill Description: Linear Equations With No Solutions — Recognise a linear equation with no solution, a contradiction, when simplification leaves a false statement.

mf-skill-5dc337f110d59412.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-5dc337f110d59412.Skill Name: Solving Equations With Even Exponents Using the Nth Root Method
mf-skill-5dc337f110d59412.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Roots and radicals; Radicals as Fractional Exponents; Solving Equations With Odd Exponents Using the Nth Root Method
mf-skill-5dc337f110d59412.Skill Description: Solving Equations With Even Exponents Using the Nth Root Method — Solve equations like xⁿ = k with n even by taking the nth root and including both positive and negative roots.

mf-skill-d3d76dd073aa845f.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-d3d76dd073aa845f.Skill Name: Solving Linear Equations by Clearing a Rational Expression
mf-skill-d3d76dd073aa845f.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Evaluating Rational Expressions; Solving Linear Equations With Fractional Coefficients
mf-skill-d3d76dd073aa845f.Skill Description: Solving Linear Equations by Clearing a Rational Expression — Solve a linear equation containing fractions by multiplying every term by the lowest common denominator.

mf-skill-6b8bdd20c465c350.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-6b8bdd20c465c350.Skill Name: Solving Linear Equations With Unknown Coefficients
mf-skill-6b8bdd20c465c350.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides; Solving Two-Variable Equations
mf-skill-6b8bdd20c465c350.Skill Description: Solving Linear Equations With Unknown Coefficients — Solve a linear equation for x when some coefficients are letters, giving the answer as an expression and noting when division by a letter is allowed.

mf-skill-6e995958a6a4c78a.Subject: Exponential Functions
mf-skill-6e995958a6a4c78a.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Modeling Exponential Decay With Functions; Interpreting Exponential Growth
mf-skill-6e995958a6a4c78a.Skill Description: Interpreting Exponential Decay — Read the initial value, decay factor and percentage decrease from an exponential decay model or table, and explain them in context.

mf-skill-750d4a0ad2ba9395.Subject: Exponential Functions
mf-skill-750d4a0ad2ba9395.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Interpreting Exponential Growth
mf-skill-750d4a0ad2ba9395.Skill Description: Solving Exponential Growth Problems — Apply an exponential growth model to predict a future value or find how long it takes to reach a target, such as a doubling time.

mf-skill-9f3d4f27809e4633.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-9f3d4f27809e4633.Prerequisite Names: Inverse functions; Exponential models; Radicals as Fractional Exponents; Converting From Logarithmic to Exponential Form
mf-skill-9f3d4f27809e4633.Skill Description: Evaluating Logarithms — Finding the value of a logarithm such as log_2(8) by asking what exponent on the base produces the argument.

mf-skill-c98c1de9c5afb256.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-c98c1de9c5afb256.Skill Name: Solving Exponential Equations With Different Bases
mf-skill-c98c1de9c5afb256.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Exponent rules; The Power Rule for Exponents With Algebraic Expressions; Solving Exponential Equations
mf-skill-c98c1de9c5afb256.Skill Description: Solving Exponential Equations With Different Bases — Solve exponential equations with bases like 4 and 8 by rewriting both as powers of a shared base, then equating exponents.

mf-skill-a458c41ee603304a.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-a458c41ee603304a.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Vertical Reflections of Functions; Vertical Translations of Exponential Growth Functions
mf-skill-a458c41ee603304a.Skill Description: Vertical Reflections of Exponential Functions — Reflect an exponential graph across the x-axis by negating the function, as in y = −bˣ, and describe the effect on range and direction.

mf-skill-d3d96250999d6f0d.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-d3d96250999d6f0d.Skill Name: Vertical Translations of Exponential Decay Functions
mf-skill-d3d96250999d6f0d.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Graphing Exponential Decay Functions; Vertical Translations of Exponential Growth Functions
mf-skill-d3d96250999d6f0d.Skill Description: Vertical Translations of Exponential Decay Functions — Shift a decay graph such as y = (1/2)ˣ up or down by adding a constant k, which moves its horizontal asymptote to y = k.

mf-skill-54eae40ca2ff9d88.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-54eae40ca2ff9d88.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; Horizontal Translations of Functions; Horizontal Stretches of Functions
mf-skill-54eae40ca2ff9d88.Skill Description: Combining Graph Transformations: Two Operations — Combine two graph transformations, such as a stretch and a shift, and see when their order changes the result.

mf-skill-db8dc6cb7e081ccf.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-db8dc6cb7e081ccf.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; Horizontal Stretches of Functions; Vertical Reflections of Functions
mf-skill-db8dc6cb7e081ccf.Skill Description: Horizontal Reflections of Functions — Reflect a graph across the y-axis by replacing x with −x in the function.

mf-skill-53a483fa032ba652.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-53a483fa032ba652.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Increasing and Decreasing Functions; Global Extrema of Functions
mf-skill-53a483fa032ba652.Skill Description: Local Extrema of Functions — Identify local maxima and minima, the points where a function is higher or lower than all nearby values.

mf-skill-af0e68c6ba8aa9a0.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-af0e68c6ba8aa9a0.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Factoring polynomials; Rational expressions and restrictions; Exponential and logarithmic equations; Further Solving Linear Inequalities
mf-skill-af0e68c6ba8aa9a0.Skill Description: Solving Inequalities Involving Exponential Functions — Solve inequalities involving expressions like a^x by matching bases or taking logarithms, reversing direction when the base is below one.

mf-skill-2801f9d732fd5216.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-2801f9d732fd5216.Prerequisite Names: Multiplication and division; Matrix arithmetic; Conformability for Matrix Multiplication
mf-skill-2801f9d732fd5216.Skill Description: Multiplying Matrices — Multiply two matrices by taking row-by-column dot products, after checking that the inner dimensions agree.

mf-skill-3419290c4144365b.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-3419290c4144365b.Prerequisite Names: Matrix arithmetic; Polynomial arithmetic; The Minors of a 3x3 Matrix
mf-skill-3419290c4144365b.Skill Description: The Determinant of a 3x3 Matrix — Evaluate a 3×3 determinant by cofactor expansion along a row or column, using the + − + sign pattern.

mf-skill-2941d9ed90b052e0.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-2941d9ed90b052e0.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Limits of functions; Finding the Existence of a Limit Using One-Sided Limits
mf-skill-2941d9ed90b052e0.Skill Description: Determining Continuity from Graphs — Identify from a graph where a function is continuous, spotting holes, jumps, and vertical asymptotes as discontinuities.

mf-skill-bbdfb0ceb1512625.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-bbdfb0ceb1512625.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; The Left and Right-Sided Limits of a Function; Unbounded Behavior of Functions Near a Point
mf-skill-bbdfb0ceb1512625.Skill Description: Infinite Limits from Graphs — Read from a graph when a function grows without bound near a point, and write limits such as lim x→a f(x) = ∞ or −∞.

mf-skill-55a4ff50c24ef6a4.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-55a4ff50c24ef6a4.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; The Sum Rule for Limits; Limits at Infinity from Graphs
mf-skill-55a4ff50c24ef6a4.Skill Description: Limits at Infinity of Polynomials — Find the end behaviour of a polynomial as x → ±∞ from the sign of its leading coefficient and its degree.

mf-skill-93d3ee139ffa72f2.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-93d3ee139ffa72f2.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; The Sum Rule for Limits; Finding the Existence of a Limit Using One-Sided Limits
mf-skill-93d3ee139ffa72f2.Skill Description: Limits of Piecewise Functions — Evaluate limits of piecewise-defined functions, using the correct formula on each side of a boundary and comparing one-sided limits.

mf-skill-9c361466bc9bbc03.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-9c361466bc9bbc03.Skill Name: The Product and Quotient Rules for Limits
mf-skill-9c361466bc9bbc03.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; The Sum Rule for Limits
mf-skill-9c361466bc9bbc03.Skill Description: The Product and Quotient Rules for Limits — Find the limit of a product or quotient from the limits of its parts, provided they exist and the denominator's limit is nonzero.

mf-skill-0be640789287adb6.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-0be640789287adb6.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Exponent rules; Simplifying Linear Expressions When a Group of Terms Is Subtracted; Simplifying Polynomials
mf-skill-0be640789287adb6.Skill Description: Adding and Subtracting Polynomials — Add or subtract polynomials by combining like terms, taking care to distribute a minus sign across brackets.

mf-skill-70a72952773dec53.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-70a72952773dec53.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Exponent rules; Graphing Elementary Cubic Functions; End Behavior of Functions; The Degree of a Polynomial
mf-skill-70a72952773dec53.Skill Description: End Behavior of Polynomials — Predict what a polynomial graph does far to the left and right using its degree and leading coefficient.

mf-skill-a24a2b26247fd9a3.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-a24a2b26247fd9a3.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Exponent rules; The Degree of a Polynomial
mf-skill-a24a2b26247fd9a3.Skill Description: Monomials, Binomials and Trinomials — Classify a polynomial as a monomial, binomial, or trinomial by counting its terms after simplifying.

mf-skill-bb667e19fe0fc0b1.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-bb667e19fe0fc0b1.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Exponent rules; The Product Rule for Exponents; Simplifying Polynomials
mf-skill-bb667e19fe0fc0b1.Skill Description: The Distributive Law for Polynomials — Use a(b + c) = ab + ac to multiply a monomial or polynomial across a bracket of terms.

mf-skill-d65a33bce9d46d70.Subject: Probability
mf-skill-d65a33bce9d46d70.Prerequisite Names: Probability rules; Integer powers; Sequences and finite sums; Modeling With the Binomial Distribution; The Geometric Distribution
mf-skill-d65a33bce9d46d70.Skill Description: Modeling With the Geometric Distribution — Apply the geometric distribution to real 'wait until the first success' situations and check that its assumptions hold.

mf-skill-4e92af5338cfae6c.Subject: Probability
mf-skill-4e92af5338cfae6c.Skill Name: Percentage Points of the Standard Normal Distribution
mf-skill-4e92af5338cfae6c.Prerequisite Names: Roots and radicals; Expectation and variance; Continuous probability densities; Symmetry Properties of the Standard Normal Distribution
mf-skill-4e92af5338cfae6c.Skill Description: Percentage Points of the Standard Normal Distribution — Find the z-value that cuts off a given tail probability of the standard normal, such as 1.96 for the upper 2.5%.

mf-skill-87ea02efd159e2e1.Subject: Probability
mf-skill-87ea02efd159e2e1.Prerequisite Names: Roots and radicals; Expectation and variance; Continuous probability densities; Symmetry Properties of the Standard Normal Distribution
mf-skill-87ea02efd159e2e1.Skill Description: The Normal Distribution — Understand the bell-shaped normal distribution, its symmetry, its parameters μ and σ, and probabilities as areas under the curve.

mf-skill-c733974f1b0859bf.Subject: Radical & Rational Expressions
mf-skill-c733974f1b0859bf.Prerequisite Names: Fraction products and quotients; Polynomial arithmetic; The Quotient Rule for Exponents; Equivalent Expressions With Fractions
mf-skill-c733974f1b0859bf.Skill Description: Simplifying Rational Expressions — Reduce a rational expression to lowest terms by cancelling common factors and stating which values are excluded.

mf-skill-de4dec3208e1448b.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions
mf-skill-de4dec3208e1448b.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; Inverse Variation; Graphs of Functions; Unbounded Behavior of Functions Near a Point
mf-skill-de4dec3208e1448b.Skill Description: Graphing Reciprocal Functions — Sketch y = 1/x and y = k/x, showing both branches and the asymptotes along the axes.

mf-skill-3591c72db13617de.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-3591c72db13617de.Skill Name: Determining Indexes of Terms in Geometric Sequences
mf-skill-3591c72db13617de.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; Sequences and finite sums; The Nth Term of a Geometric Sequence; Solving Exponential Equations
mf-skill-3591c72db13617de.Skill Description: Determining Indexes of Terms in Geometric Sequences — Solve for the position of a given term in a geometric sequence, using powers or logarithms.

mf-skill-7d2a805e404dc782.Subject: Sequences
mf-skill-7d2a805e404dc782.Skill Name: Finding the Common Ratio of a Geometric Sequence Given Two Terms
mf-skill-7d2a805e404dc782.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; Sequences and finite sums; The Quotient Rule for Exponents With Algebraic Expressions; The Nth Term of a Geometric Sequence; Solving Equations With Odd Exponents Using the Nth Root Method
mf-skill-7d2a805e404dc782.Skill Description: Finding the Common Ratio of a Geometric Sequence Given Two Terms — Find the common ratio of a geometric sequence from two known terms that need not be next to each other.

mf-skill-b7bdfe79f674a2e9.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-b7bdfe79f674a2e9.Prerequisite Names: Limits of functions; Geometric series; The Nth Term of a Geometric Sequence; Graphing Exponential Decay Functions
mf-skill-b7bdfe79f674a2e9.Skill Description: Convergence of Geometric Sequences — Decide whether a geometric sequence approaches a limit by examining the size and sign of its common ratio.

mf-skill-ee90c64631448b9d.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-ee90c64631448b9d.Skill Name: Finding the Sum of an Arithmetic Series
mf-skill-ee90c64631448b9d.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Sequences and finite sums; Properties of Finite Series; Expressing an Arithmetic Series in Sigma Notation
mf-skill-ee90c64631448b9d.Skill Description: Finding the Sum of an Arithmetic Series — Add the terms of an arithmetic series with Sn = n(a1 + an)/2 or its equivalent form using the common difference.

mf-skill-0688fce5785c50af.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-0688fce5785c50af.Skill Name: The Sum of the First N Terms of a Geometric Series
mf-skill-0688fce5785c50af.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Geometric series; The Sum of a Finite Geometric Series
mf-skill-0688fce5785c50af.Skill Description: The Sum of the First N Terms of a Geometric Series — Apply the partial-sum formula Sn to find geometric sums, missing values, or how many terms reach a target total.

mf-skill-420d3178d95e779e.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-420d3178d95e779e.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle distances; Unit-circle trigonometry; Finding Trigonometric Ratios of Quadrantal Angles; Finding Trigonometric Ratios of Special Angles Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-420d3178d95e779e.Skill Description: Evaluating Trigonometric Expressions — Evaluate expressions that combine trigonometric values, such as 2 sin 30° + cos²45°, exactly using known special values.

mf-skill-c381b7a4657dcb8b.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-c381b7a4657dcb8b.Skill Name: Further Extensions of the Special Trigonometric Ratios
mf-skill-c381b7a4657dcb8b.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle distances; Unit-circle trigonometry; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios to Negative Angles; Extending the Trigonometric Ratios to Large Angles; Finding Trigonometric Ratios of Special Angles Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-c381b7a4657dcb8b.Skill Description: Further Extensions of the Special Trigonometric Ratios — Apply special-angle values to negative angles, angles beyond 360°, and the reciprocal functions secant, cosecant and cotangent.

mf-skill-2d2fe546351a035f.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-2d2fe546351a035f.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Unit-circle trigonometry; Periodic Functions; Finding Trigonometric Ratios of Special Angles Using the Unit Circle
mf-skill-2d2fe546351a035f.Skill Description: Graphing Sine and Cosine — Plot y = sin x and y = cos x from unit-circle values, showing their wave shape, period 2π, and range from −1 to 1.

mf-skill-c01649865e5852a3.Subject: Two-Variable Equations
mf-skill-c01649865e5852a3.Skill Name: Equations of Lines in Slope-Intercept Form
mf-skill-c01649865e5852a3.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Ratios and unit rates; Linear equations in one unknown; Calculating Slopes of Straight Lines; Solving Two-Variable Equations
mf-skill-c01649865e5852a3.Skill Description: Equations of Lines in Slope-Intercept Form — Write a line's equation as y = mx + b from its slope and y-intercept, from two points, or by rearranging.

mf-skill-ba79c5ed192537d2.Subject: Vectors
mf-skill-ba79c5ed192537d2.Prerequisite Names: Vector components and arithmetic; Right-triangle trigonometry; The Cross Product of Two Vectors
mf-skill-ba79c5ed192537d2.Skill Description: Properties of the Cross Product — Use the algebraic rules of the cross product: anticommutativity, distributivity, scalar factoring, and zero for parallel vectors.

mf-skill-8e2bffd5f0f41732.Subject: Absolute Value
mf-skill-8e2bffd5f0f41732.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-NUF-004, MTH-ALF-006, MTH-ALF-010, MTH-NUS-009, MTH-ABV-005, MTH-EQI-042, MTH-EQI-043
mf-skill-8e2bffd5f0f41732.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Linear inequalities and intervals; Absolute Value; Absolute Value Equations; Compound AND Inequalities; Compound OR Inequalities
mf-skill-8e2bffd5f0f41732.Skill Description: Absolute Value Inequalities — Solve inequalities like |x − 2| < 3 or |x| > 4 and write the solutions as intervals.

mf-skill-12c46162c865c46f.Subject: Absolute Value
mf-skill-12c46162c865c46f.Skill Name: Combining Transformations of Absolute Value Graphs
mf-skill-12c46162c865c46f.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-NUF-004, MTH-ALF-006, MTH-ALF-010, MTH-ABV-007, MTH-FUN-019, MTH-ABV-008
mf-skill-12c46162c865c46f.Prerequisite Names: Signed numbers; Linear equations in one unknown; Linear inequalities and intervals; Stretches of Absolute Value Graphs; Combining Graph Transformations: Two Operations; Vertical Reflections of Absolute Value Graphs
mf-skill-12c46162c865c46f.Skill Description: Combining Transformations of Absolute Value Graphs — Sketch graphs of the form y = a|x − h| + k by combining shifts, stretches, and reflections of y = |x|.

mf-skill-2acfc550459ff823.Subject: Conic Sections

mf-skill-2acfc550459ff823.Skill Description: Equations of Ellipses Centered at a General Point — Use (x − h)²/a² + (y − k)²/b² = 1 to find the center, vertices, co-vertices and foci of a shifted ellipse.

mf-skill-f9f3d1ff08e73180.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-f9f3d1ff08e73180.Skill Name: Equations of Hyperbolas Centered at the Origin
mf-skill-f9f3d1ff08e73180.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Equations of Ellipses Centered at the Origin
mf-skill-f9f3d1ff08e73180.Skill Description: Equations of Hyperbolas Centered at the Origin — Use x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 or y²/a² − x²/b² = 1 to find the vertices and foci of an origin-centered hyperbola.

mf-skill-4da3c97461f1f78d.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-4da3c97461f1f78d.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Calculating Circle Intercepts; Equations of Ellipses Centered at the Origin
mf-skill-4da3c97461f1f78d.Skill Description: Finding Intercepts of Ellipses — Find where an ellipse crosses the coordinate axes, including shifted ellipses whose intercepts are not its vertices.

mf-skill-f2d180b4153d82f7.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-f2d180b4153d82f7.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Solving Linear Equations With Variables on Both Sides; Solving Linear Equations by Clearing a Rational Expression
mf-skill-f2d180b4153d82f7.Skill Description: Solving Linear Equations Using Cross-Multiplication — Solve an equation of the form a/b = c/d by cross-multiplying to get ad = bc, then solving the linear equation.

mf-skill-546fdc84b8a9b7b4.Subject: Equations & Inequalities
mf-skill-546fdc84b8a9b7b4.Skill Name: Solving Linear Equations With Unknown Coefficients by Factoring
mf-skill-546fdc84b8a9b7b4.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Linear equations in one unknown; Factoring Linear Expressions; Solving Linear Equations With Unknown Coefficients
mf-skill-546fdc84b8a9b7b4.Skill Description: Solving Linear Equations With Unknown Coefficients by Factoring — Isolate an unknown that appears in several terms with letter coefficients by collecting those terms and factoring the unknown out.

mf-skill-0b41123c0b9ddb68.Subject: Exponential Functions
mf-skill-0b41123c0b9ddb68.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Interpreting Exponential Decay; Solving Exponential Growth Problems
mf-skill-0b41123c0b9ddb68.Skill Description: Solving Exponential Decay Problems — Use an exponential decay model to find a future amount or the time needed to fall to a given level, such as with half-life.

mf-skill-bfae17e714108f2d.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-bfae17e714108f2d.Skill Name: Combining Graph Transformations of Exponential Functions
mf-skill-bfae17e714108f2d.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Exponential models; Combining Graph Transformations: Two Operations; Vertical Reflections of Exponential Functions; Vertical Translations of Exponential Decay Functions
mf-skill-bfae17e714108f2d.Skill Description: Combining Graph Transformations of Exponential Functions — Graph y = a·b^(x − h) + k by applying horizontal shifts, stretches, reflections and vertical shifts to a basic exponential graph in order.

mf-skill-7d071c44321285d6.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-7d071c44321285d6.Prerequisite Names: Inverse functions; Exponential models; Evaluating Logarithms
mf-skill-7d071c44321285d6.Skill Description: The Common Logarithm — The base-10 logarithm, written log(x) or log10(x), which gives the power of 10 that produces x.

mf-skill-348b2bf01348545d.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-348b2bf01348545d.Skill Name: Combining Graph Transformations: Three or More Operations
mf-skill-348b2bf01348545d.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; Combining Graph Transformations: Two Operations
mf-skill-348b2bf01348545d.Skill Description: Combining Graph Transformations: Three or More Operations — Apply three or more stretches, reflections, and shifts to a graph in a consistent order and track key points.

mf-skill-66a6f374e3f493ad.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-66a6f374e3f493ad.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Variables and expressions; Introduction to Functions; Equations of Lines in Slope-Intercept Form
mf-skill-66a6f374e3f493ad.Skill Description: Constructing Linear Functions — Write the equation of a linear function from two points, a slope and a point, a table, or a graph.

mf-skill-a69a96d9eae2d081.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-a69a96d9eae2d081.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Vertical Reflections of Functions; Horizontal Reflections of Functions
mf-skill-a69a96d9eae2d081.Skill Description: Even and Odd Functions — Classify functions by symmetry: even functions satisfy f(−x) = f(x) and odd functions satisfy f(−x) = −f(x).

mf-skill-2b73916ed1dfe9c4.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-2b73916ed1dfe9c4.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; Combining Graph Transformations: Two Operations
mf-skill-2b73916ed1dfe9c4.Skill Description: Finding Points on Transformed Curves — Given a point on y = f(x), find the matching point on a transformed graph such as y = a·f(x − h) + k.

mf-skill-cc54c6d3931d3d63.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-cc54c6d3931d3d63.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Introduction to Functions; Adding and Subtracting Polynomials
mf-skill-cc54c6d3931d3d63.Skill Description: The Arithmetic of Functions — Combine functions by adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing their outputs, while tracking the domain of each result.

mf-skill-3e47c14c90516a69.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-3e47c14c90516a69.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Linear inequalities and intervals; Further Solving Linear Inequalities; Equations of Lines in Slope-Intercept Form
mf-skill-3e47c14c90516a69.Skill Description: Graphing Strict Two-Variable Linear Inequalities — Graph linear inequalities using < or > by drawing a dashed boundary line and shading the correct half-plane.

mf-skill-543a1198b3723649.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-543a1198b3723649.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Factoring polynomials; Logarithms; Rational expressions and restrictions; Solving Inequalities Involving Exponential Functions
mf-skill-543a1198b3723649.Skill Description: Solving Inequalities Involving Logarithmic Functions — Solve inequalities involving logarithms by respecting the domain and the base's direction, then combining the conditions.

mf-skill-9df19c22f07105f5.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-9df19c22f07105f5.Skill Name: Solving Inequalities Involving Positive and Negative Factors
mf-skill-9df19c22f07105f5.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-ALF-010, MTH-ALF-017, MTH-ALF-021, MTH-NUS-018, MTH-EQI-035, MTH-EQI-042

mf-skill-58188426762baaca.Skill Description: Multiplying a Matrix by the Identity Matrix — Recognize that multiplying by an identity matrix of the right size leaves any matrix or vector unchanged.

mf-skill-9e40e70cb13caa95.Subject: Limits & Continuity

mf-skill-c550f81af516680e.Skill Description: Limits of Exponential Functions — Evaluate limits of exponential functions such as bˣ and e^(−x), including their end behaviour and values at finite points.

mf-skill-ee0e04267e53c0f6.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-ee0e04267e53c0f6.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; Limits at Infinity from Graphs; Infinite Limits from Graphs; Graphing Reciprocal Functions
mf-skill-ee0e04267e53c0f6.Skill Description: Limits of Reciprocal Functions — Find limits of reciprocal functions like 1/x and 1/(x − a), including unbounded behaviour near zero and approach to 0 at infinity.

mf-skill-6a5a40104aa5807b.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-6a5a40104aa5807b.Prerequisite Names: Exponential models; Limits of functions; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Limits at Infinity of Polynomials; Convergence of Geometric Sequences
mf-skill-6a5a40104aa5807b.Skill Description: Limits of Sequences — Determine whether a sequence aₙ converges to a finite limit as n → ∞ or diverges, and find the limit when it exists.

mf-skill-b90a90f39938ac65.Subject: Limits & Continuity

mf-skill-b90a90f39938ac65.Skill Description: Limits of Trigonometric Functions — Evaluate limits of sine, cosine, and tangent, using continuity for direct substitution and noting where tangent is undefined.

mf-skill-856056119bd13076.Subject: Limits & Continuity

mf-skill-856056119bd13076.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; Writing Radical Expressions Using Fractional Exponents; The Product and Quotient Rules for Limits
mf-skill-856056119bd13076.Skill Description: The Power and Root Rules for Limits — Pass a limit through powers and roots, using lim [f(x)]ⁿ = [lim f(x)]ⁿ and the matching rule for nth roots.

mf-skill-b980bd759781544c.Subject: Polynomials
