mf-skill-b980bd759781544c.Skill Description: Multiplying Binomials — Multiply two binomials by multiplying each term of one by each term of the other, often using FOIL.

mf-skill-fff3e6566c39a711.Subject: Polynomials

mf-skill-fff3e6566c39a711.Skill Description: The Greatest Common Factor of Two Monomials — Find the largest monomial dividing two monomials by combining the GCF of their coefficients with the lowest shared variable powers.

mf-skill-67a56b859c718d69.Subject: Parametric & Polar Coordinates
mf-skill-67a56b859c718d69.Skill Name: Converting from Polar Coordinates to Cartesian Coordinates
mf-skill-67a56b859c718d69.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Radians and arc length; Right-triangle trigonometry; Introduction to Polar Coordinates; Evaluating Trigonometric Expressions
mf-skill-67a56b859c718d69.Skill Description: Converting from Polar Coordinates to Cartesian Coordinates — Convert polar points and equations to Cartesian form using x = r cos θ and y = r sin θ.

mf-skill-1d60a671fec657a7.Subject: Parametric & Polar Coordinates
mf-skill-1d60a671fec657a7.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Functions, domains, and ranges; Right-triangle trigonometry; Introduction to Functions; Evaluating Trigonometric Expressions
mf-skill-1d60a671fec657a7.Skill Description: Graphing Curves Defined Parametrically — Sketch a parametric curve by tabulating t, plotting (x(t), y(t)), and marking the direction of motion.

mf-skill-e55e98598e422a57.Subject: Probability

mf-skill-e55e98598e422a57.Skill Description: Mean and Variance of the Normal Distribution — Interpret the mean μ and variance σ² of a normal distribution and find them from given probabilities.

mf-skill-3a384e1217eedc46.Subject: Quadratics

mf-skill-3a384e1217eedc46.Skill Description: Introduction to Quadratic Equations — Recognize quadratic equations, write them in standard form ax² + bx + c = 0, and check proposed solutions.

mf-skill-7d2b13f089cd0ecb.Subject: Radical & Rational Expressions

mf-skill-7d2b13f089cd0ecb.Skill Description: Solving Rational Equations Containing One Fractional Term — Solve an equation with a single fraction by multiplying both sides by its denominator to clear it.

mf-skill-08b8fbc5cc890101.Subject: Radical & Rational Expressions
mf-skill-08b8fbc5cc890101.Skill Name: Splitting Rational Expressions Into Separate Terms

mf-skill-08b8fbc5cc890101.Skill Description: Splitting Rational Expressions Into Separate Terms — Break a fraction with a multi-term numerator into a sum of simpler fractions over the same denominator.

mf-skill-e047fcb6cbfd97ab.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions

mf-skill-e047fcb6cbfd97ab.Skill Description: Graph Transformations of Reciprocal Functions — Sketch y = a/(x − h) + k by shifting the asymptotes of y = 1/x and stretching or reflecting its branches.

mf-skill-d0f87287fe46f0df.Skill Description: Graph Transformations of Square Root Functions — Sketch y = a√(b(x − h)) + k by shifting, stretching, and reflecting the basic square root curve.

mf-skill-1736e0039ad9b8f4.Subject: Sequences and Series

mf-skill-aa981886865e8814.Skill Description: Further Convergence of Geometric Sequences — Find limits of sequences built from geometric terms and determine the values of a variable that make them converge.

mf-skill-b7713815b0e05f0c.Skill Description: Infinite Series and Partial Sums — Form the sequence of partial sums of an infinite series and use its limit to define the series' value.

mf-skill-a1887b1acc4151e1.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-a1887b1acc4151e1.Skill Name: Sums of Finite Geometric Series Given in Sigma Notation

mf-skill-a1887b1acc4151e1.Skill Description: Sums of Finite Geometric Series Given in Sigma Notation — Evaluate a finite geometric sum given in sigma notation by identifying its first term, ratio and number of terms.

mf-skill-2549e0563fd053a7.Subject: Statistics

mf-skill-2549e0563fd053a7.Skill Description: Trend Lines — Draw a line of best fit through a scatter plot and write its equation to summarise a linear trend.

mf-skill-65c61475e907b783.Subject: Trigonometry

mf-skill-dea737308092d978.Skill Description: Graphing Tangent and Cotangent — Sketch y = tan x and y = cot x, placing their vertical asymptotes, zeros, and period-π branches correctly.

mf-skill-8ce4d7d18da9a13b.Subject: Trigonometry

mf-skill-769bcb6e3d1bb7bc.Subject: Two-Variable Equations

mf-skill-4df88d0c923d16d2.Skill Description: Introduction to Systems of Linear Equations — Understand what a system of linear equations is and what it means for an ordered pair to solve it.

mf-skill-cb7e95d94a32defb.Subject: Conic Sections

mf-skill-1dde80c4ba83f938.Subject: Functions

mf-skill-c73d59bf7c370d79.Skill Description: Solving Inequalities Involving Geometric Sequences — Find which terms or partial sums of a geometric sequence pass a given value, using logarithms and whole-number reasoning.

mf-skill-5068cceca83e52c0.Subject: Linear Algebra

mf-skill-e69455355c7f144d.Skill Description: Limits of Radical Functions — Evaluate limits of functions involving square roots and other radicals, paying attention to where the radicand is allowed.

mf-skill-3824d1ffb6ac2b45.Skill Description: Limits of Reciprocal Trigonometric Functions — Evaluate limits of secant, cosecant, and cotangent by rewriting them as reciprocals involving sine and cosine.

mf-skill-1aa0b0027cff3b32.Subject: Two-Variable Equations
mf-skill-1aa0b0027cff3b32.Skill Name: Further Modeling With Linear Equations in Two Variables

mf-skill-1aa0b0027cff3b32.Skill Description: Further Modeling With Linear Equations in Two Variables — Build linear models from data points and compare competing linear models to answer practical questions.

mf-skill-b26966bc734f4735.Subject: Two-Variable Equations

mf-skill-b26966bc734f4735.Skill Description: Solving Systems of Linear Equations Using Elimination: Two Transformations — Use elimination by multiplying both equations by different constants to create matching coefficients.

mf-skill-99b28dd810fd8f4a.Subject: Two-Variable Equations
mf-skill-99b28dd810fd8f4a.Skill Name: Systems of Equations With No Solutions and Infinitely Many Solutions

mf-skill-99b28dd810fd8f4a.Skill Description: Systems of Equations With No Solutions and Infinitely Many Solutions — Recognise during solving when a linear system has no solution or infinitely many, and describe the solution set.

mf-skill-1ba14bee8aa969a4.Subject: Vectors
mf-skill-1ba14bee8aa969a4.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Vector components and arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; Antiderivatives; Differentiating Vector-Valued Functions
mf-skill-1ba14bee8aa969a4.Skill Description: Integrating Vector-Valued Functions — Integrate a vector-valued function component by component, using a constant vector or an initial condition.

mf-skill-da99dd85d72421fe.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-da99dd85d72421fe.Skill Name: Inverses of Exponential and Logarithmic Functions

mf-skill-da99dd85d72421fe.Skill Description: Inverses of Exponential and Logarithmic Functions — Recognize y = bˣ and y = log_b(x) as inverse functions, and find inverses of simple exponential and logarithmic functions.

mf-skill-acd4761751a1bb4a.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms

mf-skill-acd4761751a1bb4a.Skill Description: Solving Logarithmic Equations Containing the Natural Logarithm — Solving equations involving ln(x) by isolating the natural logarithm and exponentiating with base e.

mf-skill-fc3574ceabc7adde.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-fc3574ceabc7adde.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; The Power Rule for Exponents; Logarithms; The Product Rule for Logarithms
mf-skill-fc3574ceabc7adde.Skill Description: The Power Rule for Logarithms — Using log_b(M^p) = p·log_b(M) to move an exponent in front of a logarithm or back inside it.

mf-skill-ac11d85d8f8d3a5b.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-ac11d85d8f8d3a5b.Prerequisite Names: Exponent rules; The Quotient Rule for Exponents; Logarithms; The Product Rule for Logarithms
mf-skill-ac11d85d8f8d3a5b.Skill Description: The Quotient Rule for Logarithms — Using log_b(M/N) = log_b(M) − log_b(N) to turn the log of a quotient into a difference, or the reverse.

mf-skill-073d7bfea2887ce0.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-073d7bfea2887ce0.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Reflections of Figures Across Arbitrary Lines; Calculating the Inverse of a Function
mf-skill-073d7bfea2887ce0.Skill Description: Graphs of Inverse Functions — Sketch the graph of an inverse function by reflecting the original graph across the line y = x.

mf-skill-5bbfd1c391b0e9d3.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-5bbfd1c391b0e9d3.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Factoring polynomials; Rational expressions and restrictions; Further Solving Linear Inequalities; Solving Quadratic Equations by Factoring
mf-skill-5bbfd1c391b0e9d3.Skill Description: Solving Elementary Quadratic Inequalities — Solve simple quadratic inequalities such as x² < 9 or x² ≥ 5, avoiding the mistake of taking only one square root.

mf-skill-53f18e8055a678f3.Subject: Linear Algebra

mf-skill-53f18e8055a678f3.Skill Description: Rotations as Linear Transformations — Rotate points about the origin through any angle θ using the matrix with rows (cos θ, −sin θ) and (sin θ, cos θ).

mf-skill-ccc4ece46094e9f0.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-ccc4ece46094e9f0.Skill Name: Solving Systems of Equations Using Inverse Matrices
mf-skill-ccc4ece46094e9f0.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-LIA-002, MTH-ALF-014, MTH-LIA-003, MTH-LAL-028, MTH-LAL-029, MTH-LAL-032

mf-skill-ccc4ece46094e9f0.Skill Description: Solving Systems of Equations Using Inverse Matrices — Solve square linear systems of any size, typically 3×3, by computing x = A⁻¹b when the coefficient matrix is invertible.

mf-skill-3017c5df66d3a2a0.Subject: Limits & Continuity

mf-skill-3017c5df66d3a2a0.Skill Description: The Intermediate Value Theorem — Use the Intermediate Value Theorem to show that a continuous function on [a, b] takes every value between f(a) and f(b).

mf-skill-cf85f9e3c46b86a2.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-cf85f9e3c46b86a2.Skill Name: Dividing Polynomials by Manipulating Rational Expressions

mf-skill-cf85f9e3c46b86a2.Skill Description: Dividing Polynomials by Manipulating Rational Expressions — Divide polynomials by rewriting the numerator so the divisor can be split off algebraically, without the long division layout.

mf-skill-924f3c7998f87a54.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-924f3c7998f87a54.Prerequisite Names: Factors and multiples; Polynomial arithmetic; Factoring Trinomials Using Common Factors
mf-skill-924f3c7998f87a54.Skill Description: Factoring Trinomials With Leading Coefficients — Factor trinomials ax² + bx + c where a is not 1, using the ac (grouping) method or trial and check.

mf-skill-40979a212f8b8626.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-40979a212f8b8626.Prerequisite Names: Collecting terms and distribution; Exponent rules; Solving Polynomial Equations Using the GCF; Factoring Cubic Expressions by Grouping
mf-skill-40979a212f8b8626.Skill Description: Solving Cubic Equations by Grouping — Solve four-term cubic equations by grouping pairs of terms to factor, then setting each factor equal to zero.

mf-skill-8491b068f0c04f06.Subject: Polynomials

mf-skill-8491b068f0c04f06.Skill Description: The Remainder Theorem — Find the remainder of dividing a polynomial f(x) by (x − a) simply by evaluating f(a).

mf-skill-fc41459a6426b949.Subject: Parametric & Polar Coordinates

mf-skill-fc41459a6426b949.Skill Description: Finding Intersections of Parametric Curves and Lines — Find where a parametric curve meets a line by substituting x(t) and y(t) into the line's equation and solving for t.

mf-skill-d580fc4b8424fe53.Subject: Quadratics

mf-skill-d580fc4b8424fe53.Skill Description: Graphs of General Quadratic Functions — Graph y = ax² + bx + c by finding its direction of opening, y-intercept, vertex, axis of symmetry and any x-intercepts.

mf-skill-f422bc3c90f997ca.Subject: Quadratics

mf-skill-f422bc3c90f997ca.Skill Description: Solving Quadratic Equations by Completing the Square — Solve x² + bx + c = 0 by rewriting the left side as a perfect square, then taking square roots.

mf-skill-687d0abdfbacca8f.Subject: Radical & Rational Expressions

mf-skill-687d0abdfbacca8f.Skill Description: Solving Rational Equations Containing Binomials Using Cross-Multiplication — Solve equations where one binomial fraction equals another by cross-multiplying and checking the excluded values.

mf-skill-37ca9f387a37f122.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions
mf-skill-37ca9f387a37f122.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; Domain and Range of Transformed Reciprocal Functions; Calculating the Inverse of a Function
mf-skill-37ca9f387a37f122.Skill Description: Inverses of Reciprocal Functions — Find the inverse of a reciprocal function by swapping x and y, and note how the asymptotes swap too.

mf-skill-7768064b933d589b.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions
mf-skill-7768064b933d589b.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-ALF-004, MTH-ALF-006, MTH-NUF-019, MTH-RRE-007, MTH-EQI-030, MTH-QUA-009

mf-skill-7768064b933d589b.Skill Description: Solving Radical Equations — Solve equations containing a radical by isolating it, raising both sides to a power, and checking for extraneous solutions.

mf-skill-b666412cb44d225d.Subject: Sequences and Series

mf-skill-b666412cb44d225d.Skill Description: Calculating the Number of Terms in an Arithmetic Series — Count how many terms an arithmetic series has, from its first term, last term and difference, or from its sum.

mf-skill-985e73db7b84ea41.Subject: Sequences and Series

mf-skill-985e73db7b84ea41.Skill Description: Expanding a Binomial Using Binomial Coefficients — Expand (a + b)^n using binomial coefficients C(n, k) and find specific terms without expanding fully.

mf-skill-1a7b94583b343696.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-1a7b94583b343696.Skill Name: Writing an Infinite Geometric Series in Sigma Notation

mf-skill-1a7b94583b343696.Skill Description: Writing an Infinite Geometric Series in Sigma Notation — Write an infinite geometric series in sigma notation by finding its first term and common ratio.

mf-skill-0ffc59881c18ca83.Subject: Trigonometry

mf-skill-63530e8dcffa59a1.Subject: Trigonometry

mf-skill-4774dacb74518b50.Skill Description: Speed-Time Graphs — Interpret speed-time graphs, reading acceleration from the gradient and recognising constant speed as a flat line.

mf-skill-738c99a2a99351ca.Skill Description: Combining the Laws of Logarithms — Expanding or condensing logarithmic expressions by applying the product, quotient, and power rules together.

mf-skill-277309777f648be2.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms

mf-skill-3fb5e30af80e6cc9.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms

mf-skill-521aed1de9471c62.Skill Name: Solving Logarithmic Equations Using the Laws of Logarithms

mf-skill-521aed1de9471c62.Skill Description: Solving Logarithmic Equations Using the Laws of Logarithms — Solving log equations by first condensing several same-base logs into one with the product or quotient rule.

mf-skill-346e257c90947ac6.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms

mf-skill-256ed37a7f925692.Subject: Functions

mf-skill-256ed37a7f925692.Skill Description: The Range of a Function: Advanced Cases — Find ranges for harder functions, such as rational functions or restricted domains, by solving for the input.

mf-skill-8b0a38b7f1089588.Subject: Inequalities

mf-skill-95a7424ddea6f417.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-95a7424ddea6f417.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Linear inequalities and intervals; Systems of Linear Inequalities; Graphs of General Quadratic Functions

mf-skill-4641ebd7471d1f8d.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-4641ebd7471d1f8d.Skill Name: Further Factoring Trinomials With Leading Coefficients
mf-skill-4641ebd7471d1f8d.Prerequisite Names: Factors and multiples; Polynomial arithmetic; Factoring Trinomials With Leading Coefficients
mf-skill-4641ebd7471d1f8d.Skill Description: Further Factoring Trinomials With Leading Coefficients — Factor harder trinomials with leading coefficients, including negative leading terms and trinomials in two variables.

mf-skill-40064ef55330ec99.Prerequisite Names: Factoring polynomials; Polynomial division; Determining the Roots of Polynomials; The Remainder Theorem
mf-skill-40064ef55330ec99.Skill Description: The Factor Theorem — State and use the rule that (x − a) is a factor of a polynomial p(x) exactly when p(a) = 0.

mf-skill-677cf250be75a345.Skill Description: Completing the Square With Odd Linear Terms — Complete the square when the x-coefficient is odd, handling the resulting halves and quarters exactly.

mf-skill-25f482deb94ebf9a.Subject: Quadratics
mf-skill-25f482deb94ebf9a.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Solving quadratic equations; The Roots of a Function; Graphs of General Quadratic Functions
mf-skill-25f482deb94ebf9a.Skill Description: Roots of Quadratic Functions — Find the zeros of a quadratic function, the x-values where f(x) = 0 and the graph crosses or touches the x-axis.

mf-skill-5d65fdc5fa5bacb7.Subject: Quadratics
mf-skill-5d65fdc5fa5bacb7.Skill Name: Solving Quadratic Equations with Leading Coefficients by Factoring
mf-skill-5d65fdc5fa5bacb7.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Roots and radicals; Factoring polynomials; Solving Quadratic Equations by Factoring; Factoring Trinomials With Leading Coefficients
mf-skill-5d65fdc5fa5bacb7.Skill Description: Solving Quadratic Equations with Leading Coefficients by Factoring — Factor quadratics ax² + bx + c with a ≠ 1, for example by the ac (grouping) method, and solve with the zero product rule.

mf-skill-00aa2ef912e3d800.Subject: Quadratics
mf-skill-00aa2ef912e3d800.Skill Name: The Axis of Symmetry of a Parabola

mf-skill-00aa2ef912e3d800.Skill Description: The Axis of Symmetry of a Parabola — Find the vertical line x = h that divides a parabola into mirror-image halves, using x = −b/(2a) or symmetric points.

mf-skill-cefcc4accf213442.Subject: Radical & Rational Expressions
mf-skill-cefcc4accf213442.Prerequisite Names: Fraction products and quotients; Polynomial arithmetic; Simplifying Rational Expressions; Factoring Trinomials With Leading Coefficients
mf-skill-cefcc4accf213442.Skill Description: Simplifying Rational Expressions by Factoring — Simplify rational expressions with polynomial numerators and denominators by factoring both fully and cancelling common factors.

mf-skill-97972fe321760064.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions
mf-skill-97972fe321760064.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Roots and radicals; Properties of Transformed Square Root Functions; Solving Radical Equations
mf-skill-97972fe321760064.Skill Description: Roots of Transformed Radical Functions — Find where a transformed square root or cube root function crosses the x-axis by solving f(x) = 0.

mf-skill-3c8e19795c042d92.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-3c8e19795c042d92.Skill Name: Sums of Infinite Geometric Series Given in Sigma Notation
mf-skill-3c8e19795c042d92.Prerequisite Names: Limits of functions; Geometric series; Sums of Finite Geometric Series Given in Sigma Notation; Writing an Infinite Geometric Series in Sigma Notation
mf-skill-3c8e19795c042d92.Skill Description: Sums of Infinite Geometric Series Given in Sigma Notation — Evaluate infinite geometric series written in sigma notation, checking convergence and reading the first term correctly.

mf-skill-d2fb439937ebb2a8.Subject: Sequences and Series
mf-skill-d2fb439937ebb2a8.Skill Name: The Special Case of the Binomial Theorem
mf-skill-d2fb439937ebb2a8.Prerequisite Names: Permutations and combinations; Polynomial arithmetic; Expanding a Binomial Using Binomial Coefficients
mf-skill-d2fb439937ebb2a8.Skill Description: The Special Case of the Binomial Theorem — Expand (1 + x)^n with the simplified binomial formula, and reduce general binomials to this form.

mf-skill-a38f5cf9f75ce70c.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-ALF-009, MTH-GET-011, MTH-CAL-002, MTH-FUN-015, MTH-TRI-032, MTH-FUN-034

mf-skill-a38f5cf9f75ce70c.Skill Description: Graphing the Inverse Sine Function — Sketch y = arcsin(x) by restricting sine to [−π/2, π/2] and reflecting that piece in the line y = x.

mf-skill-3cbd502cb30e6e73.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-3cbd502cb30e6e73.Prerequisite Names: Transforming function graphs; Periodic functions and phase; Horizontal Stretches of Functions; Horizontal Translations of Trigonometric Functions
mf-skill-3cbd502cb30e6e73.Skill Description: Horizontal Stretches of Trigonometric Functions — Change the period of a trigonometric function with y = f(Bx), compressing or stretching its graph horizontally.

mf-skill-d932acf7404287a0.Subject: Two-Variable Equations
mf-skill-d932acf7404287a0.Skill Name: Calculating Distance From a Speed-Time Graph
mf-skill-d932acf7404287a0.Prerequisite Names: Physical quantities and SI units; Slope and intercept; Areas of Trapezoids; Speed-Time Graphs
mf-skill-d932acf7404287a0.Skill Description: Calculating Distance From a Speed-Time Graph — Find the distance travelled by calculating the area between a speed-time graph and the time axis.

mf-skill-155f4a89089201af.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-155f4a89089201af.Skill Name: Determining Circle Properties by Completing the Square
mf-skill-155f4a89089201af.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Equations of Circles; Completing the Square With Odd Linear Terms
mf-skill-155f4a89089201af.Skill Description: Determining Circle Properties by Completing the Square — Convert a circle from general form x² + y² + Dx + Ey + F = 0 to standard form to find its center and radius.

mf-skill-3b36825cb71eba4d.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-3b36825cb71eba4d.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Plotting X as a Function of Y; Upward and Downward Opening Parabolas
mf-skill-3b36825cb71eba4d.Skill Description: Left and Right Opening Parabolas — Recognise and graph parabolas that open sideways, written as x = a(y − k)² + h or y² = 4px.

mf-skill-ca7dd693e71fbf1b.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-ca7dd693e71fbf1b.Skill Name: Combining Graph Transformations of Logarithmic Functions

mf-skill-ca7dd693e71fbf1b.Skill Description: Combining Graph Transformations of Logarithmic Functions — Applying several shifts, stretches, and reflections together to graph functions of the form y = a·log_b(x − h) + k.

mf-skill-ce6f50e22829e218.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-ce6f50e22829e218.Skill Name: Solving Equations Containing the Exponential Function
mf-skill-ce6f50e22829e218.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Exponent rules; The Natural Logarithm; Solving Exponential Equations Using Logarithms
mf-skill-ce6f50e22829e218.Skill Description: Solving Equations Containing the Exponential Function — Solve equations involving eˣ by isolating the exponential term and taking the natural logarithm of both sides.

mf-skill-7717b3bf78348ba5.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms

mf-skill-7717b3bf78348ba5.Skill Description: Solving Exponential Equations With Different Bases Using Logarithms — Solve exponential equations whose bases cannot share a common base by taking logarithms of both sides and solving for the exponent.

mf-skill-528e861191c2bcf3.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-528e861191c2bcf3.Skill Name: Solving Logarithmic Equations by Combining the Laws of Logarithms

mf-skill-528e861191c2bcf3.Skill Description: Solving Logarithmic Equations by Combining the Laws of Logarithms — Solving log equations that need several log laws at once, including the power rule, before converting to exponential form.

mf-skill-4df83838796068b2.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-4df83838796068b2.Skill Name: Solving Logarithmic Equations With Logarithms on Both Sides
mf-skill-4df83838796068b2.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Logarithms; Solving Quadratic Equations by Factoring; Solving Logarithmic Equations Using the Laws of Logarithms
mf-skill-4df83838796068b2.Skill Description: Solving Logarithmic Equations With Logarithms on Both Sides — Solving equations of the form log_b(A) = log_b(B) by setting the arguments equal and rejecting invalid solutions.

mf-skill-17047f5b7971512b.Subject: Functions
mf-skill-17047f5b7971512b.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Domain and Range of Inverse Functions
mf-skill-17047f5b7971512b.Skill Description: Invertible Functions — Decide whether a function has an inverse, and restrict its domain when needed to make it invertible.

mf-skill-51eff10809414797.Subject: Inequalities

mf-skill-51eff10809414797.Skill Description: Inequalities Involving Powers of Binomials — Solve inequalities containing powers such as (x − a)ⁿ, using how even and odd powers affect the sign.

mf-skill-5c7894425465115b.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-5c7894425465115b.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Factoring polynomials; Rational expressions and restrictions; Solving Elementary Quadratic Inequalities; Roots of Quadratic Functions
mf-skill-5c7894425465115b.Skill Description: Solving Quadratic Inequalities From Graphs — Read the solution of a quadratic inequality directly from a given graph of a parabola.

mf-skill-5a24a65c03f1b525.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-5a24a65c03f1b525.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-ALF-010, MTH-ALF-012, MTH-ALF-017, MTH-ALF-021, MTH-RRE-008, MTH-INE-010
mf-skill-5a24a65c03f1b525.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Radical equations; Factoring polynomials; Rational expressions and restrictions; The Square Root of a Perfect Square With Domain Restrictions; Solving Quadratic Inequalities Using the Sign Table Method
mf-skill-5a24a65c03f1b525.Skill Description: Solving Radical Inequalities — Solve inequalities involving square roots by combining the domain condition with a careful squaring step.

mf-skill-cb08d416d16a4e38.Subject: Linear Algebra

mf-skill-cb08d416d16a4e38.Skill Description: Inverting Linear Transformations — Undo a linear transformation with the inverse of its matrix, recovering original points from their images.

mf-skill-2e953889333647b1.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-2e953889333647b1.Skill Name: Calculating Limits of Rational Functions by Factoring
mf-skill-2e953889333647b1.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; The Product and Quotient Rules for Limits; Simplifying Rational Expressions by Factoring
mf-skill-2e953889333647b1.Skill Description: Calculating Limits of Rational Functions by Factoring — Resolve a 0/0 form in a rational function limit by factoring, cancelling the common factor, and then substituting.

mf-skill-12dd89a1d9b4cf5a.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-12dd89a1d9b4cf5a.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; Limits of Exponential Functions; Graphing Logarithmic Functions
mf-skill-12dd89a1d9b4cf5a.Skill Description: Limits of Logarithmic Functions — Evaluate limits of logarithmic functions, including their behaviour as x → 0 from the right and as x → ∞.

mf-skill-e0a0a624b15fc72a.Subject: Polynomials

mf-skill-e0a0a624b15fc72a.Skill Description: Determining Polynomial Coefficients Using the Factor Theorem — Use the fact that (x − a) is a factor exactly when p(a) = 0 to solve for unknown coefficients in a polynomial.

mf-skill-21f2ac3a47841d8b.Skill Description: Factoring Biquadratic Expressions — Factor fourth-degree expressions of the form ax⁴ + bx² + c by treating them as quadratics in x².

mf-skill-769c58c42681c394.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-769c58c42681c394.Skill Name: Factoring Cubic Polynomials Using the Factor Theorem

mf-skill-769c58c42681c394.Skill Description: Factoring Cubic Polynomials Using the Factor Theorem — Factor a cubic by finding one root with the factor theorem, dividing it out, and factoring the remaining quadratic.

mf-skill-bf6ad6ba00446a54.Subject: Polynomials

mf-skill-bf6ad6ba00446a54.Skill Description: The Rational Roots Theorem — List the only possible rational roots of an integer-coefficient polynomial using divisors of its constant and leading coefficients.

mf-skill-8100b08e1bf3805a.Subject: Quadratics

mf-skill-a797140139cbf6f8.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions
mf-skill-a797140139cbf6f8.Skill Name: Simplifying Rational Expressions Using Polynomial Factorization

mf-skill-a797140139cbf6f8.Skill Description: Simplifying Rational Expressions Using Polynomial Factorization — Reduce a rational expression to lowest terms by factoring numerator and denominator and cancelling common factors.

mf-skill-bb9938459ab73c7d.Subject: Sequences and Series

mf-skill-bb9938459ab73c7d.Prerequisite Names: Permutations and combinations; Polynomial arithmetic; The Special Case of the Binomial Theorem
mf-skill-bb9938459ab73c7d.Skill Description: Approximating Values Using the Binomial Theorem — Estimate powers such as 1.02^5 or 0.99^10 by keeping only the first few terms of a binomial expansion.

mf-skill-d230b3facf6da1e8.Subject: Trigonometry

mf-skill-d230b3facf6da1e8.Skill Description: Combining Graph Transformations of Sine and Cosine — Apply several transformations at once to sine or cosine, in a sensible order, to graph y = A sin(B(x − C)) + D.

mf-skill-04a7fa0adec42c55.Subject: Trigonometry

mf-skill-04a7fa0adec42c55.Skill Description: Graph Transformations of Tangent and Cotangent — Apply individual stretches, shifts, and reflections to tangent and cotangent graphs and track how asymptotes and key points move.

mf-skill-89a596450be9f750.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-89a596450be9f750.Prerequisite Names: Inverse functions; Unit-circle trigonometry; Limits of functions; Describing Properties of the Cosine Function; Graphing the Inverse Sine Function
mf-skill-89a596450be9f750.Skill Description: Graphing the Inverse Cosine Function — Sketch y = arccos(x) by restricting cosine to [0, π] and reflecting its graph in the line y = x.

mf-skill-cf6ddbff6d867ad8.Subject: Trigonometry

mf-skill-23888d4f9dfd74ff.Subject: Complex Numbers
mf-skill-23888d4f9dfd74ff.Skill Name: The Fundamental Theorem of Algebra with Cubic Equations
mf-skill-23888d4f9dfd74ff.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial division; Complex-number arithmetic; The Fundamental Theorem of Algebra for Quadratic Equations; Factoring Cubic Polynomials Using the Factor Theorem

mf-skill-8cbe548997769e16.Subject: Conic Sections

mf-skill-8cbe548997769e16.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Equations of Ellipses Centered at a General Point; Determining Circle Properties by Completing the Square
mf-skill-8cbe548997769e16.Skill Description: Finding the Center and Axes of Ellipses by Completing the Square — Complete the square in x and y to turn an expanded ellipse equation into standard form and read its center and axes.

mf-skill-59370fc1bdd9829a.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-59370fc1bdd9829a.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Left and Right Opening Parabolas
mf-skill-59370fc1bdd9829a.Skill Description: Parametric Equations of Parabolas — Write a parabola as a pair of parametric equations, such as x = t, y = t² or x = pt², y = 2pt.

mf-skill-8dfa2d0458afeb00.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-8dfa2d0458afeb00.Prerequisite Names: Transforming function graphs; Logarithms; Properties of Transformed Exponential Functions; Combining Graph Transformations of Logarithmic Functions
mf-skill-8dfa2d0458afeb00.Skill Description: Properties of Transformed Logarithmic Functions — Reading the domain, range, asymptote, intercepts, and increasing or decreasing behaviour of a transformed logarithmic function from its equation.

mf-skill-cd5a1b875c23343b.Subject: Exponentials & Logarithms
mf-skill-cd5a1b875c23343b.Skill Name: Solving Exponential Equations Using the Zero-Product Property

mf-skill-cd5a1b875c23343b.Skill Description: Solving Exponential Equations Using the Zero-Product Property — Solve exponential equations by factoring, often after substituting u = bˣ, then setting each factor to zero and rejecting impossible cases.

mf-skill-433861cebcca4304.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-433861cebcca4304.Skill Name: The Instantaneous Rate of Change of a Function at a Point
mf-skill-433861cebcca4304.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Limits of functions; The Average Rate of Change of a Function over a Varying Interval; Calculating Limits of Rational Functions by Factoring
mf-skill-433861cebcca4304.Skill Description: The Instantaneous Rate of Change of a Function at a Point — Find how fast a function is changing at a single input by taking the limit of average rates as the interval shrinks.

mf-skill-c62146d1a8be4ee1.Subject: Inequalities

mf-skill-c62146d1a8be4ee1.Skill Description: Solving Polynomial Inequalities Using the Sign Table Method — Solve polynomial inequalities by factoring completely and recording each factor's sign on every interval in a table.

mf-skill-a64c53182e007b00.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-a64c53182e007b00.Skill Name: Solving Quadratic Inequalities Using the Graphical Method
mf-skill-a64c53182e007b00.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Factoring polynomials; Rational expressions and restrictions; Graphs of General Quadratic Functions; Solving Quadratic Inequalities From Graphs
mf-skill-a64c53182e007b00.Skill Description: Solving Quadratic Inequalities Using the Graphical Method — Solve a quadratic inequality by finding its roots, sketching the parabola, and choosing the part above or below the axis.

mf-skill-3cdc15552a99ae52.Subject: Linear Algebra
mf-skill-3cdc15552a99ae52.Skill Name: Singular Linear Transformations in the Plane
mf-skill-3cdc15552a99ae52.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Vector components and arithmetic; Matrix arithmetic; Area Scale Factors of Linear Transformations; Inverting Linear Transformations
mf-skill-3cdc15552a99ae52.Skill Description: Singular Linear Transformations in the Plane — Recognize a plane transformation with zero determinant, which collapses the plane onto a line or a point and cannot be undone.

mf-skill-56aad0379e8c0a20.Skill Name: Calculating Limits of Radical Functions Using Conjugate Multiplication

mf-skill-23719857650fd368.Prerequisite Names: Exponential models; Limits of functions; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Limits of Exponential Functions; Limits of Logarithmic Functions

mf-skill-a3d4451a3410f687.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Unit-circle trigonometry; Describing Properties of the Tangent Function; Elementary Trigonometric Equations Containing Sine
mf-skill-a3d4451a3410f687.Skill Description: Elementary Trigonometric Equations Containing Tangent — Solve tangent equations like tan x = −1, using the period π to find every solution in an interval.

mf-skill-5e621300cb6fbf8a.Subject: Vectors
mf-skill-5e621300cb6fbf8a.Prerequisite Names: Vector components and arithmetic; Right-triangle trigonometry; Unit Vectors; Calculating the Dot Product Using Components; The Angle Between Two Vectors
mf-skill-5e621300cb6fbf8a.Skill Description: Calculating a Scalar Projection — Find the signed length of one vector along another, comp_b a = (a · b) / |b|.

mf-skill-e76ee6634bca3461.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-e76ee6634bca3461.Skill Name: Finding Intercepts and Intersections of Hyperbolas
mf-skill-e76ee6634bca3461.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Equations of Hyperbolas Centered at a General Point; Solving Systems of Nonlinear Equations
mf-skill-e76ee6634bca3461.Skill Description: Finding Intercepts and Intersections of Hyperbolas — Find where a hyperbola meets the axes, a line or another conic by substitution or elimination.

mf-skill-adee5e44b51bcd9e.Subject: Conic Sections
mf-skill-adee5e44b51bcd9e.Prerequisite Names: Cartesian coordinates; Parametric curves; Completing the square; Calculating Circle Intercepts; Solving Systems of Nonlinear Equations
mf-skill-adee5e44b51bcd9e.Skill Description: Intersections of Circles with Lines — Find the points where a line meets a circle by substitution, and tell whether it is a secant, a tangent or a miss.

mf-skill-f7f9dc8fa40e944e.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-f7f9dc8fa40e944e.Skill Name: Estimating Derivatives Using a Backward Difference Quotient
mf-skill-f7f9dc8fa40e944e.Prerequisite Names: Sequences and finite sums; Derivative as local rate; Estimating Derivatives Using a Forward Difference Quotient
mf-skill-f7f9dc8fa40e944e.Skill Description: Estimating Derivatives Using a Backward Difference Quotient — Estimate a derivative from the current point and the previous sample: [f(x) − f(x − h)]/h.

mf-skill-4fdc797760840919.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-4fdc797760840919.Skill Name: The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Differentiation
mf-skill-4fdc797760840919.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Limits of functions; The Power Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-4fdc797760840919.Skill Description: The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Differentiation — Differentiate sums, differences and constant multiples term by term, combining this with the power rule.

mf-skill-eb7832aac36c3647.Subject: Integration Techniques
mf-skill-eb7832aac36c3647.Skill Name: Expressing Rational Functions with Repeated Factors as Sums of Partial Fractions
mf-skill-eb7832aac36c3647.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial division; Rational expressions and restrictions; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Expressing Rational Functions as Sums of Partial Fractions
mf-skill-eb7832aac36c3647.Skill Description: Expressing Rational Functions with Repeated Factors as Sums of Partial Fractions — Decompose rational functions with repeated linear factors, giving one partial fraction for each power of the repeated factor.

mf-skill-49e660dd248ba847.Subject: Limits & Continuity
mf-skill-49e660dd248ba847.Skill Name: Limits at Infinity and Horizontal Asymptotes of Rational Functions
mf-skill-49e660dd248ba847.Prerequisite Names: Exponential models; Limits of functions; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Limits at Infinity of Polynomials; Horizontal Asymptotes of Rational Functions
mf-skill-49e660dd248ba847.Skill Description: Limits at Infinity and Horizontal Asymptotes of Rational Functions — Find a rational function's limit as x → ±∞ by comparing numerator and denominator degrees, giving its horizontal asymptote.

mf-skill-934483b3011fac39.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-934483b3011fac39.Skill Name: Graphing Cubic Curves Containing One Distinct Real Root
mf-skill-934483b3011fac39.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Factoring polynomials; Graphing Cubic Curves Containing a Double Root; The Discriminant of a Quadratic Equation
mf-skill-934483b3011fac39.Skill Description: Graphing Cubic Curves Containing One Distinct Real Root — Sketch a cubic that meets the x-axis only once, either through an irreducible quadratic factor or a triple root.

mf-skill-01e9295dd842d792.Subject: Quadratics
mf-skill-01e9295dd842d792.Skill Name: Determining Unknown Parameters in Quadratic Equations With One Real Solution
mf-skill-01e9295dd842d792.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Roots and radicals; Factoring polynomials; The Discriminant of a Quadratic Equation
mf-skill-01e9295dd842d792.Skill Description: Determining Unknown Parameters in Quadratic Equations With One Real Solution — Find the value of an unknown coefficient that gives a quadratic equation exactly one real solution by setting the discriminant to zero.

mf-skill-32aa696bc58e1e26.Subject: Quadratics
mf-skill-32aa696bc58e1e26.Skill Name: Finding Intersections of Lines and Quadratic Functions
mf-skill-32aa696bc58e1e26.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Solving quadratic equations; Solving Systems of Nonlinear Equations
mf-skill-32aa696bc58e1e26.Skill Description: Finding Intersections of Lines and Quadratic Functions — Find where a line meets a parabola by setting the expressions equal and solving the resulting quadratic equation.

mf-skill-888b92189f50846b.Subject: Quadratics
mf-skill-888b92189f50846b.Skill Name: The Discriminant of a Quadratic Function
mf-skill-888b92189f50846b.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Solving quadratic equations; Roots of Quadratic Functions; The Quadratic Formula; The Discriminant of a Quadratic Equation
mf-skill-888b92189f50846b.Skill Description: The Discriminant of a Quadratic Function — Use b² − 4ac to tell how many times the graph of y = ax² + bx + c meets the x-axis.

mf-skill-5c2e58afa3d57492.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions
mf-skill-5c2e58afa3d57492.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Linear equations in one unknown; Roots and radicals; The Domain of a Transformed Radical Function; Inverses of Quadratic Functions
mf-skill-5c2e58afa3d57492.Skill Description: Inverses of Radical Functions — Find inverses of square root and cube root functions, restricting domains so the inverse is a function.

mf-skill-8514eed0325d3d0c.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-8514eed0325d3d0c.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Unit-circle trigonometry; Describing Properties of the Cotangent Function; Elementary Trigonometric Equations Containing Tangent
mf-skill-8514eed0325d3d0c.Skill Description: Elementary Trigonometric Equations Containing Cotangent — Solve cotangent equations by converting to tangent or using unit-circle values, remembering that cotangent repeats every π.

mf-skill-ad9f0b97b1c9e60e.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-ad9f0b97b1c9e60e.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Unit-circle trigonometry; Describing Properties of the Secant Function; Elementary Trigonometric Equations Containing Cosine
mf-skill-ad9f0b97b1c9e60e.Skill Description: Elementary Trigonometric Equations Containing Secant — Solve equations like sec x = −2 by rewriting them in terms of cosine and locating every solution in the interval.

mf-skill-06996e6d5cfab629.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-06996e6d5cfab629.Skill Name: General Solutions of Elementary Trigonometric Equations
mf-skill-06996e6d5cfab629.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Unit-circle trigonometry; Elementary Trigonometric Equations Containing Cosine; Elementary Trigonometric Equations Containing Tangent
mf-skill-06996e6d5cfab629.Skill Description: General Solutions of Elementary Trigonometric Equations — Express every solution of a basic trigonometric equation using an integer parameter, such as x = π/6 + 2nπ.

mf-skill-c023217662c90391.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-c023217662c90391.Skill Name: Solving Trigonometric Equations Using the Sin-Cos-Tan Identity
mf-skill-c023217662c90391.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Unit-circle trigonometry; Simplifying Expressions Using Basic Trigonometric Identities; Elementary Trigonometric Equations Containing Tangent
mf-skill-c023217662c90391.Skill Description: Solving Trigonometric Equations Using the Sin-Cos-Tan Identity — Solve equations mixing sine and cosine, such as sin x = √3 cos x, by rewriting them as a tangent equation.

mf-skill-c5ac3eb77ae3ead5.Subject: Vectors
mf-skill-c5ac3eb77ae3ead5.Prerequisite Names: Vector components and arithmetic; Right-triangle trigonometry; Calculating the Dot Product Using Components; Calculating a Scalar Projection
mf-skill-c5ac3eb77ae3ead5.Skill Description: Calculating a Vector Projection — Find the vector component of a along b, proj_b a = ((a · b) / |b|²) b, and the perpendicular remainder.

mf-skill-ec796299a6532636.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-ec796299a6532636.Skill Name: Estimating Derivatives Using a Central Difference Quotient
mf-skill-ec796299a6532636.Prerequisite Names: Sequences and finite sums; Derivative as local rate; Estimating Derivatives Using a Backward Difference Quotient
mf-skill-ec796299a6532636.Skill Description: Estimating Derivatives Using a Central Difference Quotient — Estimate a derivative from samples on both sides, [f(x + h) − f(x − h)]/(2h), usually more accurately than one-sided quotients.

mf-skill-6b19eacdf4e50b92.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-6b19eacdf4e50b92.Skill Name: Calculating the Slope of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation
mf-skill-6b19eacdf4e50b92.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Limits of functions; The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Differentiation
mf-skill-6b19eacdf4e50b92.Skill Description: Calculating the Slope of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation — Compute the slope of the tangent to a curve at a point by evaluating the derivative there.

mf-skill-f2c86c5c3eeec1b5.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-f2c86c5c3eeec1b5.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; Limits Involving the Exponential Function; The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Differentiation
mf-skill-f2c86c5c3eeec1b5.Skill Description: Differentiating Exponential Functions — Differentiate eˣ, aˣ and exponentials of inner functions using d/dx(eˣ) = eˣ and the chain rule.

mf-skill-adc29036236fae8e.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-adc29036236fae8e.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; Special Limits Involving Sine; The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Differentiation
mf-skill-adc29036236fae8e.Skill Description: Differentiating Trigonometric Functions — Find derivatives of sine, cosine and tangent, and combine them with other rules, working in radians.

mf-skill-83650d44cf3752e5.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-83650d44cf3752e5.Skill Name: Interpreting the Meaning of the Derivative in Context
mf-skill-83650d44cf3752e5.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Limits of functions; Selecting Units for Rates of Change; The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Differentiation
mf-skill-83650d44cf3752e5.Skill Description: Interpreting the Meaning of the Derivative in Context — Explain what a derivative's value and sign mean in a real situation, with correct units of output per input.

mf-skill-7880e25f0017c1b4.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-7880e25f0017c1b4.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Differentiation
mf-skill-7880e25f0017c1b4.Skill Description: Second and Higher-Order Derivatives — Differentiate repeatedly to find second, third and higher derivatives, and interpret the second derivative as concavity or acceleration.

mf-skill-6d00dac9e6b5a37d.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-6d00dac9e6b5a37d.Prerequisite Names: Power, product, and quotient differentiation; The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Differentiation
mf-skill-6d00dac9e6b5a37d.Skill Description: The Antiderivative — Find a function whose derivative is a given function, and write the general antiderivative with an arbitrary constant C.

mf-skill-cda5a6ed1c4aad03.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-cda5a6ed1c4aad03.Skill Name: Further Solving of Two-Variable Nonlinear Inequalities
mf-skill-cda5a6ed1c4aad03.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Linear inequalities and intervals; Solving Two-Variable Nonlinear Inequalities; Finding Intersections of Lines and Quadratic Functions
mf-skill-cda5a6ed1c4aad03.Skill Description: Further Solving of Two-Variable Nonlinear Inequalities — Solve systems of nonlinear two-variable inequalities by shading overlapping regions and finding where boundary curves intersect.

mf-skill-3232c94a2f6f0afc.Subject: Integration Techniques
mf-skill-3232c94a2f6f0afc.Skill Name: Expressing Rational Functions with Irreducible Quadratic Factors as Sums of Partial Fractions
mf-skill-3232c94a2f6f0afc.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial division; Rational expressions and restrictions; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Expressing Rational Functions with Repeated Factors as Sums of Partial Fractions
mf-skill-3232c94a2f6f0afc.Skill Description: Expressing Rational Functions with Irreducible Quadratic Factors as Sums of Partial Fractions — Decompose rational functions whose denominators contain irreducible quadratic factors, using linear numerators over those factors.

mf-skill-cd421604b4d37012.Subject: Polynomials
mf-skill-cd421604b4d37012.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Factoring polynomials; Factoring Quartic Polynomials Using the Factor Theorem; Graphing Cubic Curves Containing One Distinct Real Root
mf-skill-cd421604b4d37012.Skill Description: Graphing General Polynomials — Sketch any factored polynomial from its end behaviour, real roots, root multiplicities, and y-intercept.

mf-skill-693b2f80ca48e6ea.Subject: Radical & Rational Functions
mf-skill-693b2f80ca48e6ea.Skill Name: Finding Intersections of Lines and Reciprocal Functions
mf-skill-693b2f80ca48e6ea.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Rational expressions and restrictions; Graphing Reciprocal Functions; Finding Intersections of Lines and Quadratic Functions
mf-skill-693b2f80ca48e6ea.Skill Description: Finding Intersections of Lines and Reciprocal Functions — Find where a straight line meets a reciprocal curve by setting them equal and solving the resulting quadratic.

mf-skill-bd6cc8fd2701719e.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-bd6cc8fd2701719e.Skill Name: General Solutions of Trigonometric Equations With Transformed Functions
mf-skill-bd6cc8fd2701719e.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Unit-circle trigonometry; Properties of Transformed Sine and Cosine Functions; General Solutions of Elementary Trigonometric Equations
mf-skill-bd6cc8fd2701719e.Skill Description: General Solutions of Trigonometric Equations With Transformed Functions — Find all solutions of equations like 2 sin(3x) = 1 by solving for the inner angle first, then undoing the transformation.

mf-skill-a981c8c87be22445.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-a981c8c87be22445.Skill Name: Calculating Velocity for Straight-Line Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-a981c8c87be22445.Prerequisite Names: Higher derivatives; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Distance-Time Graphs; Interpreting the Meaning of the Derivative in Context
mf-skill-a981c8c87be22445.Skill Description: Calculating Velocity for Straight-Line Motion Using Differentiation — Find instantaneous velocity on a line as the derivative of position, and read direction and rest from its sign.

mf-skill-ca77eb83dc85d11d.Subject: Differential Equations
mf-skill-ca77eb83dc85d11d.Prerequisite Names: Exponential models; Derivative as local rate; Fundamental theorem of calculus; The Antiderivative; Second and Higher-Order Derivatives
mf-skill-ca77eb83dc85d11d.Skill Description: Introduction to Differential Equations — Recognize what a differential equation is, its order, and what it means for a function to be a solution.

mf-skill-757811a82ebc9ddf.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-757811a82ebc9ddf.Skill Name: Global vs. Local Extrema and Critical Points
mf-skill-757811a82ebc9ddf.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-ALF-010, MTH-CAL-003, MTH-CAL-010, MTH-FUN-013, MTH-FUN-021, MTH-INC-007
mf-skill-757811a82ebc9ddf.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Continuity and discontinuities; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Global Extrema of Functions; Local Extrema of Functions; Calculating the Slope of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation
mf-skill-757811a82ebc9ddf.Skill Description: Global vs. Local Extrema and Critical Points — Distinguish local from global maxima and minima, and recognize critical points as the interior candidates for extrema.

mf-skill-b45817dc1901e0b9.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-b45817dc1901e0b9.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Continuity and discontinuities; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Continuity and Differentiability of Functions; Calculating the Slope of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation
mf-skill-b45817dc1901e0b9.Skill Description: The Mean Value Theorem — For a function continuous on [a, b] and differentiable on (a, b), some interior point has instantaneous slope equal to the average slope.

mf-skill-55408cbe1e305e16.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-55408cbe1e305e16.Skill Name: Calculating the Equation of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation
mf-skill-55408cbe1e305e16.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Limits of functions; Equations of Lines in Point-Slope Form; Calculating the Slope of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation
mf-skill-55408cbe1e305e16.Skill Description: Calculating the Equation of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation — Write the equation of the line touching a curve at a given point, using the derivative as its slope.

mf-skill-568bef089652b446.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-568bef089652b446.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; The Natural Logarithm; Differentiating Exponential Functions
mf-skill-568bef089652b446.Skill Description: Differentiating Logarithmic Functions — Differentiate ln x, logarithms to other bases, and logs of inner functions, using log laws to simplify first.

mf-skill-fff7b10bdf11b4d9.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-fff7b10bdf11b4d9.Skill Name: The Constant Multiple Rule for Indefinite Integrals
mf-skill-fff7b10bdf11b4d9.Prerequisite Names: Power, product, and quotient differentiation; The Antiderivative
mf-skill-fff7b10bdf11b4d9.Skill Description: The Constant Multiple Rule for Indefinite Integrals — Move a constant factor outside an indefinite integral, using ∫ k·f(x) dx = k ∫ f(x) dx.

mf-skill-37ebcdf62c3cbcab.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-37ebcdf62c3cbcab.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Differentiation; Differentiating Exponential Functions
mf-skill-37ebcdf62c3cbcab.Skill Description: The Product Rule for Differentiation — Differentiate a product of two functions with (fg)' = f'g + fg'.

mf-skill-fe77e650ab325c85.Subject: Inequalities
mf-skill-fe77e650ab325c85.Skill Name: Solving Polynomial Inequalities Using a Graphical Method
mf-skill-fe77e650ab325c85.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Factoring polynomials; Rational expressions and restrictions; Solving Quadratic Inequalities Using the Graphical Method; Graphing General Polynomials
mf-skill-fe77e650ab325c85.Skill Description: Solving Polynomial Inequalities Using a Graphical Method — Solve polynomial inequalities by sketching the graph from its roots, multiplicities and end behaviour, then reading where it lies above or below the axis.

mf-skill-f032ecb8421cae91.Subject: Trigonometry
mf-skill-f032ecb8421cae91.Skill Name: Trigonometric Equations Containing Transformed Tangent Functions
mf-skill-f032ecb8421cae91.Prerequisite Names: Linear equations in one unknown; Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Unit-circle trigonometry; Graph Transformations of Tangent and Cotangent; General Solutions of Trigonometric Equations With Transformed Functions
mf-skill-f032ecb8421cae91.Skill Description: Trigonometric Equations Containing Transformed Tangent Functions — Solve equations such as tan(2x) = 1 or 3 tan(x − π/6) = √3, using the transformed period to list all solutions.

mf-skill-ef1a505f80d7873b.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-ef1a505f80d7873b.Skill Name: Calculating Acceleration for Straight-Line Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-ef1a505f80d7873b.Prerequisite Names: Higher derivatives; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Second and Higher-Order Derivatives; Calculating Velocity for Straight-Line Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-ef1a505f80d7873b.Skill Description: Calculating Acceleration for Straight-Line Motion Using Differentiation — Find the acceleration of an object on a line by differentiating its velocity, or its position twice.

mf-skill-fb7371d12814b044.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-fb7371d12814b044.Skill Name: Calculating Velocity for Plane Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-fb7371d12814b044.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-GET-004, MTH-LIA-001, MTH-CAL-016, MTH-PPC-004, MTH-VEC-023, MTH-CAC-001
mf-skill-fb7371d12814b044.Prerequisite Names: Parametric curves; Vector components and arithmetic; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Differentiating Parametric Curves; Differentiating Vector-Valued Functions; Calculating Velocity for Straight-Line Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-fb7371d12814b044.Skill Description: Calculating Velocity for Plane Motion Using Differentiation — Differentiate position components to get a planar velocity vector, and find speed as its magnitude.

mf-skill-7677f9f11698f25e.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-7677f9f11698f25e.Skill Name: Approximating Functions Using Local Linearity and Linearization
mf-skill-7677f9f11698f25e.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Continuity and discontinuities; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Calculating the Equation of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation
mf-skill-7677f9f11698f25e.Skill Description: Approximating Functions Using Local Linearity and Linearization — Approximate a function near a point by its tangent line, L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x − a).

mf-skill-b9f9e0704c20921c.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-b9f9e0704c20921c.Prerequisite Names: Linear inequalities and intervals; Continuity and discontinuities; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Continuity of Functions; Global vs. Local Extrema and Critical Points
mf-skill-b9f9e0704c20921c.Skill Description: The Extreme Value Theorem — A continuous function on a closed, bounded interval always attains both an absolute maximum and an absolute minimum.

mf-skill-3b6928b376164e92.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-3b6928b376164e92.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; Calculating the Slope of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation; The Product Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-3b6928b376164e92.Skill Description: Calculating Derivatives From Graphs — Read derivative values as tangent slopes from a graph and use graphed values with differentiation rules.

mf-skill-2a7d6c526e1fec20.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-2a7d6c526e1fec20.Skill Name: Calculating the Equation of a Normal Line Using Differentiation
mf-skill-2a7d6c526e1fec20.Prerequisite Names: Slope and intercept; Limits of functions; Finding Equations of Perpendicular Lines; Calculating the Equation of a Tangent Line Using Differentiation
mf-skill-2a7d6c526e1fec20.Skill Description: Calculating the Equation of a Normal Line Using Differentiation — Find the line perpendicular to a curve's tangent at a point, using the negative reciprocal of the derivative as its slope.

mf-skill-4a697b286d548548.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-4a697b286d548548.Prerequisite Names: Function composition; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Describing Function Composition; The Product Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-4a697b286d548548.Skill Description: The Chain Rule for Differentiation — Differentiate a composite function f(g(x)) by multiplying the outer derivative, evaluated at the inner function, by the inner derivative.

mf-skill-83c657bd7561f063.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-83c657bd7561f063.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; The Product Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-83c657bd7561f063.Skill Description: The Quotient Rule for Differentiation — Differentiate a ratio of two functions with (f/g)' = (f'g − fg')/g², where g is nonzero.

mf-skill-cdf0f218eaaaf442.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-cdf0f218eaaaf442.Skill Name: The Sum Rule for Indefinite Integrals
mf-skill-cdf0f218eaaaf442.Prerequisite Names: Power, product, and quotient differentiation; The Constant Multiple Rule for Indefinite Integrals
mf-skill-cdf0f218eaaaf442.Skill Description: The Sum Rule for Indefinite Integrals — Integrate a sum or difference term by term, using ∫ [f(x) ± g(x)] dx = ∫ f(x) dx ± ∫ g(x) dx.

mf-skill-eb46c764f099b144.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-eb46c764f099b144.Skill Name: Calculating Acceleration for Plane Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-eb46c764f099b144.Prerequisite Names: Parametric curves; Vector components and arithmetic; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Calculating Acceleration for Straight-Line Motion Using Differentiation; Calculating Velocity for Plane Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-eb46c764f099b144.Skill Description: Calculating Acceleration for Plane Motion Using Differentiation — Differentiate each component of a planar velocity vector to find the acceleration vector of an object moving in 2D.

mf-skill-4430127237535b12.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-4430127237535b12.Prerequisite Names: Higher derivatives; Fundamental theorem of calculus; The Sum Rule for Indefinite Integrals; Calculating Acceleration for Straight-Line Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-4430127237535b12.Skill Description: Calculating Velocity Using Integration — Find velocity from acceleration by integrating, using an initial velocity to fix the constant of integration.

mf-skill-82b750a76f7aeba7.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-82b750a76f7aeba7.Prerequisite Names: Definite integrals and accumulation; Antiderivatives; Defining Definite Integrals Using Left and Right Riemann Sums; The Sum Rule for Indefinite Integrals
mf-skill-82b750a76f7aeba7.Skill Description: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus — Link differentiation and integration: accumulation functions differentiate back to the integrand, and definite integrals are evaluated with antiderivatives.

mf-skill-c1c82e41a41e1edd.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-c1c82e41a41e1edd.Prerequisite Names: Inverse functions; Chain rule; Plotting X as a Function of Y; The Chain Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-c1c82e41a41e1edd.Skill Description: Calculating dy/dx Using dx/dy — Find dy/dx as the reciprocal of dx/dy when x is given as a function of y.

mf-skill-1f01a31ce10150d0.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-1f01a31ce10150d0.Skill Name: Calculating Slopes of Circles, Ellipses, and Parabolas
mf-skill-1f01a31ce10150d0.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-ALF-009, MTH-CAL-012, MTH-CAL-017, MTH-COS-003, MTH-COS-006, MTH-INC-019
mf-skill-1f01a31ce10150d0.Prerequisite Names: Inverse functions; Chain rule; Implicit differentiation; Equations of Circles; Equations of Ellipses Centered at the Origin; The Chain Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-1f01a31ce10150d0.Skill Description: Calculating Slopes of Circles, Ellipses, and Parabolas — Find the slope of the tangent line at a point on a circle, ellipse, or parabola using implicit differentiation.

mf-skill-92a80d47d53136fd.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-92a80d47d53136fd.Prerequisite Names: Sequences and finite sums; Higher derivatives; Second and Higher-Order Derivatives; Approximating Functions Using Local Linearity and Linearization
mf-skill-92a80d47d53136fd.Skill Description: Second-Degree Taylor Polynomials — Build the quadratic approximation f(a) + f'(a)(x − a) + f''(a)(x − a)²/2, matching a function's value, slope, and concavity at a point.

mf-skill-9dd5861d14c3427d.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-9dd5861d14c3427d.Skill Name: Calculating Derivatives From Data and Tables
mf-skill-9dd5861d14c3427d.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; The Quotient Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-9dd5861d14c3427d.Skill Description: Calculating Derivatives From Data and Tables — Use tabulated function and derivative values with differentiation rules, or estimate derivatives from data using difference quotients.

mf-skill-31af78296ce3e1c8.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-31af78296ce3e1c8.Prerequisite Names: Polynomial arithmetic; Derivative as local rate; Differentiating Trigonometric Functions; The Quotient Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-31af78296ce3e1c8.Skill Description: Differentiating Reciprocal Trigonometric Functions — Differentiate secant, cosecant and cotangent, deriving their formulas from sine and cosine with the quotient rule.

mf-skill-fa013904ec995ea7.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-fa013904ec995ea7.Prerequisite Names: Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Differentiating Exponential Functions; The Sum Rule for Indefinite Integrals
mf-skill-fa013904ec995ea7.Skill Description: Integrating Exponential Functions — Find antiderivatives of eˣ, e^(kx) and aˣ, and evaluate definite integrals of simple exponentials.

mf-skill-39f48d2002cba63c.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-39f48d2002cba63c.Prerequisite Names: Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Differentiating Logarithmic Functions; The Sum Rule for Indefinite Integrals
mf-skill-39f48d2002cba63c.Skill Description: Integrating the Reciprocal Function — Integrate 1/x to get ln|x| + C, the case the power rule for integration cannot handle.

mf-skill-ca09e60029b2bbf2.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-ca09e60029b2bbf2.Prerequisite Names: Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Differentiating Trigonometric Functions; The Sum Rule for Indefinite Integrals
mf-skill-ca09e60029b2bbf2.Skill Description: Integrating Trigonometric Functions — Recall and apply the standard antiderivatives of sine, cosine and the other basic trig derivative results.

mf-skill-d95fd88d9660afcc.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-d95fd88d9660afcc.Skill Name: The Chain Rule With Exponential Functions
mf-skill-d95fd88d9660afcc.Prerequisite Names: Function composition; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Differentiating Exponential Functions; The Chain Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-d95fd88d9660afcc.Skill Description: The Chain Rule With Exponential Functions — Differentiate exponentials with a function in the exponent, such as e^(g(x)) or a^(g(x)), using the chain rule.

mf-skill-8169be40f65d8a6d.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-8169be40f65d8a6d.Skill Name: The Chain Rule With Logarithmic Functions
mf-skill-8169be40f65d8a6d.Prerequisite Names: Function composition; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Differentiating Logarithmic Functions; The Chain Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-8169be40f65d8a6d.Skill Description: The Chain Rule With Logarithmic Functions — Differentiate logarithms of inner functions, such as ln(g(x)), using the result d/dx ln(g(x)) = g′(x)/g(x).

mf-skill-1daffc815fa375a3.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-1daffc815fa375a3.Skill Name: The Chain Rule With Trigonometric Functions
mf-skill-1daffc815fa375a3.Prerequisite Names: Function composition; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; Differentiating Trigonometric Functions; The Chain Rule for Differentiation
mf-skill-1daffc815fa375a3.Skill Description: The Chain Rule With Trigonometric Functions — Differentiate trigonometric functions of an inner expression, such as sin(g(x)) or cos²(x), using the chain rule.

mf-skill-b4cb38ef445be416.Subject: Integration Techniques
mf-skill-b4cb38ef445be416.Prerequisite Names: Chain rule; Fundamental theorem of calculus; The Chain Rule for Differentiation; The Sum Rule for Indefinite Integrals
mf-skill-b4cb38ef445be416.Skill Description: Integrating Algebraic Functions Using Substitution — Integrate algebraic expressions by substituting for an inner expression whose derivative appears as a factor.

mf-skill-cf9b48f1878bf935.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-cf9b48f1878bf935.Skill Name: Calculating the Position Function of a Particle Using Integration
mf-skill-cf9b48f1878bf935.Prerequisite Names: Higher derivatives; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Calculating Velocity Using Integration
mf-skill-cf9b48f1878bf935.Skill Description: Calculating the Position Function of a Particle Using Integration — Recover a particle's position function by antidifferentiating its velocity and using an initial position to fix the constant.

mf-skill-37529637d432abe8.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-37529637d432abe8.Skill Name: Finding Velocity Vectors in Two Dimensions Using Integration
mf-skill-37529637d432abe8.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-GET-004, MTH-LIA-001, MTH-CAL-016, MTH-VEC-025, MTH-CAC-005, MTH-CAC-004
mf-skill-37529637d432abe8.Prerequisite Names: Parametric curves; Vector components and arithmetic; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Integrating Vector-Valued Functions; Calculating Velocity Using Integration; Calculating Acceleration for Plane Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-37529637d432abe8.Skill Description: Finding Velocity Vectors in Two Dimensions Using Integration — Recover a two-dimensional velocity vector by integrating the acceleration vector component by component and applying the initial velocity.

mf-skill-e832ca38a066895d.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-e832ca38a066895d.Skill Name: Velocity and Acceleration for Plane Motion
mf-skill-e832ca38a066895d.Prerequisite Names: Parametric curves; Vector components and arithmetic; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Calculating the Magnitude of Cartesian Vectors in 2D; Calculating Acceleration for Plane Motion Using Differentiation
mf-skill-e832ca38a066895d.Skill Description: Velocity and Acceleration for Plane Motion — Differentiate a position vector to find velocity, speed, and acceleration for an object moving in a plane.

mf-skill-9f5eb2920f57fd41.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-9f5eb2920f57fd41.Skill Name: Applying the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus to Exponential and Trigonometric Functions
mf-skill-9f5eb2920f57fd41.Prerequisite Names: Definite integrals and accumulation; Antiderivatives; The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus; Integrating Trigonometric Functions; Integrating Exponential Functions
mf-skill-9f5eb2920f57fd41.Skill Description: Applying the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus to Exponential and Trigonometric Functions — Evaluate definite integrals of exponential and trigonometric functions by finding antiderivatives and applying the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

mf-skill-3b5f10fbf4799d4f.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-3b5f10fbf4799d4f.Skill Name: The Arc Length of a Planar Curve
mf-skill-3b5f10fbf4799d4f.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-GET-002, MTH-GET-003, MTH-CAL-016, MTH-TVE-002, MTH-INC-019, MTH-DEI-006
mf-skill-3b5f10fbf4799d4f.Prerequisite Names: Perimeter and planar area; Surface area and volume; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Distances Between Points in the Coordinate Plane; The Chain Rule for Differentiation; The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
mf-skill-3b5f10fbf4799d4f.Skill Description: The Arc Length of a Planar Curve — Find the length of a curve between two points by integrating the square root of one plus the derivative squared.

mf-skill-beb194456c8caf5d.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-beb194456c8caf5d.Skill Name: The Area Bounded by a Curve and the X-Axis
mf-skill-beb194456c8caf5d.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Fundamental theorem of calculus; The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
mf-skill-beb194456c8caf5d.Skill Description: The Area Bounded by a Curve and the X-Axis — Compute the area of a region between a curve and the x-axis over an interval using a definite integral.

mf-skill-8fc22b4b43407d64.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-8fc22b4b43407d64.Skill Name: The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Definite Integrals
mf-skill-8fc22b4b43407d64.Prerequisite Names: Definite integrals and accumulation; Antiderivatives; The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
mf-skill-8fc22b4b43407d64.Skill Description: The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Definite Integrals — Split definite integrals of sums and pull constant factors outside the integral to simplify evaluation.

mf-skill-fc41dba03cfb3cf3.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-fc41dba03cfb3cf3.Prerequisite Names: Sequences and finite sums; Higher derivatives; Second-Degree Taylor Polynomials
mf-skill-fc41dba03cfb3cf3.Skill Description: Analyzing Second-Degree Taylor Polynomials — Read a function's value, slope, concavity, and error bounds from its second-degree Taylor polynomial.

mf-skill-b306ad6edac04785.Subject: Differentiation
mf-skill-b306ad6edac04785.Prerequisite Names: Inverse functions; Chain rule; Calculating the Inverse of a Function; Calculating dy/dx Using dx/dy
mf-skill-b306ad6edac04785.Skill Description: Differentiating Inverse Functions — Derive and apply the general rule (f⁻¹)'(x) = 1/f'(f⁻¹(x)) for the derivative of an inverse function.

mf-skill-4cbc1944b7ad106d.Subject: Introduction to Calculus
mf-skill-4cbc1944b7ad106d.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-ALF-005, MTH-CAL-010, MTH-INC-029, MTH-INC-023, MTH-INC-028, MTH-INC-027
mf-skill-4cbc1944b7ad106d.Prerequisite Names: Function composition; Power, product, and quotient differentiation; The Chain Rule With Trigonometric Functions; Differentiating Reciprocal Trigonometric Functions; The Chain Rule With Logarithmic Functions; The Chain Rule With Exponential Functions
mf-skill-4cbc1944b7ad106d.Skill Description: Selecting Procedures for Calculating Derivatives — Decide which differentiation rules an expression needs, and in what order, by analysing its structure.

mf-skill-14f712d96ae51d13.Subject: Integration Techniques

mf-skill-14f712d96ae51d13.Prerequisite Names: Chain rule; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Integrating Algebraic Functions Using Substitution; Integrating Exponential Functions
mf-skill-14f712d96ae51d13.Skill Description: Integrating Exponential Functions Using Linear Substitution — Integrate exponentials with a linear exponent, such as e^(ax + b), by substituting u = ax + b and dividing by a.

mf-skill-3f5cc844bf62e40c.Subject: Integration Techniques
mf-skill-3f5cc844bf62e40c.Skill Name: Integrating Linear Rational Functions Using Substitution
mf-skill-3f5cc844bf62e40c.Prerequisite Names: Chain rule; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Integrating the Reciprocal Function; Integrating Algebraic Functions Using Substitution
mf-skill-3f5cc844bf62e40c.Skill Description: Integrating Linear Rational Functions Using Substitution — Integrate fractions whose denominator is a linear expression ax + b by substituting u = ax + b.

mf-skill-6ed4f3d0c7b3ed37.Subject: Integration Techniques
mf-skill-6ed4f3d0c7b3ed37.Prerequisite Names: Chain rule; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Integrating Algebraic Functions Using Substitution
mf-skill-6ed4f3d0c7b3ed37.Skill Description: Integration Using Substitution — Use u-substitution, the reverse of the chain rule, to turn a composite integrand into a simpler integral in a new variable.

mf-skill-034a2ba6ffe753c4.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-034a2ba6ffe753c4.Skill Name: Calculating the Displacement of a Particle Using Integration
mf-skill-034a2ba6ffe753c4.Prerequisite Names: Higher derivatives; Fundamental theorem of calculus; The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus; Calculating the Position Function of a Particle Using Integration
mf-skill-034a2ba6ffe753c4.Skill Description: Calculating the Displacement of a Particle Using Integration — Compute net change in position by integrating velocity, and separate it from total distance travelled.

mf-skill-dfa67a0204faa3f4.Subject: Contextual Applications of Calculus
mf-skill-dfa67a0204faa3f4.Skill Name: Rates of Change in Applied Contexts
mf-skill-dfa67a0204faa3f4.Prerequisite Names: Single-variable optimization; Implicit differentiation; Interpreting the Meaning of the Derivative in Context; Selecting Procedures for Calculating Derivatives
mf-skill-dfa67a0204faa3f4.Skill Description: Rates of Change in Applied Contexts — Interpret derivatives as rates of change with units in real settings such as motion, economics, biology, and physics.

mf-skill-c98a76aa8846b48d.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-c98a76aa8846b48d.Skill Name: Finding the Area Between a Curve and the X-Axis When They Intersect
mf-skill-c98a76aa8846b48d.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Fundamental theorem of calculus; The Roots of a Function; The Area Bounded by a Curve and the X-Axis

mf-skill-ffbc8ed38782a660.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-ffbc8ed38782a660.Skill Name: Properties of Definite Integrals Involving the Limits of Integration
mf-skill-ffbc8ed38782a660.Prerequisite Names: Definite integrals and accumulation; Antiderivatives; The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Definite Integrals
mf-skill-ffbc8ed38782a660.Skill Description: Properties of Definite Integrals Involving the Limits of Integration — Use rules about the limits of integration, including zero-width intervals, reversed limits, and splitting an interval, to evaluate integrals.

mf-skill-20301db6f7b45b09.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-20301db6f7b45b09.Skill Name: The Area Bounded by a Curve and the Y-Axis
mf-skill-20301db6f7b45b09.Prerequisite Names: Functions, domains, and ranges; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Plotting X as a Function of Y; The Area Bounded by a Curve and the X-Axis
mf-skill-20301db6f7b45b09.Skill Description: The Area Bounded by a Curve and the Y-Axis — Find the area between a curve and the y-axis by writing x as a function of y and integrating with respect to y.

mf-skill-85757e054838ad95.Subject: Definite Integrals
mf-skill-85757e054838ad95.Skill Name: The Average Value of a Function
mf-skill-85757e054838ad95.Prerequisite Names: Perimeter and planar area; Surface area and volume; Fundamental theorem of calculus; The Sum and Constant Multiple Rules for Definite Integrals; Applying the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus to Exponential and Trigonometric Functions
mf-skill-85757e054838ad95.Skill Description: The Average Value of a Function — Find the average height of a continuous function over an interval by dividing its definite integral by the interval's length.

mf-skill-9ad4887a54aa66a1.Subject: Differential Equations
mf-skill-9ad4887a54aa66a1.Prerequisite Names: Exponential models; Derivative as local rate; Fundamental theorem of calculus; Introduction to Differential Equations; Selecting Procedures for Calculating Derivatives
mf-skill-9ad4887a54aa66a1.Skill Description: Verifying Solutions of Differential Equations — Check whether a given function solves a differential equation by substituting it and its derivatives into the equation.

mf-skill-0cabcdb035faa11c.Subject: Differentiation
