e-shielding.Skill Description: Shielding and twisted-pair concepts — Reduce noise pickup in wiring by controlling electric and magnetic field coupling with shields and twisted pairs.

hx-elx-wiring-harness.Subject: Wiring, connectors and harnesses
hx-elx-wiring-harness.Skill Name: Build a wiring harness with crimped connectors
hx-elx-wiring-harness.Prerequisite Names: Specify wiring and protection; Crimp and pin a connector terminal; Choose wire stranding and insulation
hx-elx-wiring-harness.Skill Description: Build a wiring harness with crimped connectors — Draw a pinout and wiring diagram, cut and label wires, crimp and populate connectors, sleeve and tie the bundle, and continuity-test the finished harness.

hx-elx-diff-signaling.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-diff-signaling.Prerequisite Names: Logic levels and noise margins; Shielding and twisted-pair concepts
hx-elx-diff-signaling.Skill Description: Differential signaling and common-mode rejection — Explain how differential pairs reject common-mode noise and ground offsets, and why twisted pairs suit long robot cable runs.

hx-elx-checkpoint-s2.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-elx-checkpoint-s2.Prerequisite Names: Level-shift between logic families; Diagnose I2C bus problems; Choose dead time to prevent shoot-through; High-side drive and bootstrap supply
hx-elx-checkpoint-s2.Skill Description: Electrical & Electronics checkpoint: stage 2 (controlled joint) — Demonstrate the 4 end-of-branch electrical & electronics skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 2 integration milestone.

hx-elx-current-calibrate.Subject: Current and voltage sensing
hx-elx-current-calibrate.Prerequisite Names: Sensor calibration curves; Convert ADC codes with a stated reference; Current-sense amplifiers and Kelvin connections
hx-elx-current-calibrate.Skill Description: Calibrate a current-sense channel — Measure zero offset and gain against a reference meter, convert ADC codes to amperes, and filter the reading to match the control bandwidth.

hx-elx-ground-loops.Subject: Grounding, EMI and signal integrity
hx-elx-ground-loops.Prerequisite Names: Star grounding and separated returns; Shielding and twisted-pair concepts
hx-elx-ground-loops.Skill Description: Identify and break ground loops — Recognize ground loops formed by multiple return paths, predict the induced noise, and break them with single-point grounding or isolation.

hx-elx-ground-plane.Subject: PCB design in KiCad
hx-elx-ground-plane.Skill Name: Ground planes and return paths on a PCB
hx-elx-ground-plane.Prerequisite Names: PCB connectivity and physical layout; Star grounding and separated returns; Inductive noise pickup and loop area
hx-elx-ground-plane.Skill Description: Ground planes and return paths on a PCB — Use solid ground planes, avoid routing signals across plane splits, and keep high-current returns away from sensitive analog references.

hx-elx-power-stage-thermal.Subject: Power switching and motor drive
hx-elx-power-stage-thermal.Skill Name: Junction temperature of a power stage
hx-elx-power-stage-thermal.Prerequisite Codes: MAT-MFP-028, PHY-HEC-003, PHY-HEC-002, PHY-COC-009, PHY-HEC-005, ELX-PSM-005, ELX-PSM-007
hx-elx-power-stage-thermal.Prerequisite Names: Thermal resistance networks; Junction-to-ambient resistance chain from datasheets; Heat spreading through PCB copper and thermal vias; Read heatsink resistance versus airflow curves; Choose a thermal interface material; MOSFET conduction loss at temperature; Estimate MOSFET switching loss
hx-elx-power-stage-thermal.Skill Description: Junction temperature of a power stage — Sum conduction and switching losses and use junction-to-ambient thermal resistance to predict MOSFET or driver temperature and decide on heatsinking.

hx-elx-three-phase-bridge.Subject: Power switching and motor drive
hx-elx-three-phase-bridge.Prerequisite Names: H-bridge motor drive; Three-phase systems; Brushless DC motor operation and commutation
hx-elx-three-phase-bridge.Skill Description: Three-phase inverter bridge — Describe the six-switch three-phase bridge, its eight switching states, and how phase voltages are applied to a brushless motor's windings.

hx-elx-joint-cable-routing.Subject: Wiring, connectors and harnesses
hx-elx-joint-cable-routing.Prerequisite Names: Create an assembly with defined motion; Build a wiring harness with crimped connectors
hx-elx-joint-cable-routing.Skill Description: Route cables through moving joints — Plan service loops, bend radius, clamping and hollow-shaft paths so cables crossing a joint survive its full range of motion without pinching.

hx-elx-transmission-line.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-transmission-line.Prerequisite Names: Convert among wave period, frequency, and wavelength; RC transient response; Differential signaling and common-mode rejection
hx-elx-transmission-line.Skill Description: Transmission lines and termination — Decide when a cable acts as a transmission line from edge rate and length, and calculate reflections for matched and mismatched terminations.

hx-elx-usb-robots.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-usb-robots.Prerequisite Names: Remote Linux administration: SSH, permissions, and services; Differential signaling and common-mode rejection
hx-elx-usb-robots.Skill Description: USB devices in robots — Manage USB power limits, cable length, hubs, persistent device naming and noise-induced disconnects for cameras and serial adapters on a robot computer.

hx-elx-pcb-routing.Subject: PCB design in KiCad
hx-elx-pcb-routing.Prerequisite Names: Place components on a PCB; Size PCB traces for current; Ground planes and return paths on a PCB
hx-elx-pcb-routing.Skill Description: Route a two-layer PCB — Route a two-layer board with appropriate trace widths, clearances, vias and short differential pairs while keeping return paths continuous.

hx-elx-pwm-ripple.Subject: Power switching and motor drive
hx-elx-pwm-ripple.Prerequisite Names: RL transient response; Interpret PWM duty and period; H-bridge motor drive; Model a brushed DC motor with torque and back-EMF constants; Inductor core saturation
hx-elx-pwm-ripple.Skill Description: Motor current ripple from PWM — Calculate peak-to-peak armature current ripple from bus voltage, duty cycle, PWM frequency and winding inductance, and its effect on RMS heating.

hx-elx-svpwm.Subject: Power switching and motor drive
hx-elx-svpwm.Prerequisite Names: Interpret PWM duty and period; Phasors and impedance; Rotating magnetic field from three-phase currents; Three-phase inverter bridge
hx-elx-svpwm.Skill Description: Sinusoidal and space-vector PWM — Compute three-phase duty cycles for sinusoidal and space-vector PWM from a desired voltage vector and compare their bus-voltage utilization.

hx-elx-six-step.Subject: Power switching and motor drive
hx-elx-six-step.Skill Description: Six-step commutation with Hall sensors — Map Hall sensor states to the correct bridge switching pattern for trapezoidal commutation and predict torque ripple and direction reversal.

hx-elx-cable-flex-life.Subject: Wiring, connectors and harnesses
hx-elx-cable-flex-life.Prerequisite Names: Fatigue under repeated loading; Route cables through moving joints
hx-elx-cable-flex-life.Skill Description: Cable flex and torsion life — Estimate and test cable life under repeated bending and torsion at a joint, and choose cable construction and routing to meet a cycle target.

hx-elx-slip-ring.Subject: Wiring, connectors and harnesses
hx-elx-slip-ring.Skill Name: Select a slip ring for continuous rotation
hx-elx-slip-ring.Prerequisite Names: Differential signaling and common-mode rejection; Route cables through moving joints
hx-elx-slip-ring.Skill Description: Select a slip ring for continuous rotation — Specify a slip ring by circuit count, current, voltage, rotational speed and signal noise when a joint must rotate beyond a cable's limit.

hx-elx-can-physical.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-can-physical.Prerequisite Names: Differential signaling and common-mode rejection; Transmission lines and termination
hx-elx-can-physical.Skill Description: CAN physical layer and termination — Explain dominant and recessive states, CAN transceivers, 120-ohm end termination and stub limits, and verify termination by measuring 60 ohms.

hx-elx-rs485.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-rs485.Prerequisite Names: UART electrical levels and framing; Transmission lines and termination
hx-elx-rs485.Skill Description: Wire an RS-485 multidrop bus — Build a half-duplex RS-485 bus with transceivers, termination, fail-safe biasing and driver-enable timing, and verify it with a scope.

hx-elx-checkpoint-s4.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-elx-checkpoint-s4.Skill Description: Electrical & Electronics checkpoint: stage 4 (wheeled base) — Demonstrate the 1 end-of-branch electrical & electronics skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 4 integration milestone.

hx-elx-phase-current-sense.Subject: Current and voltage sensing
hx-elx-phase-current-sense.Skill Name: Three-phase current sensing for motor control
hx-elx-phase-current-sense.Prerequisite Names: Sampling and aliasing; Current-sense amplifiers and Kelvin connections; Sinusoidal and space-vector PWM
hx-elx-phase-current-sense.Skill Description: Three-phase current sensing for motor control — Place shunts or Hall sensors in a three-phase inverter and synchronize ADC sampling to the PWM center to obtain clean phase currents.

hx-elx-pcb-drc.Subject: PCB design in KiCad
hx-elx-pcb-drc.Skill Name: Run DRC against fab design rules
hx-elx-pcb-drc.Skill Description: Run DRC against fab design rules — Load a fabricator's minimum trace, space, drill and annular-ring rules into KiCad and resolve every design rule check violation.

hx-elx-pwm-frequency.Subject: Power switching and motor drive
hx-elx-pwm-frequency.Prerequisite Names: Estimate MOSFET switching loss; Motor current ripple from PWM
hx-elx-pwm-frequency.Skill Description: Choose a motor PWM frequency — Select a PWM frequency that balances current ripple, switching loss, audible whine and controller timing for a given motor and driver.

hx-elx-can-frames.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-can-frames.Skill Name: CAN frames, arbitration and bit timing
hx-elx-can-frames.Prerequisite Names: Error detection with checksums and CRCs; CAN physical layer and termination
hx-elx-can-frames.Skill Description: CAN frames, arbitration and bit timing — Read CAN frame fields, predict which identifier wins arbitration, and set bit timing segments and sample point for a given bit rate.

hx-elx-servo-bus-wiring.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-servo-bus-wiring.Prerequisite Names: Build a wiring harness with crimped connectors; Wire an RS-485 multidrop bus
hx-elx-servo-bus-wiring.Skill Description: Wire a daisy-chained smart-servo bus — Wire half-duplex TTL or RS-485 smart servos in a chain with power injection, ID planning and cable lengths that keep voltage drop and noise acceptable.

hx-elx-pcb-fab-outputs.Subject: PCB design in KiCad
hx-elx-pcb-fab-outputs.Skill Name: Generate fab files and order a PCB
hx-elx-pcb-fab-outputs.Prerequisite Names: Run DRC against fab design rules
hx-elx-pcb-fab-outputs.Skill Description: Generate fab files and order a PCB — Export Gerbers, drill files, BOM and pick-and-place files, preview them in a Gerber viewer, and place a fabrication and assembly order.

hx-elx-hbridge-pwm.Subject: Power switching and motor drive
hx-elx-hbridge-pwm.Skill Name: Drive a brushed motor with an H-bridge and PWM
hx-elx-hbridge-pwm.Prerequisite Names: Use a current-limited bench power supply; Generate PWM with hardware timers; H-bridge drive and decay modes; Choose a motor PWM frequency
hx-elx-hbridge-pwm.Skill Description: Drive a brushed motor with an H-bridge and PWM — Wire an H-bridge between supply, motor and microcontroller, generate direction and PWM signals, and verify speed control and braking on the bench.

hx-elx-can-bus.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-can-bus.Skill Name: Wire and use a CAN bus network
hx-elx-can-bus.Prerequisite Names: UART, SPI, and I²C in firmware; Build a wiring harness with crimped connectors; CAN frames, arbitration and bit timing
hx-elx-can-bus.Skill Description: Wire and use a CAN bus network — Build a terminated CAN network of several nodes, bring it up on a microcontroller or Linux SocketCAN, and send and receive frames reliably.

hx-elx-emi-suppression.Subject: Grounding, EMI and signal integrity
hx-elx-emi-suppression.Skill Name: Suppress EMI from motors and switchers
hx-elx-emi-suppression.Prerequisite Codes: ELX-ACS-007, PHY-EWS-003, ELX-REP-025, PHY-ELI-013, ELX-PSM-015, PHY-EWS-009
hx-elx-emi-suppression.Prerequisite Names: Passive low-pass filters; Shielding physics: reflection, absorption and magnetic shielding; Shielding and twisted-pair concepts; Inductive noise pickup and loop area; Drive a brushed motor with an H-bridge and PWM; Near field versus far field
hx-elx-emi-suppression.Skill Description: Suppress EMI from motors and switchers — Identify noisy edges from PWM, brushes and regulators and apply motor-terminal capacitors, RC snubbers, ferrites and common-mode chokes to tame them.

hx-elx-pcb-basic.Subject: PCB design in KiCad
hx-elx-pcb-basic.Skill Name: Design a simple PCB from schematic to order
hx-elx-pcb-basic.Prerequisite Names: Bring up a new circuit board safely; Generate fab files and order a PCB
hx-elx-pcb-basic.Skill Description: Design a simple PCB from schematic to order — Take a small robot interface board from schematic through layout, DRC and fab outputs to an ordered, assembled and tested board.

hx-elx-motor-driver-ic.Subject: Power switching and motor drive
hx-elx-motor-driver-ic.Skill Name: Select and use an integrated motor driver IC
hx-elx-motor-driver-ic.Prerequisite Names: MOSFET conduction loss at temperature; Drive a brushed motor with an H-bridge and PWM
hx-elx-motor-driver-ic.Skill Description: Select and use an integrated motor driver IC — Choose a motor driver IC by voltage, continuous and peak current, and package, then configure its current limit, sleep, and fault pins.

hx-elx-can-bus-load.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-can-bus-load.Prerequisite Names: Latency, bandwidth, and jitter; Wire and use a CAN bus network
hx-elx-can-bus-load.Skill Description: CAN FD and bus-load budgeting — Estimate CAN bus load and worst-case latency from message rates and frame sizes, and decide when CAN FD or a second bus is needed.

hx-elx-bus-selection.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-bus-selection.Skill Name: Choose a bus for a robot subsystem
hx-elx-bus-selection.Prerequisite Names: Size I2C pull-ups from bus capacitance; Wire SPI for reliable high-speed transfer; Wire an RS-485 multidrop bus; Wire and use a CAN bus network
hx-elx-bus-selection.Skill Description: Choose a bus for a robot subsystem — Select I2C, SPI, UART, RS-485, CAN, USB or Ethernet for a subsystem by bandwidth, determinism, distance, node count and noise environment.

hx-elx-can-diagnose.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-can-diagnose.Prerequisite Names: Probe switching circuits safely and accurately; Wire and use a CAN bus network
hx-elx-can-diagnose.Skill Description: Diagnose CAN bus faults — Locate wrong termination, swapped lines, bit-rate mismatch and bus-off nodes using resistance checks, scope captures and error counters.

hx-elx-cable-shielding.Subject: Grounding, EMI and signal integrity
hx-elx-cable-shielding.Prerequisite Names: Superposing fields of several currents; Shielding physics: reflection, absorption and magnetic shielding; Identify and break ground loops; Suppress EMI from motors and switchers
hx-elx-cable-shielding.Skill Description: Terminate cable shields correctly — Choose shielded or twisted-pair cable and terminate shields at one or both ends with 360-degree clamps according to frequency and ground scheme.

hx-elx-four-layer-pcb.Subject: PCB design in KiCad
hx-elx-four-layer-pcb.Prerequisite Names: Transmission lines and termination; Design a simple PCB from schematic to order
hx-elx-four-layer-pcb.Skill Description: Four-layer stackups and controlled impedance — Choose a four-layer stackup and route controlled-impedance pairs for CAN, USB or Ethernet with continuous reference planes.

hx-elx-power-pcb-layout.Subject: PCB design in KiCad
hx-elx-power-pcb-layout.Skill Name: Lay out a motor-driver power stage
hx-elx-power-pcb-layout.Prerequisite Names: Dielectric strength, breakdown, clearance and creepage; Current-sense amplifiers and Kelvin connections; Junction temperature of a power stage; Drive a brushed motor with an H-bridge and PWM; Design a simple PCB from schematic to order
hx-elx-power-pcb-layout.Skill Description: Lay out a motor-driver power stage — Minimize the hot loop, route Kelvin gate and sense returns, add copper pours and thermal vias, and separate power and logic grounds on a driver board.

hx-elx-driver-faults.Subject: Power switching and motor drive
hx-elx-driver-faults.Prerequisite Names: Use watchdogs and fault states; Select and use an integrated motor driver IC
hx-elx-driver-faults.Skill Description: Handle motor driver fault signals — Interpret overcurrent, thermal shutdown and undervoltage lockout flags from a motor driver and implement a safe latch, report and recovery sequence.

hx-elx-ethercat-overview.Subject: Communication buses: electrical layer
hx-elx-ethercat-overview.Prerequisite Names: Packets, headers, and protocol layers; Timestamps and clock synchronization; CAN FD and bus-load budgeting
hx-elx-ethercat-overview.Skill Description: EtherCAT for multi-axis robots — Explain EtherCAT processing on the fly, daisy-chain topology and distributed clocks, and why humanoids use it for synchronized joint control.

hx-elx-checkpoint-s5.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-elx-checkpoint-s5.Skill Description: Electrical & Electronics checkpoint: stage 5 (mobile manipulator) — Demonstrate the 1 end-of-branch electrical & electronics skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 5 integration milestone.

hx-elx-bldc-driver-bringup.Subject: Current and voltage sensing
hx-elx-bldc-driver-bringup.Skill Name: Bring up a commercial BLDC/FOC driver
hx-elx-bldc-driver-bringup.Prerequisite Names: Six-step commutation with Hall sensors; Three-phase current sensing for motor control; Handle motor driver fault signals
hx-elx-bldc-driver-bringup.Skill Description: Bring up a commercial BLDC/FOC driver — Wire a brushless motor, encoder and supply to an FOC driver board, run motor calibration, tune current limits and confirm fault responses.

hx-elx-humanoid-harness.Subject: Wiring, connectors and harnesses
hx-elx-humanoid-harness.Prerequisite Names: Cable flex and torsion life; Select a slip ring for continuous rotation; Design fused power distribution for many actuators; Choose a bus for a robot subsystem
hx-elx-humanoid-harness.Skill Description: Plan a humanoid wiring architecture — Partition a humanoid's power and data wiring into serviceable segments with joint crossings, connector breaks and bus topology across torso, arms and head.

hx-elx-checkpoint-s3.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-elx-checkpoint-s3.Prerequisite Codes: ELX-CVS-002, ELX-BPS-005, ELX-CBE-012, ELX-GES-005, ELX-CBE-016, ELX-PDK-011, ELX-CVS-007
hx-elx-checkpoint-s3.Prerequisite Names: Hall-effect current sensors; Rework and repair a circuit board; Wire a daisy-chained smart-servo bus; Terminate cable shields correctly; Diagnose CAN bus faults; Lay out a motor-driver power stage; Bring up a commercial BLDC/FOC driver
hx-elx-checkpoint-s3.Skill Description: Electrical & Electronics checkpoint: stage 3 (robot arm) — Demonstrate the 7 end-of-branch electrical & electronics skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 3 integration milestone.

hx-elx-checkpoint-s6.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-elx-checkpoint-s6.Skill Name: Electrical & Electronics checkpoint: stage 6 (humanoid protocol droid)
hx-elx-checkpoint-s6.Prerequisite Names: EtherCAT for multi-axis robots; Plan a humanoid wiring architecture
hx-elx-checkpoint-s6.Skill Description: Electrical & Electronics checkpoint: stage 6 (humanoid protocol droid) — Demonstrate the 2 end-of-branch electrical & electronics skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 6 integration milestone.

hx-pwr-stop-categories.Subject: Safety circuits
hx-pwr-stop-categories.Skill Description: Stop categories and e-stop requirements — Explain stop categories 0, 1 and 2 and what an emergency stop must guarantee about energy removal, latching and manual reset.

hx-pwr-fuse-select.Subject: Power distribution and protection
hx-pwr-fuse-select.Prerequisite Names: Wire gauge, ampacity and voltage drop; Specify wiring and protection
hx-pwr-fuse-select.Skill Description: Select a fuse — Choose fuse current rating, time-current curve, I-squared-t, DC voltage rating and breaking capacity so the wire is protected but normal surges pass.

hx-pwr-safety-relay.Subject: Safety circuits
hx-pwr-safety-relay.Prerequisite Names: Stop categories and e-stop requirements; Inductive switching and recirculation
hx-pwr-safety-relay.Skill Description: Safety relays and dual-channel circuits — Wire a dual-channel e-stop to a safety relay with forced-guided contacts, cross-monitoring and monitored reset, and explain each failure it detects.

hx-pwr-reverse-polarity.Subject: Charging and docking
hx-pwr-reverse-polarity.Prerequisite Names: Diode behavior and limits; Read a power MOSFET datasheet
hx-pwr-reverse-polarity.Skill Description: Reverse-polarity protection — Protect a robot input from reversed battery connection using a series diode or P-MOSFET and compare their voltage drop and dissipation.

hx-pwr-breakers-efuse.Subject: Power distribution and protection
hx-pwr-breakers-efuse.Prerequisite Names: Read a power MOSFET datasheet; Select a fuse
hx-pwr-breakers-efuse.Skill Description: Breakers, PTCs and electronic fuses — Compare DC circuit breakers, resettable PTC fuses and eFuse or hot-swap controllers by trip speed, reset behavior and fault reporting.

hx-pwr-precharge.Subject: Power distribution and protection
hx-pwr-precharge.Prerequisite Names: Compare resistor dissipation with a stated derated power limit; RC transient response; Select a fuse
hx-pwr-precharge.Skill Description: Pre-charge capacitive loads — Size a pre-charge resistor and time to limit inrush into motor-driver bus capacitance, and check resistor pulse energy rating.

hx-pwr-regulator-select.Subject: Power conversion
hx-pwr-regulator-select.Prerequisite Names: Estimate temperature rise with a lumped model; Buck-converter fundamentals; Linear voltage regulation
hx-pwr-regulator-select.Skill Description: Choose linear or switching regulation — Pick an LDO or switching converter from dropout, dissipated heat, noise and efficiency, and check LDO junction temperature for the load.

hx-pwr-converter-efficiency.Subject: Power conversion
hx-pwr-converter-efficiency.Prerequisite Names: Electrical power and dissipation; Efficiency losses appear as heat; Boost-converter fundamentals; Buck-converter fundamentals
hx-pwr-converter-efficiency.Skill Description: Converter efficiency and input current — Use efficiency curves to compute converter input current, battery-side power and heat, including light-load efficiency penalties.

hx-pwr-cell-chemistries.Subject: Battery cells
hx-pwr-cell-chemistries.Prerequisite Names: Battery capacity, energy, and internal resistance; Electrochemical energy and equilibrium
hx-pwr-cell-chemistries.Skill Description: Compare lithium cell chemistries — Compare Li-ion NMC, LiPo, LiFePO4 and NiMH cells on nominal voltage, energy density, power capability, cycle life and abuse tolerance for robots.

hx-pwr-ideal-diode.Subject: Charging and docking
hx-pwr-ideal-diode.Skill Description: Ideal-diode ORing of power sources — Combine battery, charger and external supply inputs with ideal-diode controllers so the robot switches source without back-feeding or brownout.

hx-pwr-fuse-coordination.Subject: Power distribution and protection
hx-pwr-fuse-coordination.Prerequisite Names: Select a fuse; Breakers, PTCs and electronic fuses
hx-pwr-fuse-coordination.Skill Description: Coordinate branch and main fuses — Select branch and main protection so a fault in one actuator branch clears locally before the main fuse or BMS disconnects the robot.

hx-pwr-contactors.Subject: Power distribution and protection
hx-pwr-contactors.Prerequisite Names: Inductive switching and recirculation; Pre-charge capacitive loads
hx-pwr-contactors.Skill Description: DC contactors and relays — Select DC contactors and relays by voltage, current and arc-breaking capability, add coil suppression, and detect welded contacts.

hx-pwr-module-select.Subject: Power conversion
hx-pwr-module-select.Skill Name: Select DC-DC modules for robot rails
hx-pwr-module-select.Prerequisite Names: Converter efficiency and input current; Choose linear or switching regulation
hx-pwr-module-select.Skill Description: Select DC-DC modules for robot rails — Choose buck, boost or buck-boost modules for logic, servo and compute rails by voltage range, current headroom, transient response and EMI.

hx-pwr-regen-energy.Subject: Regeneration and braking
hx-pwr-regen-energy.Skill Name: Regenerative energy and bus voltage rise
hx-pwr-regen-energy.Prerequisite Names: Capacitance and stored energy; Rotational kinetic energy and power; Model a brushed DC motor with torque and back-EMF constants
hx-pwr-regen-energy.Skill Description: Regenerative energy and bus voltage rise — Calculate energy returned by a decelerating joint or wheel and the resulting DC bus voltage rise on a given bus capacitance.

hx-pwr-cell-voltage-curve.Subject: Battery cells
hx-pwr-cell-voltage-curve.Skill Name: Cell voltage versus state of charge
hx-pwr-cell-voltage-curve.Prerequisite Names: Interpreting physical graphs; Compare lithium cell chemistries
hx-pwr-cell-voltage-curve.Skill Description: Cell voltage versus state of charge — Read discharge curves to find a cell's maximum, nominal and cutoff voltages and explain why flat LiFePO4 curves make voltage a poor charge gauge.

hx-pwr-busbars.Subject: Power distribution and protection
hx-pwr-busbars.Prerequisite Names: Bolted joints and preload; Wire gauge, ampacity and voltage drop; Corrosion and galvanic couples
hx-pwr-busbars.Skill Description: Busbars and bolted power connections — Size copper busbars for current and temperature rise, and make bolted electrical joints with correct plating, washers and torque.

hx-pwr-load-transient.Subject: Power conversion
hx-pwr-load-transient.Prerequisite Names: Choose decoupling and bulk capacitance; Select DC-DC modules for robot rails
hx-pwr-load-transient.Skill Description: Load transients and brownouts — Predict rail droop when actuators draw step loads and size bulk capacitance or separate rails so logic and computers do not brown out.

hx-pwr-braking-resistor.Subject: Regeneration and braking
hx-pwr-braking-resistor.Skill Name: Size a braking resistor and chopper
hx-pwr-braking-resistor.Prerequisite Names: Compare resistor dissipation with a stated derated power limit; Regenerative energy and bus voltage rise
hx-pwr-braking-resistor.Skill Description: Size a braking resistor and chopper — Set a brake-chopper threshold and size a braking resistor's resistance, peak power and average power for a regeneration profile.

hx-pwr-cell-datasheet.Subject: Battery cells
hx-pwr-cell-datasheet.Prerequisite Names: Model a battery with stated limits; Cell voltage versus state of charge
hx-pwr-cell-datasheet.Skill Description: Read a battery cell datasheet — Extract rated capacity, continuous and pulse discharge current, charge limits, temperature windows and cycle life conditions from a cell datasheet.

hx-pwr-telemetry.Subject: Power budget and telemetry
hx-pwr-telemetry.Prerequisite Names: Write a ROS 2 publisher and subscriber; Sense a battery or bus voltage with an ADC; Calibrate a current-sense channel
hx-pwr-telemetry.Skill Description: Monitor power with telemetry — Read per-rail voltage, current and energy from monitor ICs, publish them as robot telemetry, and log them for analysis.

hx-pwr-distribution.Subject: Power distribution and protection
hx-pwr-distribution.Skill Name: Design fused power distribution for many actuators
hx-pwr-distribution.Prerequisite Names: DC contactors and relays; Coordinate branch and main fuses; Select DC-DC modules for robot rails; Busbars and bolted power connections
hx-pwr-distribution.Skill Description: Design fused power distribution for many actuators — Lay out a power tree from battery through main disconnect, pre-charge, busbars and fused branches to many actuators with voltage drop checked.

hx-pwr-isolated-supply.Subject: Power conversion
hx-pwr-isolated-supply.Prerequisite Names: Transformers and mutual inductance; Select DC-DC modules for robot rails; Identify and break ground loops
hx-pwr-isolated-supply.Skill Description: Isolated DC-DC supplies — Explain transformer-based isolated converters and decide when isolation is needed for safety, noise or ground-loop breaking in a robot.

hx-pwr-compute-supply.Subject: Power conversion
hx-pwr-compute-supply.Prerequisite Names: Set up a single-board computer running Linux; Load transients and brownouts

hx-pwr-c-rating.Subject: Battery cells
hx-pwr-c-rating.Skill Description: C-rate and discharge current limits — Convert C-rates to amperes for a given capacity and check continuous and burst discharge currents against cell and pack limits.

hx-pwr-usable-energy.Subject: Battery cells
hx-pwr-usable-energy.Prerequisite Names: Battery capacity, energy, and internal resistance; Read a battery cell datasheet
hx-pwr-usable-energy.Skill Description: Usable battery energy — Calculate usable watt-hours from nominal capacity after depth-of-discharge limits, high-rate capacity loss, temperature derating and end-of-life fade.

hx-pwr-bus-capacitance.Subject: Regeneration and braking

hx-pwr-bus-capacitance.Skill Description: Size DC bus capacitance — Size motor-drive bus capacitors for ripple current, voltage hold-up and regenerative energy absorption, including ripple-current rating and lifetime.

hx-pwr-voltage-sag.Subject: Battery cells
hx-pwr-voltage-sag.Prerequisite Names: Battery capacity, energy, and internal resistance; C-rate and discharge current limits
hx-pwr-voltage-sag.Skill Description: Internal resistance and voltage sag — Predict terminal voltage and heat under load from cell internal resistance, and check that sag does not trip regulators or undervoltage cutoffs.

hx-pwr-series-parallel.Subject: Battery packs
hx-pwr-series-parallel.Prerequisite Names: C-rate and discharge current limits; Usable battery energy
hx-pwr-series-parallel.Skill Description: Series and parallel cell configurations — Compute pack voltage, capacity, energy and current capability for an xSyP arrangement and choose cell counts to hit a target bus voltage.

hx-pwr-cccv.Subject: Charging and docking
hx-pwr-cccv.Prerequisite Names: Cell voltage versus state of charge; C-rate and discharge current limits
hx-pwr-cccv.Skill Description: Constant-current constant-voltage charging — Describe CC/CV charging, compute charge time from capacity and current, and choose termination current and chemistry-specific voltage setpoints.

hx-pwr-measure-ir.Subject: Battery cells
hx-pwr-measure-ir.Prerequisite Names: Take and interpret low-voltage circuit measurements; Internal resistance and voltage sag
hx-pwr-measure-ir.Skill Description: Measure cell internal resistance — Measure DC internal resistance with a pulse-load step and compare it with AC impedance meter readings to grade cells.

hx-pwr-bms.Skill Description: Battery management system functions — Explain how a BMS monitors cell voltages, current and temperatures and opens protection FETs on overvoltage, undervoltage, overcurrent, short or overtemperature.

hx-pwr-pack-heat.Subject: Thermal management

hx-pwr-pack-heat.Skill Description: Battery pack heat generation — Estimate pack heat from I-squared-R losses over a duty cycle and predict temperature rise with a lumped thermal model.

hx-pwr-cell-balancing.Subject: Battery management
hx-pwr-cell-balancing.Skill Description: Cell imbalance and balancing — Explain how mismatched cells drift apart, compare passive and active balancing, and compute the time to correct an imbalance at a given balance current.

hx-pwr-soc-estimation.Subject: Battery management
hx-pwr-soc-estimation.Prerequisite Names: Calibrate a current-sense channel; Cell voltage versus state of charge; Battery management system functions
hx-pwr-soc-estimation.Skill Description: Estimate state of charge — Implement coulomb counting with voltage-based rest correction to estimate state of charge and bound its drift.

hx-pwr-smart-battery.Subject: Battery management

hx-pwr-smart-battery.Skill Description: Read smart-battery telemetry — Read cell voltages, current, temperature, state of charge and fault flags from a smart BMS over SMBus, UART or CAN.

hx-pwr-bms-thresholds.Subject: Battery management
hx-pwr-bms-thresholds.Prerequisite Names: Internal resistance and voltage sag; Battery management system functions
hx-pwr-bms-thresholds.Skill Description: Set BMS protection thresholds — Choose overvoltage, undervoltage, overcurrent and temperature thresholds and delays from cell limits and robot peak loads without nuisance trips.

hx-pwr-charger-select.Subject: Charging and docking
hx-pwr-charger-select.Skill Name: Select and configure a battery charger
hx-pwr-charger-select.Prerequisite Names: Constant-current constant-voltage charging; Battery management system functions
hx-pwr-charger-select.Skill Description: Select and configure a battery charger — Match a charger to a pack's chemistry, series count, charge current, balancing needs and cold-temperature charge prohibition.

hx-pwr-estop.Subject: Safety circuits

hx-pwr-estop.Skill Description: Design an emergency stop and safe power-off circuit — Design an e-stop chain that removes actuator power independently of software, latches until reset and leaves logic powered for diagnosis.

hx-pwr-thermal-derating.Subject: Thermal management
hx-pwr-thermal-derating.Prerequisite Names: Temperature sensor interfaces; Read and apply a thermal derating curve; Junction temperature of a power stage; Battery pack heat generation
hx-pwr-thermal-derating.Skill Description: Derate current from measured temperature — Implement firmware that reads pack and driver temperatures and reduces current limits smoothly before hardware thermal protection trips.

hx-pwr-pack-cooling.Subject: Thermal management

hx-pwr-pack-cooling.Prerequisite Codes: MAT-MFP-024, PHY-COC-006, PHY-COC-007, PHY-COC-009, PHY-HEC-005, ELX-PSM-009, PWR-THM-001
hx-pwr-pack-cooling.Prerequisite Names: Convection and radiation concepts; Size ventilation airflow for an enclosure; Fan curve and system impedance operating point; Read heatsink resistance versus airflow curves; Choose a thermal interface material; Junction temperature of a power stage; Battery pack heat generation
hx-pwr-pack-cooling.Skill Description: Thermal design of packs and drivers — Design conduction paths, spacing, airflow and sensor placement to keep cells and motor drivers within temperature limits inside an enclosed robot.

hx-pwr-soc-kalman.Subject: Battery management
hx-pwr-soc-kalman.Prerequisite Names: Linear least-squares fitting; Linear Kalman filter; Measure cell internal resistance; Estimate state of charge
hx-pwr-soc-kalman.Skill Description: Model-based state-of-charge estimation — Fit an equivalent-circuit battery model from pulse tests and fuse current and voltage in a Kalman filter to estimate state of charge.

hx-pwr-enclosure.Subject: Battery packs

hx-pwr-enclosure.Skill Description: Design a battery enclosure and mount — Design a pack enclosure with crush protection, venting path, thermal path and quick-release mounting inside a robot base or torso.

hx-pwr-charge-path.Subject: Charging and docking

hx-pwr-charge-path.Skill Description: Charge while operating — Design the power path that lets a robot charge its pack while running, sharing charger current between load and battery safely.

hx-pwr-regen-to-battery.Subject: Regeneration and braking
hx-pwr-regen-to-battery.Prerequisite Names: Size a braking resistor and chopper; Set BMS protection thresholds
hx-pwr-regen-to-battery.Skill Description: Regenerating into a battery safely — Decide when regenerative current can be absorbed by the pack, and handle a full battery or open BMS with a shunt clamp or braking resistor.

hx-pwr-safe-torque-off.Subject: Safety circuits

hx-pwr-safe-torque-off.Skill Description: Safe torque off at motor drives — Compare safe torque off inside a drive with cutting bus power, including restart time, gravity loads and what the safety function guarantees.

hx-pwr-estop-test.Subject: Safety circuits
hx-pwr-estop-test.Prerequisite Names: Trigger and capture events on an oscilloscope; Design an emergency stop and safe power-off circuit
hx-pwr-estop-test.Skill Description: Verify e-stop response by test — Measure e-stop response and stopping time with a scope, inject single faults, and record results against the stop requirement.

hx-pwr-wireless-estop.Subject: Safety circuits

hx-pwr-wireless-estop.Skill Description: Wireless and heartbeat-based stops — Add a wireless or remote stop that halts the robot on button press or lost heartbeat, and explain its limits versus a hardwired e-stop.

hx-pwr-docking-contacts.Subject: Charging and docking
hx-pwr-docking-contacts.Prerequisite Names: Select connectors for robot wiring; Corrosion and galvanic couples; Charge while operating
hx-pwr-docking-contacts.Skill Description: Design docking charge contacts — Design dock contacts for current rating, alignment tolerance, wear, corrosion and arc avoidance, and keep exposed contacts dead until docking is confirmed.

hx-pwr-checkpoint-s5.Skill Description: Power Systems & Batteries checkpoint: stage 5 (mobile manipulator) — Demonstrate the 3 end-of-branch power systems & batteries skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 5 integration milestone.

hx-pwr-battery-safety.Skill Description: Lithium battery failure and thermal runaway — Explain how overcharge, overdischarge, shorts, puncture and heat trigger thermal runaway, and how cell chemistry changes the severity.

hx-pwr-pack-design.Skill Description: Design a lithium battery pack — Choose chemistry, cell, series-parallel layout and capacity to meet voltage, energy, peak current and mass targets for a robot.

hx-pwr-power-budget.Skill Description: Build a robot power budget and runtime estimate — Sum average and peak loads through converter efficiencies to battery power, and estimate runtime from usable energy with margin.

hx-pwr-peak-power.Prerequisite Names: Select a fuse; Set BMS protection thresholds; Build a robot power budget and runtime estimate
hx-pwr-peak-power.Skill Description: Check simultaneous peak loads — Check worst-case simultaneous actuator peaks against pack current, BMS overcurrent, fuse curves and wiring so the robot never trips during motion.

hx-pwr-low-battery-policy.Subject: Power budget and telemetry
hx-pwr-low-battery-policy.Prerequisite Names: Finite-state machines for robot behaviour; Estimate state of charge; Build a robot power budget and runtime estimate
hx-pwr-low-battery-policy.Skill Description: Low-battery behavior policy — Define state-of-charge thresholds for warning, return to dock and graceful shutdown that account for estimation error and the energy needed to get home.

hx-pwr-checkpoint-s6.Skill Description: Power Systems & Batteries checkpoint: stage 6 (humanoid protocol droid) — Demonstrate the 3 end-of-branch power systems & batteries skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 6 integration milestone.
