hx-ctl-joint-plant-model.Prerequisite Names: Differential equations and initial values; Rotational dynamics about a fixed axis; Equation of motion of a geared drive; Model a brushed DC motor with torque and back-EMF constants
hx-ctl-joint-plant-model.Skill Description: Differential equation model of a motor-driven joint — Write the coupled electrical and mechanical differential equations of a geared motor driving an inertial, damped joint and state the modeling assumptions.

hx-ctl-ekf.Subject: State estimation
hx-ctl-ekf.Skill Description: Extended Kalman filter — Linearize nonlinear process and measurement models with Jacobians at each step to run an extended Kalman filter and recognize its divergence risks.

hx-ctl-kf-tuning.Subject: State estimation
hx-ctl-kf-tuning.Skill Name: Tune and validate a Kalman filter
hx-ctl-kf-tuning.Prerequisite Names: Linear Kalman filter; Detect an inconsistent measurement innovation
hx-ctl-kf-tuning.Skill Description: Tune and validate a Kalman filter — Tune Q and R from data and check filter consistency with innovation statistics such as NIS and NEES on logged runs.

hx-ctl-transfer-function.Subject: Control systems fundamentals
hx-ctl-transfer-function.Prerequisite Names: Analyze a linear control model; Differential equation model of a motor-driven joint
hx-ctl-transfer-function.Skill Description: Transfer functions from differential equations — Derive transfer functions from linear differential equations with Laplace transforms and reduce a motor-joint model to voltage-to-velocity and voltage-to-position forms.

hx-ctl-friction-model.Subject: Feedforward and compensation
hx-ctl-friction-model.Prerequisite Names: Static and kinetic friction; Friction torque in pivots, collars and journals; Differential equation model of a motor-driven joint
hx-ctl-friction-model.Skill Description: Joint friction models — Describe Coulomb, viscous and Stribeck friction and stiction in geared joints and choose a model suitable for compensation or simulation.

hx-ctl-ukf.Subject: State estimation
hx-ctl-ukf.Prerequisite Names: Covariance and correlation; Extended Kalman filter
hx-ctl-ukf.Skill Description: Unscented Kalman filter overview — Explain how sigma points propagate mean and covariance through nonlinear models and decide when a UKF is preferable to an EKF.

hx-ctl-discretize.Subject: Control systems fundamentals
hx-ctl-discretize.Prerequisite Names: Sampling and aliasing; Represent and discretize a linear dynamical model; Transfer functions from differential equations
hx-ctl-discretize.Skill Description: Discretize a continuous controller — Convert a continuous controller to a difference equation using forward Euler, backward Euler, Tustin or zero-order-hold methods and compare their accuracy.

hx-ctl-bode.Subject: Control systems fundamentals
hx-ctl-bode.Prerequisite Names: Polar form and Euler's formula; Decibel gain and frequency plots; Transfer functions from differential equations
hx-ctl-bode.Skill Description: Frequency response and Bode plots — Evaluate a transfer function's gain and phase versus frequency and construct asymptotic Bode plots to read bandwidth, corner frequencies and resonances.

hx-ctl-poles-zeros.Subject: Control systems fundamentals
hx-ctl-poles-zeros.Prerequisite Names: Interpret poles, damping and resonance from a second-order model; Transfer functions from differential equations
hx-ctl-poles-zeros.Skill Description: Poles, zeros and response character — Locate poles and zeros of a transfer function and predict decay rates, oscillation and stability of the response from their positions in the complex plane.

hx-ctl-friction-id.Subject: System identification and calibration
hx-ctl-friction-id.Prerequisite Names: Linear least-squares fitting; Joint friction models
hx-ctl-friction-id.Skill Description: Identify joint friction parameters — Identify Coulomb and viscous friction parameters from constant-velocity torque or current measurements using least-squares fitting.

hx-ctl-state-space.Subject: State-space and optimal control
hx-ctl-state-space.Prerequisite Names: Represent and discretize a linear dynamical model; Transfer functions from differential equations
hx-ctl-state-space.Skill Description: State-space models — Write state, input and output equations for a joint or mobile robot model and convert between state-space and transfer-function forms.

hx-ctl-margins.Subject: Control systems fundamentals
hx-ctl-margins.Prerequisite Names: Feedback block diagram algebra; Frequency response and Bode plots
hx-ctl-margins.Skill Description: Gain and phase margins — Determine crossover frequencies and gain and phase margins from a loop's Bode plot and relate margins to overshoot and robustness.

hx-ctl-second-order-response.Subject: Control systems fundamentals
hx-ctl-second-order-response.Prerequisite Names: Classify underdamped, critically damped, and overdamped motion; Poles, zeros and response character
hx-ctl-second-order-response.Skill Description: Second-order response specifications — Relate damping ratio and natural frequency to overshoot, rise time, peak time and settling time, and translate response specs into pole locations.

hx-ctl-routh.Subject: Control systems fundamentals
hx-ctl-routh.Prerequisite Names: Feedback block diagram algebra; Poles, zeros and response character
hx-ctl-routh.Skill Description: Stability tests and Routh-Hurwitz — Test closed-loop stability from the characteristic polynomial with the Routh-Hurwitz criterion and find the gain range that keeps a loop stable.

hx-ctl-sysid-freq.Subject: System identification and calibration
hx-ctl-sysid-freq.Prerequisite Names: Create logs and replayable tests; Frequency response and Bode plots
hx-ctl-sysid-freq.Skill Description: Measure frequency response with sweeps — Measure a joint's frequency response with chirp or stepped-sine excitation and fit a transfer function to the measured Bode data.

hx-ctl-controllability.Subject: State-space and optimal control
hx-ctl-controllability.Prerequisite Names: Rank and null spaces; State-space models
hx-ctl-controllability.Skill Description: Controllability and observability — Test controllability and observability with rank conditions and explain what an uncontrollable or unobservable mode means for a robot.

hx-ctl-linearize.Subject: State-space and optimal control
hx-ctl-linearize.Prerequisite Names: Jacobian matrices; Linearize the inverted pendulum about upright; Local linear stability; Equations of motion of a cart-pole by Lagrange; State-space models
hx-ctl-linearize.Skill Description: Linearize nonlinear dynamics — Linearize nonlinear robot dynamics such as a pendulum or cart-pole about an equilibrium and judge local stability from the eigenvalues.

hx-ctl-sample-rate.Subject: Control systems fundamentals
hx-ctl-sample-rate.Prerequisite Names: Convert between time delay and phase shift; Evaluate sampling, delay and noise; Discretize a continuous controller; Gain and phase margins
hx-ctl-sample-rate.Skill Description: Sample rate and delay effects — Choose a control loop rate from closed-loop bandwidth and sensors, and predict the phase loss and instability risk caused by sampling, computation delay and jitter.

hx-ctl-pole-placement.Subject: State-space and optimal control
hx-ctl-pole-placement.Prerequisite Names: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors; Design state feedback and an observer; Controllability and observability
hx-ctl-pole-placement.Skill Description: State feedback by pole placement — Design full-state feedback gains that place closed-loop poles at chosen locations and check the resulting actuator effort.

hx-ctl-lqr.Subject: State-space and optimal control
hx-ctl-lqr.Prerequisite Names: Symmetric matrices and quadratic forms; Discretize a continuous controller; State feedback by pole placement
hx-ctl-lqr.Skill Description: Linear quadratic regulator — Design continuous and discrete LQR controllers by choosing state and input weights, solving the Riccati equation numerically and adding integral action for tracking.

hx-ctl-observer.Subject: State-space and optimal control
hx-ctl-observer.Skill Description: Luenberger observer design — Design a state observer whose error dynamics converge faster than the controller and apply the separation principle to combine them.

hx-ctl-lqr-balance.Subject: State-space and optimal control
hx-ctl-lqr-balance.Skill Name: Balance an inverted pendulum with LQR
hx-ctl-lqr-balance.Prerequisite Names: Simulate a robot model in Gazebo or MuJoCo; Equations of motion of a cart-pole by Lagrange; Linear state-space model of a cart-pole; Linearize nonlinear dynamics; Linear quadratic regulator
hx-ctl-lqr-balance.Skill Description: Balance an inverted pendulum with LQR — Stabilize a simulated cart-pole or inverted pendulum with LQR and measure its robustness to push disturbances and model error.

sss-rob-joint-to-tip-rate.Subject: Frames and kinematics foundations
sss-rob-joint-to-tip-rate.Skill Name: Calculate instantaneous planar tip velocity from joint rates
sss-rob-joint-to-tip-rate.Prerequisite Names: Matrix arithmetic; Derive the Cartesian position Jacobian of a planar two-link arm; Relative velocity of two points on a rigid body
sss-rob-joint-to-tip-rate.Skill Description: Calculate instantaneous planar tip velocity from joint rates — Evaluate the position Jacobian at the current configuration and multiply it by the joint-rate vector.

sss-rob-planar-singularity.Subject: Frames and kinematics foundations
sss-rob-planar-singularity.Skill Name: Identify lost instantaneous motion directions at a planar arm singularity
sss-rob-planar-singularity.Prerequisite Names: Calculate instantaneous planar tip velocity from joint rates
sss-rob-planar-singularity.Skill Description: Identify lost instantaneous motion directions at a planar arm singularity — For the two-link position task, the Jacobian determinant is L1*L2*sin(q2).

hx-ctl-rot-elementary.Subject: 3D rotations and transforms
hx-ctl-rot-elementary.Skill Name: Elementary rotations about x, y and z
hx-ctl-rot-elementary.Prerequisite Names: Unit-circle trigonometry; Construct and check rotation matrices; Rotations as Linear Transformations
hx-ctl-rot-elementary.Skill Description: Elementary rotations about x, y and z — Write the three elementary rotation matrices from an angle and apply them to rotate vectors, checking signs with the right-hand rule.

rob3:K07.Subject: Robot geometry and kinematics
rob3:K07.Skill Name: Calculate and test a planar Jacobian
rob3:K07.Prerequisite Names: Compute sampled rates and accumulated changes; Solve planar two-link forward kinematics; Partial derivatives; Differentiate trigonometric rotation expressions; Identify lost instantaneous motion directions at a planar arm singularity
rob3:K07.Skill Description: Calculate and test a planar Jacobian — Calculate and test a planar Jacobian

hx-ctl-complementary-filter.Subject: State estimation
hx-ctl-complementary-filter.Prerequisite Names: Passive high-pass filters; Passive low-pass filters; What an accelerometer measures; Estimate orientation from inertial data
hx-ctl-complementary-filter.Skill Description: Complementary filter design — Fuse a gyroscope with an accelerometer tilt estimate using a complementary filter and choose its crossover frequency from sensor noise and drift.

hx-ctl-axis-angle.Subject: 3D rotations and transforms
hx-ctl-axis-angle.Prerequisite Names: Dot products and projection; Skew-symmetric matrix of a vector; Elementary rotations about x, y and z
hx-ctl-axis-angle.Skill Description: Axis-angle rotation and Rodrigues' formula — Construct a rotation matrix from a unit axis and angle using Rodrigues' formula and interpret any rotation as a single turn about one axis.

hx-ctl-rot-fixed-vs-moving.Subject: 3D rotations and transforms
hx-ctl-rot-fixed-vs-moving.Prerequisite Names: Compose a chain of labeled rigid transforms in the correct order; Elementary rotations about x, y and z
hx-ctl-rot-fixed-vs-moving.Skill Description: Fixed-axis versus moving-axis rotation composition — Decide whether successive rotations are about fixed world axes or current body axes and premultiply or postmultiply accordingly to get the correct total rotation.

hx-ctl-checkpoint-s4.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s4.Skill Name: Kinematics, Dynamics & Control checkpoint: stage 4 (wheeled base)
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s4.Prerequisite Names: Tune and validate a Kalman filter; Unscented Kalman filter overview; Complementary filter design
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s4.Skill Description: Kinematics, Dynamics & Control checkpoint: stage 4 (wheeled base) — Demonstrate the 3 end-of-branch kinematics, dynamics & control skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 4 integration milestone.

hx-ctl-dh-assign.Subject: Forward kinematics
hx-ctl-dh-assign.Prerequisite Names: Specify joint order, zero references, signs, and units for a configuration; Apply, compose and invert rigid transforms; Elementary rotations about x, y and z
hx-ctl-dh-assign.Skill Description: Assign Denavit-Hartenberg frames — Place link frames on a serial arm following the classic Denavit-Hartenberg rules, including parallel and intersecting joint axes, and fill in the parameter table.

hx-ctl-inertia-tensor.Subject: Rigid-body dynamics
hx-ctl-inertia-tensor.Prerequisite Names: Mass moment of inertia; Parallel-axis theorem; Products of inertia; Moment of inertia about an arbitrary axis; Elementary rotations about x, y and z
hx-ctl-inertia-tensor.Skill Description: Rigid-body inertia tensor — Compute and rotate a 3D inertia tensor, apply the parallel-axis theorem in 3D, and read principal axes and moments from CAD data.

rob3:K08.Subject: Robot geometry and kinematics
rob3:K08.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-GET-011, KDC-RGK-002, EMB-SEI-003, KDC-RGK-004, KDC-RGK-008, KDC-RGK-009, KDC-RGK-010
rob3:K08.Prerequisite Names: Unit-circle trigonometry; Distinguish configuration, workspace and constraints; Write a small numerical robotics program; Apply, compose and invert rigid transforms; Solve planar two-link forward kinematics; Solve and verify planar inverse kinematics; Calculate and test a planar Jacobian
rob3:K08.Skill Description: Implement general serial-arm forward kinematics — Implement general serial-arm forward kinematics

hx-ctl-angular-velocity-3d.Subject: 3D rotations and transforms
hx-ctl-angular-velocity-3d.Prerequisite Names: Skew-symmetric matrix of a vector; Differentiate trigonometric rotation expressions; Fixed-axis versus moving-axis rotation composition
hx-ctl-angular-velocity-3d.Skill Description: Angular velocity and rotation rates — Relate the time derivative of a rotation matrix to the angular velocity vector and distinguish spatial-frame from body-frame angular velocity.

hx-ctl-euler-angles.Subject: 3D rotations and transforms
hx-ctl-euler-angles.Skill Description: Euler and roll-pitch-yaw angle conventions — Convert between a stated Euler convention such as ZYX roll-pitch-yaw or ZYZ and the equivalent rotation matrix without mixing intrinsic and extrinsic orders.

hx-ctl-rot-log.Subject: 3D rotations and transforms
hx-ctl-rot-log.Prerequisite Names: Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Axis-angle rotation and Rodrigues' formula
hx-ctl-rot-log.Skill Description: Rotation matrix logarithm — Recover the axis and angle of a rotation matrix, handling the numerically delicate cases near zero and near half-turn rotations, and express orientation error as a rotation vector.

hx-ctl-quat-convert.Subject: 3D rotations and transforms
hx-ctl-quat-convert.Prerequisite Names: Complex-number arithmetic; Axis-angle rotation and Rodrigues' formula; Fixed-axis versus moving-axis rotation composition
hx-ctl-quat-convert.Skill Description: Unit quaternions and conversions — Represent rotations as unit quaternions, compose them, rotate vectors and convert to and from rotation matrices and axis-angle, handling the double-cover sign and storage-order conventions.

hx-ctl-dh-transform.Subject: Forward kinematics
hx-ctl-dh-transform.Skill Name: Link transform from a DH row
hx-ctl-dh-transform.Skill Description: Link transform from a DH row — Compute the homogeneous transform between consecutive links from a row of theta, d, a and alpha values and chain them in order.

hx-ctl-lagrange-arm.Subject: Rigid-body dynamics
hx-ctl-lagrange-arm.Skill Name: Lagrangian dynamics of a two-link arm
hx-ctl-lagrange-arm.Prerequisite Names: Derive the Cartesian position Jacobian of a planar two-link arm; Lagrangian mechanics; Equations of motion of a double pendulum; Generalized forces from applied forces and torques; Rigid-body inertia tensor
hx-ctl-lagrange-arm.Skill Description: Lagrangian dynamics of a two-link arm — Derive the equations of motion of a planar two-link arm from kinetic and potential energy with the Euler-Lagrange equations.

rob3:K10.Subject: Robot geometry and kinematics
rob3:K10.Prerequisite Codes: KDC-RGK-008, KDC-RGK-007, KDC-RGK-009, MTH-MUC-008, MTH-MAT-010, KDC-RGK-010, KDC-RGK-011
rob3:K10.Prerequisite Names: Solve planar two-link forward kinematics; Represent spatial motion and force; Solve and verify planar inverse kinematics; Jacobian matrices; Differentiate trigonometric rotation expressions; Calculate and test a planar Jacobian; Implement general serial-arm forward kinematics
rob3:K10.Skill Description: Compute a spatial Jacobian — Compute a spatial Jacobian

hx-ctl-euler-extract.Subject: 3D rotations and transforms
hx-ctl-euler-extract.Skill Name: Extract Euler angles and detect gimbal lock
hx-ctl-euler-extract.Prerequisite Names: Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Euler and roll-pitch-yaw angle conventions
hx-ctl-euler-extract.Skill Description: Extract Euler angles and detect gimbal lock — Recover Euler angles from a rotation matrix with atan2, choose a branch consistently and detect and handle the gimbal-lock configuration where angles become coupled.

hx-ctl-quat-slerp.Subject: 3D rotations and transforms
hx-ctl-quat-slerp.Skill Description: Interpolate orientations with slerp — Interpolate smoothly between two orientations using spherical linear interpolation, choosing the shorter path and comparing the result with naive matrix or Euler interpolation.

hx-ctl-fk-serial.Subject: Forward kinematics
hx-ctl-fk-serial.Skill Name: Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-ctl-fk-serial.Prerequisite Names: Array computing with NumPy; Implement general serial-arm forward kinematics; Link transform from a DH row
hx-ctl-fk-serial.Skill Description: Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms — Compute the full end-effector pose of a six-joint spatial arm by chaining link transforms in code and verify the result at known configurations.

hx-ctl-cspace.Subject: Motion planning
hx-ctl-cspace.Prerequisite Names: Distinguish configuration, workspace and constraints; Represent collision geometry and clearance
hx-ctl-cspace.Skill Description: Configuration space and C-obstacles — Represent arm configurations as points in configuration space and explain how workspace obstacles map to complex C-space obstacle regions.

hx-ctl-newton-euler-body.Subject: Rigid-body dynamics
hx-ctl-newton-euler-body.Skill Name: Newton-Euler equations of a single rigid body
hx-ctl-newton-euler-body.Prerequisite Codes: PHY-ROO-010, PHY-MIN-010, PHY-ROD-009, PHY-ROD-010, PHY-ROD-013, KDC-RBD-001, KDC-3RT-005
hx-ctl-newton-euler-body.Prerequisite Names: Angular momentum conservation; Principal moments and axes of inertia; Gyroscopic precession and gyroscopic torque; Time derivative of a vector in a rotating frame; Free-body diagrams for linked rigid bodies; Rigid-body inertia tensor; Angular velocity and rotation rates
hx-ctl-newton-euler-body.Skill Description: Newton-Euler equations of a single rigid body — Write the translational and rotational equations of motion of one rigid body in a body frame, including the gyroscopic term from angular velocity.

rob3:K11.Subject: Robot geometry and kinematics
rob3:K11.Prerequisite Codes: KDC-RGK-008, KDC-RGK-006, MTH-CAL-014, MTH-LIA-025, KDC-RGK-009, KDC-RGK-010, KDC-RGK-012
rob3:K11.Prerequisite Names: Solve planar two-link forward kinematics; Measure orientation error for numerical pose solving; Newton's method for roots; Pseudoinverses; Solve and verify planar inverse kinematics; Calculate and test a planar Jacobian; Compute a spatial Jacobian
rob3:K11.Skill Description: Solve numerical inverse kinematics — Solve numerical inverse kinematics

hx-ctl-twist.Subject: Screw theory
hx-ctl-twist.Prerequisite Names: Represent spatial motion and force; Angular velocity and rotation rates
hx-ctl-twist.Skill Description: Twists as spatial velocities — Represent rigid-body velocity as a six-component twist of angular and linear velocity and convert between body and spatial twist forms.

hx-ctl-humanoid-tree.Subject: Forward kinematics
hx-ctl-humanoid-tree.Skill Name: Kinematic tree of a humanoid upper body
hx-ctl-humanoid-tree.Prerequisite Names: Write a URDF robot description; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-ctl-humanoid-tree.Skill Description: Kinematic tree of a humanoid upper body — Model a humanoid torso with two arms and a head as a branched kinematic tree and compute forward kinematics for each chain from a shared torso frame.

hx-ctl-workspace.Subject: Forward kinematics
hx-ctl-workspace.Prerequisite Names: Check the geometric position reach of an unrestricted planar two-link arm; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-ctl-workspace.Skill Description: Reachable and dexterous workspace mapping — Map an arm's reachable and dexterous workspace by sampling forward kinematics within joint limits and judge whether target task locations are reachable with margin.

hx-ctl-spherical-wrist.Subject: Forward kinematics
hx-ctl-spherical-wrist.Skill Name: Spherical wrist geometry and wrist center
hx-ctl-spherical-wrist.Prerequisite Names: Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-ctl-spherical-wrist.Skill Description: Spherical wrist geometry and wrist center — Identify a spherical wrist whose three axes intersect, locate the wrist center from the tool pose, and explain why it decouples position from orientation.

hx-ctl-fk-urdf-check.Subject: Forward kinematics
hx-ctl-fk-urdf-check.Skill Name: Verify forward kinematics against a URDF model
hx-ctl-fk-urdf-check.Prerequisite Names: Write a URDF robot description; Broadcast and look up transforms with tf2; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-ctl-fk-urdf-check.Skill Description: Verify forward kinematics against a URDF model — Load the arm's URDF and compare hand-computed forward kinematics with tf2 or a kinematics library, resolving frame, offset and sign mismatches.

hx-ctl-collision-check.Subject: Motion planning
hx-ctl-collision-check.Prerequisite Names: Configuration space and C-obstacles; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-ctl-collision-check.Skill Description: Collision checking for an arm — Check robot configurations and motion segments for self and environment collisions with geometric libraries, distance queries and edge discretization.

hx-ctl-adjoint.Subject: Screw theory
hx-ctl-adjoint.Skill Name: Adjoint map for changing twist frames
hx-ctl-adjoint.Prerequisite Names: Apply, compose and invert rigid transforms; Twists as spatial velocities
hx-ctl-adjoint.Skill Description: Adjoint map for changing twist frames — Build the 6x6 adjoint matrix of a homogeneous transform and use it to express a twist or screw axis in a different frame.

hx-ctl-se3-exp.Subject: Screw theory
hx-ctl-se3-exp.Prerequisite Names: Matrix exponentials; Rotation matrix logarithm; Twists as spatial velocities
hx-ctl-se3-exp.Skill Description: Exponential coordinates of rigid motion — Write the screw axis of a revolute or prismatic joint and compute the rigid motion along it with the SE(3) matrix exponential, recovering screw coordinates with the logarithm.

hx-ctl-joint-zero-cal.Subject: System identification and calibration
hx-ctl-joint-zero-cal.Prerequisite Names: Incremental and absolute encoders; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-ctl-joint-zero-cal.Skill Description: Calibrate joint zero offsets — Calibrate joint zero positions with fixtures, reference poses or absolute encoders and record offsets reproducibly in configuration.

hx-ctl-jacobian.Subject: Velocity kinematics and Jacobians
hx-ctl-jacobian.Prerequisite Names: Angular velocity and rotation rates; Compute a spatial Jacobian; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-ctl-jacobian.Skill Description: Manipulator Jacobian — Compute the geometric Jacobian of a spatial serial arm column by column from joint axes and positions and use it to map joint velocities to end-effector twist.

hx-ctl-poe-fk.Subject: Forward kinematics
hx-ctl-poe-fk.Prerequisite Names: Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms; Adjoint map for changing twist frames; Exponential coordinates of rigid motion
hx-ctl-poe-fk.Skill Description: Product-of-exponentials forward kinematics — Compute forward kinematics from screw axes and a home configuration with the space-frame and body-frame product-of-exponentials formulas and compare with the DH result.

hx-ctl-ik-wrist-decouple.Subject: Inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-ik-wrist-decouple.Skill Name: Decouple position and orientation IK at the wrist
hx-ctl-ik-wrist-decouple.Prerequisite Names: Verify an inverse-kinematic candidate by forward substitution and joint limits; Spherical wrist geometry and wrist center; Reachable and dexterous workspace mapping
hx-ctl-ik-wrist-decouple.Skill Description: Decouple position and orientation IK at the wrist — Split inverse kinematics of a spherical-wrist arm into a wrist-center position problem and a wrist orientation problem.

hx-ctl-ik-newton-se3.Subject: Inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-ik-newton-se3.Skill Name: Newton IK for full pose using matrix logarithm error
hx-ctl-ik-newton-se3.Prerequisite Names: Solve numerical inverse kinematics; Manipulator Jacobian; Exponential coordinates of rigid motion
hx-ctl-ik-newton-se3.Skill Description: Newton IK for full pose using matrix logarithm error — Iterate Newton steps on a six-dimensional pose error from the SE(3) logarithm and the body Jacobian until position and orientation tolerances are met.

hx-ctl-prm.Subject: Motion planning
hx-ctl-prm.Prerequisite Names: Graphs in code: representation and traversal; Collision checking for an arm
hx-ctl-prm.Skill Description: Probabilistic roadmaps — Build a probabilistic roadmap for repeated planning queries in a static scene and search it with a graph algorithm.

hx-ctl-rrt.Subject: Motion planning
hx-ctl-rrt.Prerequisite Names: Trees and binary search trees; Collision checking for an arm
hx-ctl-rrt.Skill Description: Rapidly-exploring random trees — Implement an RRT planner that samples configurations, extends toward them and returns a collision-free path between two arm configurations.

hx-ctl-mass-matrix.Subject: Rigid-body dynamics
hx-ctl-mass-matrix.Prerequisite Names: Symmetric matrices and quadratic forms; Lagrangian dynamics of a two-link arm; Manipulator Jacobian
hx-ctl-mass-matrix.Skill Description: Manipulator mass matrix — Assemble the joint-space mass matrix from link Jacobians and inertias and use its symmetry and positive definiteness to check a model.

hx-ctl-wrench.Subject: Screw theory
hx-ctl-wrench.Prerequisite Names: Torque and lever arms; Reduce a 3D force system to a force and couple; Adjoint map for changing twist frames
hx-ctl-wrench.Skill Description: Wrenches and their frame transformation — Represent a force and moment pair as a wrench and transform it between frames with the transpose of the adjoint, preserving power with twists.

hx-ctl-kin-calibration.Subject: System identification and calibration
hx-ctl-kin-calibration.Prerequisite Names: Solve a small nonlinear least-squares problem; Identify robot calibration parameters; Calibrate joint zero offsets
hx-ctl-kin-calibration.Skill Description: Kinematic calibration of arm geometry — Identify link-length, offset and joint-zero errors from externally measured end-effector poses with nonlinear least squares and validate on held-out poses.

hx-ctl-mpc.Subject: State-space and optimal control
hx-ctl-mpc.Prerequisite Names: Quadratic programs for control; Linear quadratic regulator; Apply model-predictive control
hx-ctl-mpc.Skill Description: Model predictive control — Formulate linear MPC as a receding-horizon quadratic program with state and input constraints and implement it in a control loop.

hx-ctl-jac-analytic.Subject: Velocity kinematics and Jacobians
hx-ctl-jac-analytic.Prerequisite Names: Euler and roll-pitch-yaw angle conventions; Manipulator Jacobian
hx-ctl-jac-analytic.Skill Description: Analytic versus geometric Jacobian — Relate the analytic Jacobian of a minimal pose representation to the geometric Jacobian through the Euler-rate mapping and explain the representation singularities it introduces.

hx-ctl-jac-dot.Subject: Velocity kinematics and Jacobians
hx-ctl-jac-dot.Skill Description: Jacobian derivative and acceleration kinematics — Compute the Jacobian time derivative and the bias acceleration term to relate joint accelerations to end-effector accelerations.

hx-ctl-resolved-rate.Subject: Velocity kinematics and Jacobians
hx-ctl-resolved-rate.Skill Description: Resolved-rate Cartesian velocity control — Command end-effector velocities by inverting or pseudo-inverting the Jacobian each control cycle, with velocity limits and drift correction from pose error.

hx-ctl-jac-singularity.Subject: Velocity kinematics and Jacobians
hx-ctl-jac-singularity.Skill Description: Singularities of a spatial arm — Locate wrist, elbow and shoulder singularities of a six-joint arm from the Jacobian determinant or singular values and describe the lost motion directions.

hx-ctl-jac-fd-check.Subject: Velocity kinematics and Jacobians
hx-ctl-jac-fd-check.Skill Name: Verify a Jacobian by finite differences
hx-ctl-jac-fd-check.Skill Description: Verify a Jacobian by finite differences — Check an analytic Jacobian numerically with finite differences of forward kinematics, including orientation columns, and diagnose step-size and frame errors.

hx-ctl-task-jacobians.Subject: Whole-body control
hx-ctl-task-jacobians.Prerequisite Names: Kinematic tree of a humanoid upper body; Manipulator Jacobian
hx-ctl-task-jacobians.Skill Description: Task definitions and task Jacobians — Define end-effector, gaze, posture and center-of-mass tasks for a humanoid with task errors and Jacobians over all joints.

hx-ctl-ik-position-3r.Subject: Inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-ik-position-3r.Skill Name: Analytic position IK for an anthropomorphic arm
hx-ctl-ik-position-3r.Prerequisite Names: Calculate both regular inverse-kinematic branches of a planar two-link arm; Decouple position and orientation IK at the wrist
hx-ctl-ik-position-3r.Skill Description: Analytic position IK for an anthropomorphic arm — Solve the first three joint angles that place the wrist center, enumerating shoulder-left/right and elbow-up/down branches with atan2.

hx-ctl-ik-dls.Subject: Inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-ik-dls.Prerequisite Names: Newton IK for full pose using matrix logarithm error; Singularities of a spatial arm
hx-ctl-ik-dls.Skill Description: Damped least-squares IK — Stabilize numerical IK near singularities with damped least squares, choosing or scheduling the damping factor to trade tracking accuracy for bounded joint steps.

hx-ctl-ft-sensing.Subject: Model-based and interaction control
hx-ctl-ft-sensing.Prerequisite Names: Calibrate a scalar sensor; Wrenches and their frame transformation
hx-ctl-ft-sensing.Skill Description: Use a force-torque sensor — Read a wrist force-torque sensor, remove bias and tool gravity, and transform measured wrenches to the contact frame.

hx-ctl-rrt-star.Subject: Motion planning
hx-ctl-rrt-star.Skill Description: RRT-Connect and RRT* — Use bidirectional RRT-Connect for fast queries and RRT* for asymptotically shorter paths, and compare success rate, time and path cost.

hx-ctl-coriolis.Subject: Rigid-body dynamics
hx-ctl-coriolis.Skill Description: Coriolis and centrifugal terms — Compute Coriolis and centrifugal torques with Christoffel symbols and verify the skew-symmetry property used in robot control stability proofs.

hx-ctl-manipulability.Subject: Velocity kinematics and Jacobians
hx-ctl-manipulability.Prerequisite Names: Singular value decomposition; Singularities of a spatial arm
hx-ctl-manipulability.Skill Description: Manipulability ellipsoid and conditioning — Compute manipulability, condition number and velocity or force ellipsoids from the Jacobian SVD and use them to choose well-conditioned arm postures.

hx-ctl-jac-nullspace.Subject: Velocity kinematics and Jacobians
hx-ctl-jac-nullspace.Prerequisite Names: Rank and null spaces; Resolved-rate Cartesian velocity control
hx-ctl-jac-nullspace.Skill Description: Redundancy and null-space projection — Use the null-space projector of a redundant arm's Jacobian to pursue a secondary objective without disturbing the primary end-effector task.

hx-ctl-jac-statics.Subject: Velocity kinematics and Jacobians
hx-ctl-jac-statics.Skill Name: Static force mapping through the Jacobian transpose
hx-ctl-jac-statics.Prerequisite Names: Principle of virtual work for mechanism statics; Moment of a force about a specified axis; Manipulator Jacobian; Wrenches and their frame transformation
hx-ctl-jac-statics.Skill Description: Static force mapping through the Jacobian transpose — Compute the joint torques that balance an end-effector wrench with the Jacobian transpose and use it to size or check actuator loads.

hx-ctl-com-control.Subject: Whole-body control
hx-ctl-com-control.Skill Name: Center-of-mass control on a wheeled humanoid
hx-ctl-com-control.Prerequisite Names: Static stability and the support polygon; Balancing by accelerating the support; Task definitions and task Jacobians
hx-ctl-com-control.Skill Description: Center-of-mass control on a wheeled humanoid — Keep a wheeled humanoid's center of mass projection inside its support polygon while reaching, using a CoM Jacobian task.

hx-ctl-ik-wrist-orient.Subject: Inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-ik-wrist-orient.Prerequisite Names: Extract Euler angles and detect gimbal lock; Analytic position IK for an anthropomorphic arm
hx-ctl-ik-wrist-orient.Skill Description: Analytic wrist orientation IK — Compute the remaining wrist rotation from the first three joints and extract the last three joint angles, including the flip solution and wrist singularity.

hx-ctl-ik-joint-limits.Subject: Inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-ik-joint-limits.Skill Description: Joint limits in numerical IK — Keep numerical IK solutions inside joint position limits using clamping, limit-avoidance weighting or bounded optimization, and detect unreachable targets gracefully.

hx-ctl-task-priority.Subject: Whole-body control
hx-ctl-task-priority.Skill Name: Strict task priority via null-space projection
hx-ctl-task-priority.Prerequisite Names: Task definitions and task Jacobians; Redundancy and null-space projection
hx-ctl-task-priority.Skill Description: Strict task priority via null-space projection — Execute a primary task exactly and lower-priority tasks only within its null space using recursive projection, handling algorithmic singularities.

hx-ctl-ik-numeric.Subject: Inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-ik-numeric.Prerequisite Names: Joint limits in numerical IK; Analytic wrist orientation IK
hx-ctl-ik-numeric.Skill Description: Numerical inverse kinematics — Build a robust numerical IK solver with seeding, multiple restarts, convergence and limit checks that returns verified joint solutions for a six- or seven-joint arm.

hx-ctl-qp-ik.Subject: Whole-body control
hx-ctl-qp-ik.Prerequisite Names: Quadratic programs for control; Joint limits in numerical IK; Strict task priority via null-space projection
hx-ctl-qp-ik.Skill Description: QP-based differential inverse kinematics — Solve weighted multi-task differential IK as a QP with joint position, velocity and collision-distance inequality constraints each control cycle.

hx-ctl-ik-redundant.Subject: Inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-ik-redundant.Prerequisite Names: Redundancy and null-space projection; Numerical inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-ik-redundant.Skill Description: Redundant-arm IK with elbow control — Solve IK for a seven-joint arm while using the spare degree of freedom to control elbow angle or avoid limits through a null-space objective.

hx-ctl-motion-planning.Subject: Motion planning
hx-ctl-motion-planning.Prerequisite Names: Path and time-scaling separation; Rapidly-exploring random trees; Numerical inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-motion-planning.Skill Description: Collision-free arm motion planning — Plan, shortcut, smooth, time-parameterize and validate collision-free arm motions from a start configuration to an IK-derived goal in a cluttered scene.

hx-ctl-traj-cartesian.Subject: Trajectory generation
hx-ctl-traj-cartesian.Prerequisite Names: Path and time-scaling separation; Interpolate orientations with slerp; Numerical inverse kinematics
hx-ctl-traj-cartesian.Skill Description: Cartesian straight-line paths — Generate a straight-line tool path with slerped orientation, time-scale it, and convert it to joint trajectories with IK while checking for singularities.

hx-ctl-moveit-setup.Subject: Motion planning
hx-ctl-moveit-setup.Prerequisite Names: Write a URDF robot description; Execute trajectories with ros2_control; Collision-free arm motion planning
hx-ctl-moveit-setup.Skill Description: Configure and plan with MoveIt 2 — Generate a MoveIt 2 configuration from URDF and SRDF, then plan and execute motions using the planning scene, collision objects and pose constraints.

hx-ctl-traj-optimization.Subject: Motion planning
hx-ctl-traj-optimization.Prerequisite Names: Gradients and directional derivatives; Quadratic programs for control; Collision-free arm motion planning
hx-ctl-traj-optimization.Skill Description: Trajectory optimization for arms — Formulate arm motion as an optimization with smoothness, collision-distance and limit terms in the style of CHOMP or TrajOpt and solve it iteratively.

hx-ctl-dual-arm-planning.Subject: Motion planning
hx-ctl-dual-arm-planning.Skill Name: Plan for a dual-arm humanoid upper body
hx-ctl-dual-arm-planning.Prerequisite Names: Kinematic tree of a humanoid upper body; Configure and plan with MoveIt 2
hx-ctl-dual-arm-planning.Skill Description: Plan for a dual-arm humanoid upper body — Plan coordinated or independent motions for two arms, torso and head with self-collision avoidance in a shared humanoid planning scene.

rob3:C02.Subject: Control and trajectories
rob3:C02.Prerequisite Names: Implement bounded fault response; Evaluate sampled feedback and error sign; Match a motor to its driver
rob3:C02.Skill Description: Implement bounded proportional control — Implement bounded proportional control

rob3:C03.Subject: Control and trajectories
rob3:C03.Prerequisite Names: Compute sampled rates and accumulated changes; Create logs and replayable tests; Implement bounded proportional control
rob3:C03.Skill Description: Implement practical PID behavior — Implement practical PID behavior

rob3:C04.Subject: Control and trajectories
rob3:C04.Prerequisite Names: Create logs and replayable tests; Implement bounded proportional control
rob3:C04.Skill Description: Measure tracking and transient performance — Measure tracking and transient performance

hx-ctl-prop-control.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-prop-control.Prerequisite Names: Second-order response specifications; Implement bounded proportional control
hx-ctl-prop-control.Skill Description: Proportional joint position control — Tune the proportional gain of a joint position loop and predict its stiffness, response speed and steady-state error under gravity load.

hx-ctl-sysid-step.Subject: System identification and calibration
hx-ctl-sysid-step.Skill Name: Identify a plant model from step data
hx-ctl-sysid-step.Prerequisite Names: Second-order response specifications; Logarithmic decrement; Identify a simple actuator model
hx-ctl-sysid-step.Skill Description: Identify a plant model from step data — Fit first- and second-order plant parameters such as gain, time constant and damping to logged step responses of a joint.

rob3:C06.Subject: Control and trajectories
rob3:C06.Prerequisite Names: Generate bounded joint trajectories; Identify a simple actuator model; Implement practical PID behavior
rob3:C06.Skill Description: Add model-based feedforward — Add model-based feedforward

rob3:C10.Subject: Control and trajectories
rob3:C10.Prerequisite Names: Generate bounded joint trajectories; Define robot messages and coordinate conventions; Measure execution budgets and concurrency; Implement practical PID behavior; Measure tracking and transient performance
rob3:C10.Skill Description: Coordinate multiple joint controllers — Coordinate multiple joint controllers

hx-ctl-pd-control.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-pd-control.Prerequisite Names: Damping ratio and natural frequency from m, c and k; Proportional joint position control
hx-ctl-pd-control.Skill Description: Derivative action and damping — Add derivative action to a joint position loop, interpret PD control as a virtual spring and damper, and tune it for a target damping ratio.

hx-ctl-d-filter.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-d-filter.Prerequisite Names: Passive low-pass filters; Discretize a continuous controller; Derivative action and damping
hx-ctl-d-filter.Skill Description: Derivative filtering and derivative-on-measurement — Low-pass filter the derivative term and differentiate the measurement instead of the error to avoid noise amplification and setpoint kick.

hx-ctl-i-action.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-i-action.Skill Name: Integral action for zero steady-state error
hx-ctl-i-action.Prerequisite Names: Feedback block diagram algebra; Derivative action and damping
hx-ctl-i-action.Skill Description: Integral action for zero steady-state error — Add integral action to remove steady-state error from constant loads, justify it with the final value theorem, and explain the phase lag and overshoot it introduces.

hx-ctl-force-control.Subject: Model-based and interaction control
hx-ctl-force-control.Prerequisite Names: Use a force-torque sensor; Integral action for zero steady-state error
hx-ctl-force-control.Skill Description: Explicit force control — Regulate contact force with feedback on measured force error and explain why stiff environments and sensor delay threaten stability.

hx-ctl-velocity-estimate.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-velocity-estimate.Skill Name: Estimate joint velocity from encoder counts
hx-ctl-velocity-estimate.Prerequisite Names: Read a quadrature encoder in firmware; Derivative filtering and derivative-on-measurement
hx-ctl-velocity-estimate.Skill Description: Estimate joint velocity from encoder counts — Estimate joint velocity from quantized encoder counts using differencing, period timing or filtering, and quantify the resulting noise and lag.

hx-ctl-anti-windup.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-anti-windup.Prerequisite Names: Saturation and clipping models; Integral action for zero steady-state error
hx-ctl-anti-windup.Skill Description: Integrator anti-windup — Prevent integrator windup under actuator saturation with conditional integration, clamping or back-calculation and compare responses after a saturating move.

hx-ctl-current-loop.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-current-loop.Prerequisite Names: Frequency response and Bode plots; Integral action for zero steady-state error
hx-ctl-current-loop.Skill Description: Tune a motor current loop — Design a PI current controller from winding resistance and inductance so the torque-producing current tracks commands with the required bandwidth.

hx-ctl-pid-discrete.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-pid-discrete.Prerequisite Names: Run a fixed-rate control loop on a microcontroller; Derivative filtering and derivative-on-measurement; Integrator anti-windup
hx-ctl-pid-discrete.Skill Description: Implement a discrete PID controller — Implement a fixed-rate discrete PID with output limits, anti-windup, filtered derivative and bumpless mode transfer on a microcontroller.

hx-ctl-pid-tuning.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-pid-tuning.Prerequisite Names: Gain and phase margins; Implement a discrete PID controller
hx-ctl-pid-tuning.Skill Description: PID tuning methods — Tune PID gains with manual heuristics, Ziegler-Nichols or relay-feedback tests and refine them against measured step and disturbance responses.

hx-ctl-pid-joint.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-pid-joint.Skill Name: Tune PID position control of a joint
hx-ctl-pid-joint.Prerequisite Names: Implement practical PID behavior; Estimate joint velocity from encoder counts; PID tuning methods
hx-ctl-pid-joint.Skill Description: Tune PID position control of a joint — Tune and verify a PID joint position controller on hardware to meet overshoot, settling time and steady-state error specifications under realistic loads.

hx-ctl-gravity-comp-joint.Subject: Feedforward and compensation
hx-ctl-gravity-comp-joint.Skill Name: Gravity compensation for a single joint
hx-ctl-gravity-comp-joint.Prerequisite Names: Estimate planar gravity holding torque; Equilibrium of a rigid body in 3D; Tune PID position control of a joint
hx-ctl-gravity-comp-joint.Skill Description: Gravity compensation for a single joint — Add a configuration-dependent gravity torque feedforward to a joint controller and show the reduction in integral effort and steady-state error.

hx-ctl-traj-feedforward.Subject: Feedforward and compensation
hx-ctl-traj-feedforward.Prerequisite Names: Quintic polynomial trajectories; Add model-based feedforward; Tune PID position control of a joint
hx-ctl-traj-feedforward.Skill Description: Velocity and acceleration feedforward — Add velocity and acceleration feedforward from a planned trajectory using estimated damping and inertia so feedback only corrects residual error.

hx-ctl-cascade-loops.Subject: PID and joint servo control
hx-ctl-cascade-loops.Skill Name: Cascaded position, velocity and current loops
hx-ctl-cascade-loops.Prerequisite Names: Tune a motor current loop; Tune PID position control of a joint
hx-ctl-cascade-loops.Skill Description: Cascaded position, velocity and current loops — Structure a joint servo as nested current, velocity and position loops, tune from the inside out and keep adequate bandwidth separation between loops.

hx-ctl-friction-comp.Subject: Feedforward and compensation
hx-ctl-friction-comp.Prerequisite Names: Joint friction models; Velocity and acceleration feedforward
hx-ctl-friction-comp.Skill Description: Friction compensation — Add model-based friction feedforward with a smoothed sign function near zero velocity and evaluate its effect on low-speed tracking and limit cycles.

hx-ctl-gravity-vector.Subject: Feedforward and compensation
hx-ctl-gravity-vector.Skill Name: Gravity torque vector of a multi-joint arm
hx-ctl-gravity-vector.Prerequisite Names: Calculate center of mass for a set of point masses; Static force mapping through the Jacobian transpose; Gravity compensation for a single joint
hx-ctl-gravity-vector.Skill Description: Gravity torque vector of a multi-joint arm — Compute the gravity torque on every joint of a spatial arm from link masses and centers of mass using link Jacobian transposes.

hx-ctl-checkpoint-s3.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s3.Skill Name: Kinematics, Dynamics & Control checkpoint: stage 3 (robot arm)
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s3.Prerequisite Codes: KDC-SIC-001, KDC-SSO-007, KDC-FOK-007, KDC-VKJ-002, KDC-VKJ-006, KDC-FOK-008, KDC-VKJ-007, KDC-TRG-009, KDC-FEC-004
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s3.Prerequisite Names: Identify joint friction parameters; Luenberger observer design; Verify forward kinematics against a URDF model; Analytic versus geometric Jacobian; Verify a Jacobian by finite differences; Product-of-exponentials forward kinematics; Manipulability ellipsoid and conditioning; Cartesian straight-line paths; Friction compensation
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s3.Skill Description: Kinematics, Dynamics & Control checkpoint: stage 3 (robot arm) — Demonstrate the 9 end-of-branch kinematics, dynamics & control skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 3 integration milestone.

hx-ctl-pd-gravity.Subject: Feedforward and compensation
hx-ctl-pd-gravity.Skill Name: PD control with gravity compensation for an arm
hx-ctl-pd-gravity.Prerequisite Names: Coordinate multiple joint controllers; Gravity torque vector of a multi-joint arm
hx-ctl-pd-gravity.Skill Description: PD control with gravity compensation for an arm — Control a multi-joint arm with joint PD plus full gravity compensation and explain why it converges to the setpoint regardless of posture.

hx-ctl-rigid-body-dynamics.Subject: Rigid-body dynamics

hx-ctl-rigid-body-dynamics.Skill Description: Rigid-body dynamics of a manipulator — Write and interpret the manipulator equation relating joint torques to mass matrix, Coriolis, gravity and external wrench terms for a spatial arm.

hx-ctl-momentum-observer.Subject: Model-based and interaction control

hx-ctl-momentum-observer.Prerequisite Names: Joint friction models; Rigid-body dynamics of a manipulator
hx-ctl-momentum-observer.Skill Description: Collision detection with a momentum observer — Detect unexpected contacts by estimating external joint torques with a generalized momentum observer and set thresholds that avoid false alarms.

hx-ctl-impedance.Subject: Model-based and interaction control

hx-ctl-impedance.Skill Description: Impedance control — Make the end effector behave like a chosen mass, spring and damper in task space using torque control with gravity compensation.

hx-ctl-floating-base.Subject: Rigid-body dynamics
hx-ctl-floating-base.Prerequisite Names: Reaction torque on the robot body; Newton-Euler equations of a single rigid body; Rigid-body dynamics of a manipulator
hx-ctl-floating-base.Skill Description: Floating-base and centroidal dynamics — Extend manipulator dynamics to an unactuated floating base and compute the humanoid's centroidal momentum and its relation to external contact forces.

hx-ctl-forward-dynamics.Subject: Rigid-body dynamics
hx-ctl-forward-dynamics.Prerequisite Names: Runge-Kutta integration; Rigid-body dynamics of a manipulator
hx-ctl-forward-dynamics.Skill Description: Forward dynamics simulation — Simulate arm motion by solving the manipulator equation for joint accelerations and integrating with a suitable numerical integrator.

hx-ctl-rnea.Subject: Rigid-body dynamics
hx-ctl-rnea.Prerequisite Names: Free-body diagrams for linked rigid bodies; Newton-Euler equations of a single rigid body; Rigid-body dynamics of a manipulator
hx-ctl-rnea.Skill Description: Recursive Newton-Euler inverse dynamics — Implement the recursive Newton-Euler algorithm to compute joint torques from positions, velocities and accelerations with outward and inward passes.

hx-ctl-dyn-regressor.Subject: System identification and calibration
hx-ctl-dyn-regressor.Prerequisite Names: Linear least-squares fitting; Measure moment of inertia by oscillation; Rigid-body dynamics of a manipulator
hx-ctl-dyn-regressor.Skill Description: Linear-in-parameters dynamics regressor — Rewrite manipulator dynamics as a regressor matrix times inertial parameters and identify base parameters with least squares.

hx-ctl-admittance.Subject: Model-based and interaction control
hx-ctl-admittance.Prerequisite Names: Use a force-torque sensor; Impedance control
hx-ctl-admittance.Skill Description: Admittance control — Turn measured contact forces into compliant position commands for stiff, position-controlled arms and tune virtual mass and damping for stability.

hx-ctl-computed-torque.Subject: Model-based and interaction control
hx-ctl-computed-torque.Prerequisite Names: Velocity and acceleration feedforward; PD control with gravity compensation for an arm; Recursive Newton-Euler inverse dynamics
hx-ctl-computed-torque.Skill Description: Computed-torque control — Linearize arm dynamics by inverse-dynamics feedforward plus PD feedback on trajectory error and analyze sensitivity to model errors.

hx-ctl-nmpc-ilqr.Subject: State-space and optimal control
hx-ctl-nmpc-ilqr.Skill Name: Nonlinear MPC with iLQR or DDP

hx-ctl-checkpoint-s5.Prerequisite Codes: KDC-SIC-004, KDC-MOP-003, KDC-MOP-005, KDC-MOP-008, KDC-MBI-002, KDC-SIC-006, KDC-MBI-005
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s5.Prerequisite Names: Kinematic calibration of arm geometry; Probabilistic roadmaps; RRT-Connect and RRT*; Trajectory optimization for arms; Explicit force control; Linear-in-parameters dynamics regressor; Admittance control
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s5.Skill Description: Kinematics, Dynamics & Control checkpoint: stage 5 (mobile manipulator) — Demonstrate the 7 end-of-branch kinematics, dynamics & control skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 5 integration milestone.

hx-ctl-osc.Subject: Model-based and interaction control
hx-ctl-osc.Prerequisite Names: Jacobian derivative and acceleration kinematics; Redundancy and null-space projection; Computed-torque control
hx-ctl-osc.Skill Description: Operational space control — Compute task-space inertia and command end-effector accelerations through dynamically consistent torque control, with null-space posture control for redundancy.

hx-ctl-collision-reaction.Subject: Model-based and interaction control
hx-ctl-collision-reaction.Prerequisite Names: Effective mass of an arm at a contact point; Collision detection with a momentum observer; Robot risk assessment
hx-ctl-collision-reaction.Skill Description: Collision reaction strategies — Choose and implement post-collision reactions such as stopping, retracting or switching to compliance consistent with human-contact force limits.

hx-ctl-checkpoint-s6.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s6.Skill Name: Kinematics, Dynamics & Control checkpoint: stage 6 (humanoid protocol droid)
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s6.Prerequisite Names: Redundant-arm IK with elbow control; Plan for a dual-arm humanoid upper body; Collision reaction strategies
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s6.Skill Description: Kinematics, Dynamics & Control checkpoint: stage 6 (humanoid protocol droid) — Demonstrate the 3 end-of-branch kinematics, dynamics & control skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 6 integration milestone.

hx-ctl-whole-body.Subject: Whole-body control
hx-ctl-whole-body.Prerequisite Names: Center-of-mass control on a wheeled humanoid; QP-based differential inverse kinematics; Coordinate base and arm motion simultaneously
hx-ctl-whole-body.Skill Description: Whole-body control with task priorities — Coordinate base, torso, both arms and head of a wheeled humanoid through a prioritized whole-body controller with safety constraints on hardware or simulation.

hx-ctl-torque-wbc.Subject: Whole-body control
hx-ctl-torque-wbc.Prerequisite Names: Floating-base and centroidal dynamics; Operational space control; Whole-body control with task priorities
hx-ctl-torque-wbc.Skill Description: Torque-level whole-body QP control — Compute joint torques and contact forces in one QP that respects dynamics, torque limits and friction cones while tracking prioritized tasks.

hx-ctl-checkpoint-s7.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s7.Prerequisite Names: Balance an inverted pendulum with LQR; Nonlinear MPC with iLQR or DDP; Torque-level whole-body QP control
hx-ctl-checkpoint-s7.Skill Description: Kinematics, Dynamics & Control checkpoint: stage 7 (legs) — Demonstrate the 3 end-of-branch kinematics, dynamics & control skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 7 integration milestone.

hx-loc-behavior-trees.Subject: Nav2 and navigation behavior
hx-loc-behavior-trees.Prerequisite Names: Finite-state machines for robot behaviour; Implement a robot behavior state machine
hx-loc-behavior-trees.Skill Description: Behavior tree fundamentals — Read and write behavior trees using sequence, fallback, decorator and action nodes, and explain tick semantics and running states compared with state machines.

rob3:N10.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation
rob3:N10.Prerequisite Codes: SYS-RSP-004, PHY-PHY-005, PHY-PHY-004, PHY-PHY-006, PHY-PHY-007, MEC-CFM-003
rob3:N10.Prerequisite Names: Allocate system budgets; Draw and balance simple planar forces; Calculate a one-dimensional center of mass; Apply a stated dry-friction contact model; Calculate a planar moment; Evaluate member stress and deflection
rob3:N10.Skill Description: Check mobile stability and traction — Check mobile stability and traction

hx-loc-traction-limit.Subject: Wheels, traction and base hardware
hx-loc-traction-limit.Prerequisite Names: Apply a stated dry-friction contact model; Newton's second law in components; Determine the required static-friction force
hx-loc-traction-limit.Skill Description: Traction-limited base acceleration — Calculate the maximum acceleration and braking a wheeled base can achieve before drive wheels slip, using normal load on driven wheels and the friction coefficient.

hx-loc-stopping-distance.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-stopping-distance.Skill Description: Base stopping distance — Calculate stopping distance from speed, detection and actuation latency and achievable deceleration, and use it to set a safe maximum speed for a sensing range.

hx-loc-support-polygon.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-support-polygon.Skill Name: Static stability and the support polygon
hx-loc-support-polygon.Prerequisite Names: Calculate center of mass for a set of point masses; Check mobile stability and traction; Check whether a predicted normal reaction is compatible with nonadhesive contact
hx-loc-support-polygon.Skill Description: Static stability and the support polygon — Construct the support polygon from ground contact points and judge static stability by whether the ground projection of the center of mass lies inside it, with a margin.

hx-loc-static-tip-angle.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-static-tip-angle.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle trigonometry; Static stability and the support polygon; Tipping versus slipping of a pushed body
hx-loc-static-tip-angle.Skill Description: Static tip-over angle — Calculate the tilt angle at which a wheeled robot tips about each support polygon edge from center of mass height and horizontal distance to that edge.

rob3:N01.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation
rob3:N01.Prerequisite Names: Right-triangle trigonometry; Label frames and joint conventions; Convert encoder counts to joint motion
rob3:N01.Skill Description: Model differential-drive motion — Model differential-drive motion

rob3:N02.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation

rob3:N02.Skill Description: Integrate wheel odometry — Integrate wheel odometry

rob3:N04.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation

rob3:N04.Skill Description: Represent maps and robot footprint — Represent maps and robot footprint

hx-loc-mecanum-kinematics.Subject: Wheeled drive kinematics
hx-loc-mecanum-kinematics.Prerequisite Names: Matrix arithmetic; Pseudoinverses; Mobile base drive types compared
hx-loc-mecanum-kinematics.Skill Description: Mecanum wheel kinematics — Derive the four-wheel mecanum kinematic matrix mapping body twist to wheel speeds and its pseudoinverse for odometry, including roller angle and sign conventions.

rob3:N03.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation

rob3:N03.Skill Description: Calibrate wheel geometry — Calibrate wheel geometry

rob3:N06.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation

rob3:N06.Skill Description: Plan a feasible grid route — Plan a feasible grid route

hx-loc-wheel-caster-select.Subject: Wheels, traction and base hardware

hx-loc-wheel-caster-select.Skill Description: Select drive wheels and casters — Choose wheel diameter, tread material, durometer and load rating plus caster size and swivel offset for a given floor type, payload and obstacle height.

hx-loc-diffdrive-odometry.Subject: Wheeled drive kinematics
hx-loc-diffdrive-odometry.Prerequisite Names: Read a quadrature encoder in firmware; Integrate wheel odometry; Calibrate wheel geometry
hx-loc-diffdrive-odometry.Skill Description: Differential-drive kinematics and wheel odometry — Implement forward and inverse differential-drive kinematics in code and integrate encoder ticks into a timestamped pose and twist estimate published for the rest of the robot.

hx-loc-odom-drift.Subject: Base motion control and odometry
hx-loc-odom-drift.Skill Name: Odometry error growth and its sources
hx-loc-odom-drift.Prerequisite Names: Interpret Gaussian state uncertainty and covariance; Differential-drive kinematics and wheel odometry
hx-loc-odom-drift.Skill Description: Odometry error growth and its sources — Separate systematic odometry errors such as wheel diameter mismatch from random errors such as wheel slip, and show how small heading errors make position error grow with distance.

hx-loc-nav-frames.Subject: Localization on a map
hx-loc-nav-frames.Skill Name: Map, odom and base frame conventions
hx-loc-nav-frames.Prerequisite Names: Broadcast and look up transforms with tf2; Differential-drive kinematics and wheel odometry
hx-loc-nav-frames.Skill Description: Map, odom and base frame conventions — Explain the map to odom to base_link frame chain, which node publishes each transform, and why odometry is continuous while map corrections may jump.

hx-loc-twist-cmdvel.Subject: Wheeled drive kinematics
hx-loc-twist-cmdvel.Skill Name: Convert body twist commands to wheel speeds
hx-loc-twist-cmdvel.Prerequisite Names: Write a ROS 2 publisher and subscriber; Differential-drive kinematics and wheel odometry
hx-loc-twist-cmdvel.Skill Description: Convert body twist commands to wheel speeds — Accept a linear and angular body velocity command and convert it into left and right wheel angular velocities with correct units, signs and frame conventions.

hx-loc-skid-steer.Subject: Wheeled drive kinematics
hx-loc-skid-steer.Skill Name: Skid-steer kinematics and effective track width
hx-loc-skid-steer.Prerequisite Names: Static and kinetic friction; Differential-drive kinematics and wheel odometry
hx-loc-skid-steer.Skill Description: Skid-steer kinematics and effective track width — Model a four-wheel skid-steer base as a differential drive with an empirically identified effective track width and explain the turning scrub it causes.

rob3:N05.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation
rob3:N05.Prerequisite Names: Integrate wheel odometry; Represent maps and robot footprint; Fuse nonlinear mobile-robot measurements
rob3:N05.Skill Description: Localize against a known map — Localize against a known map

hx-loc-velocity-accel-limits.Subject: Base motion control and odometry
hx-loc-velocity-accel-limits.Skill Name: Base velocity, acceleration and jerk limits
hx-loc-velocity-accel-limits.Prerequisite Names: Traction-limited base acceleration; Convert body twist commands to wheel speeds
hx-loc-velocity-accel-limits.Skill Description: Base velocity, acceleration and jerk limits — Apply velocity, acceleration and jerk limits with a velocity smoother, scaling saturated wheel commands so path curvature is preserved and motion stays within traction bounds.

hx-loc-umbmark.Subject: Base motion control and odometry
hx-loc-umbmark.Skill Name: Calibrate odometry with a square-path test
hx-loc-umbmark.Prerequisite Names: Calibrate wheel geometry; Odometry error growth and its sources
hx-loc-umbmark.Skill Description: Calibrate odometry with a square-path test — Run clockwise and counterclockwise square-path trials, measure end-point errors and correct wheel diameter ratio and effective track width to reduce systematic drift.

hx-loc-cmd-timeout.Subject: Base motion control and odometry
hx-loc-cmd-timeout.Prerequisite Names: Use watchdogs and fault states; Convert body twist commands to wheel speeds
hx-loc-cmd-timeout.Skill Description: Stop on stale velocity commands — Implement a command timeout that ramps the base to zero velocity when no fresh command arrives within a set interval and logs the event.

hx-loc-particle-filter.Subject: Localization on a map
hx-loc-particle-filter.Prerequisite Names: Random variables and distributions; Process depth and range observations; Odometry error growth and its sources; Localize against a known map
hx-loc-particle-filter.Skill Description: Particle filter localization — Implement Monte Carlo localization by sampling particles from a noisy odometry motion model, weighting them with a likelihood-field lidar model and applying low-variance resampling.

rob3:N09.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation
rob3:N09.Prerequisite Names: Create logs and replayable tests; Fuse nonlinear mobile-robot measurements; Localize against a known map
rob3:N09.Skill Description: Evaluate a SLAM pipeline — Evaluate a SLAM pipeline

hx-loc-cop.Subject: Legged foundations
hx-loc-cop.Prerequisite Names: Torque and lever arms; Static stability and the support polygon; Move a force to another point using an equivalent force-and-couple system
hx-loc-cop.Skill Description: Center of pressure — Calculate the center of pressure from distributed vertical contact forces under one or two feet and relate it to the net ground reaction moment.

hx-loc-suspension.Subject: Wheels, traction and base hardware
hx-loc-suspension.Prerequisite Names: Select drive wheels and casters; Recognize when support reactions require deformation compatibility
hx-loc-suspension.Skill Description: Wheel suspension to keep traction — Explain why a rigid base with four or more wheels can lift a drive wheel on uneven floors and design a rocker or sprung suspension that keeps drive wheels loaded.

hx-loc-friction-cone.Subject: Legged foundations
hx-loc-friction-cone.Prerequisite Names: Represent spatial motion and force; Determine the required static-friction force; Angle of friction and the friction cone; Center of pressure
hx-loc-friction-cone.Skill Description: Contact forces and friction cones — Check whether a contact force lies inside its friction cone, linearize the cone as a pyramid and extend the idea to the contact wrench of a flat foot.

hx-loc-foot-force-sensors.Subject: Legged foundations
hx-loc-foot-force-sensors.Prerequisite Names: Calibrate a scalar sensor; Resistive bridge sensing; Center of pressure
hx-loc-foot-force-sensors.Skill Description: Measure foot ground reaction forces — Instrument a foot with force-sensitive resistors or load cells, calibrate them and compute total normal force and center of pressure in real time.

hx-loc-bumper-safety.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-bumper-safety.Skill Name: Bumpers, cliff sensors and protective stop
hx-loc-bumper-safety.Prerequisite Names: Base stopping distance; Design an emergency stop and safe power-off circuit
hx-loc-bumper-safety.Skill Description: Bumpers, cliff sensors and protective stop — Fit contact bumpers and cliff sensors to a base and wire them into a protective stop that halts the drive independently of the navigation software.

hx-loc-base-chassis.Subject: Wheels, traction and base hardware
hx-loc-base-chassis.Skill Name: Lay out a wheeled base chassis
hx-loc-base-chassis.Prerequisite Names: Build a CAD assembly with mates and motion; Select drive wheels and casters; Design a lithium battery pack
hx-loc-base-chassis.Skill Description: Lay out a wheeled base chassis — Lay out a mobile base chassis in CAD placing motors, wheels, battery, electronics and the upper-body mount to keep the center of mass low and service access clear.

hx-loc-odom-imu-fusion.Subject: Base motion control and odometry
hx-loc-odom-imu-fusion.Skill Name: Fuse wheel odometry with an IMU
hx-loc-odom-imu-fusion.Prerequisite Names: Fuse nonlinear mobile-robot measurements; Odometry error growth and its sources; What an accelerometer measures; Estimate orientation from an IMU
hx-loc-odom-imu-fusion.Skill Description: Fuse wheel odometry with an IMU — Configure an extended Kalman filter node to fuse wheel odometry velocities with IMU yaw rate, setting covariances so heading drift is reduced without double counting.

hx-loc-legged-anatomy.Subject: Legged foundations
hx-loc-legged-anatomy.Skill Name: Legged robot anatomy and degrees of freedom
hx-loc-legged-anatomy.Prerequisite Names: Distinguish configuration, workspace and constraints; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-loc-legged-anatomy.Skill Description: Legged robot anatomy and degrees of freedom — Identify the hip, knee and ankle joints of a humanoid leg, explain why six degrees of freedom per leg is typical and compare leg layouts.

hx-loc-static-dynamic-stability.Subject: Legged foundations
hx-loc-static-dynamic-stability.Prerequisite Names: Static stability and the support polygon; Legged robot anatomy and degrees of freedom
hx-loc-static-dynamic-stability.Skill Description: Static versus dynamic stability — Distinguish statically stable gaits, which keep the center of mass over the support polygon, from dynamic gaits that rely on motion and momentum to stay upright.

hx-loc-gait-phases.Subject: Gait generation
hx-loc-gait-phases.Skill Description: Gait phases and timing — Describe single support, double support, swing and stance phases, and set step period, duty factor and double-support ratio for a walking pattern.

hx-loc-rl-locomotion-env.Subject: Learning-based locomotion
hx-loc-rl-locomotion-env.Prerequisite Names: Simulate a robot model in Gazebo or MuJoCo; Reinforcement learning fundamentals; Gait phases and timing
hx-loc-rl-locomotion-env.Skill Description: Locomotion reinforcement learning environment — Set up a parallel simulated locomotion environment with observations, joint-target actions under PD control, command sampling, termination and reset conditions.

hx-loc-contact-detection.Subject: Legged control
hx-loc-contact-detection.Prerequisite Names: Measure foot ground reaction forces; Gait phases and timing
hx-loc-contact-detection.Skill Description: Foot contact detection — Decide foot contact state from force sensors, estimated joint torques and gait phase, with hysteresis so early or late touchdown is handled cleanly.

hx-loc-rl-reward-design.Subject: Learning-based locomotion
hx-loc-rl-reward-design.Skill Description: Reward design for locomotion — Design reward terms for velocity tracking, orientation, energy, joint limits, foot clearance and gait regularity, and diagnose reward hacking from rollouts.

hx-loc-rl-policy-training.Subject: Learning-based locomotion
hx-loc-rl-policy-training.Skill Name: Train a locomotion policy with PPO
hx-loc-rl-policy-training.Prerequisite Names: Train a neural network in PyTorch; Reward design for locomotion
hx-loc-rl-policy-training.Skill Description: Train a locomotion policy with PPO — Train a walking policy with PPO and a terrain or command curriculum, tracking returns, episode length and gait quality to decide when training has converged.

hx-loc-leg-kinematics.Subject: Legged foundations
hx-loc-leg-kinematics.Prerequisite Names: Solve and verify planar inverse kinematics; Legged robot anatomy and degrees of freedom; Numerical inverse kinematics
hx-loc-leg-kinematics.Skill Description: Leg forward and inverse kinematics — Compute foot pose from leg joint angles and solve inverse kinematics analytically for a six-joint leg with intersecting hip axes, checking joint limits.

hx-loc-swing-trajectory.Subject: Gait generation
hx-loc-swing-trajectory.Prerequisite Names: Generate smooth joint trajectories; Gait phases and timing; Leg forward and inverse kinematics
hx-loc-swing-trajectory.Skill Description: Swing foot trajectories — Generate smooth swing foot trajectories with polynomial or spline segments that meet clearance height and land with near-zero velocity at the planned footstep.

hx-loc-domain-randomization.Subject: Learning-based locomotion
hx-loc-domain-randomization.Prerequisite Names: Train a locomotion policy with PPO
hx-loc-domain-randomization.Skill Description: Domain randomization for locomotion — Randomize mass, friction, motor strength, latency, sensor noise and external pushes during training so a policy tolerates mismatch between simulation and hardware.

hx-loc-legged-state-estimation.Subject: Legged control
hx-loc-legged-state-estimation.Prerequisite Names: Fuse nonlinear mobile-robot measurements; Estimate orientation from an IMU; Foot contact detection; Leg forward and inverse kinematics
hx-loc-legged-state-estimation.Skill Description: Legged state estimation — Fuse IMU data with leg kinematics of feet in stance in a Kalman filter to estimate base velocity, orientation and position for walking control.

hx-loc-com-height.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-com-height.Skill Name: Combined center of mass of a tall robot
hx-loc-com-height.Prerequisite Names: Calculate center of mass for a set of point masses; Static stability and the support polygon; Center of mass of a composite body
hx-loc-com-height.Skill Description: Combined center of mass of a tall robot — Compute the three-dimensional center of mass of a base carrying a torso, arms, head and battery from component masses and positions, and report its height.

hx-loc-zmp.Subject: Balance and walking models
hx-loc-zmp.Prerequisite Names: Rotational dynamics about a fixed axis; Center of pressure; Static versus dynamic stability; Center-of-mass acceleration and ground reaction
hx-loc-zmp.Skill Description: Zero moment point balance criterion — Compute the zero moment point from center of mass motion and judge whether a motion is dynamically feasible by whether the ZMP stays inside the support polygon.

hx-loc-arm-extended-com.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-arm-extended-com.Skill Name: Center of mass shift with arms and payload
hx-loc-arm-extended-com.Prerequisite Names: Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms; Center of mass of a composite body; Combined center of mass of a tall robot
hx-loc-arm-extended-com.Skill Description: Center of mass shift with arms and payload — Compute how center of mass and stability margin change as arms extend or lift a payload, using forward kinematics over sampled arm configurations.

hx-loc-dynamic-tip-accel.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-dynamic-tip-accel.Prerequisite Codes: PHY-TRM-016, PHY-NIF-001, LOC-MBS-003, PHY-IPB-004, LOC-MBS-005, PHY-IPB-005
hx-loc-dynamic-tip-accel.Prerequisite Names: Newton's second law in components; Inertial forces in a linearly accelerating frame; Static tip-over angle; Balancing by accelerating the support; Combined center of mass of a tall robot; Center-of-mass acceleration and ground reaction
hx-loc-dynamic-tip-accel.Skill Description: Tip-over limit under acceleration — Calculate the largest braking, acceleration or turning lateral acceleration before a tall robot tips, using the ratio of edge distance to center of mass height.

hx-loc-lipm.Subject: Balance and walking models
hx-loc-lipm.Prerequisite Names: Small-angle pendulum model; Second-order linear equations; Linearize the inverted pendulum about upright; Zero moment point balance criterion
hx-loc-lipm.Skill Description: Linear inverted pendulum model — Derive the linear inverted pendulum equations under constant center of mass height, solve them in closed form and simulate center of mass motion for a given ZMP.

hx-loc-slope-tip.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-slope-tip.Prerequisite Names: Inclined-plane dynamics; Tip-over limit under acceleration
hx-loc-slope-tip.Skill Description: Stability on ramps — Combine ramp grade with braking and turning acceleration to find the worst-case stability margin of a tall wheeled robot on a ramp, uphill, downhill and across.

hx-loc-stability-aware-limits.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-stability-aware-limits.Prerequisite Names: Base velocity, acceleration and jerk limits; Center of mass shift with arms and payload; Tip-over limit under acceleration
hx-loc-stability-aware-limits.Skill Description: Stability-aware base acceleration limits — Scale base speed and acceleration limits online from the current arm pose and payload so the predicted tip-over margin never drops below a set threshold.

hx-loc-tilt-test.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-tilt-test.Prerequisite Names: Plan traceable verification; Static tip-over angle; Center of mass shift with arms and payload
hx-loc-tilt-test.Skill Description: Verify tip-over margin physically — Measure a real robot's tip-over margin with a tilt platform or calibrated pull test in its worst configuration, using tethers, and compare with the predicted value.

hx-loc-capture-point.Subject: Balance and walking models
hx-loc-capture-point.Prerequisite Names: Linearize the inverted pendulum about upright; Linear inverted pendulum model
hx-loc-capture-point.Skill Description: Capture point — Compute the instantaneous capture point from center of mass position and velocity and decide whether the robot can stop by stepping or must take more steps.

hx-loc-dcm.Subject: Balance and walking models
hx-loc-dcm.Skill Description: Divergent component of motion — Split linear inverted pendulum dynamics into stable and divergent parts and plan DCM trajectories backward from final footsteps to drive walking.

hx-loc-fall-detection.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-fall-detection.Prerequisite Names: Estimate orientation from an IMU; Capture point
hx-loc-fall-detection.Skill Description: Detect an imminent fall — Detect an unrecoverable fall early from capture point outside reachable footholds, trunk tilt and angular rate thresholds, and trigger a fall response.

hx-loc-step-planning.Subject: Gait generation
hx-loc-step-planning.Prerequisite Names: Plan a feasible grid route; Gait phases and timing; Capture point
hx-loc-step-planning.Skill Description: Footstep planning — Generate a footstep sequence to a goal respecting step length, width, rotation and collision constraints, alternating feet and handling turning in place.

hx-loc-terrain-mapping.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-terrain-mapping.Prerequisite Names: Build and process point clouds from depth; Footstep planning
hx-loc-terrain-mapping.Skill Description: Elevation mapping for footholds — Build a local elevation map from depth data and score candidate footholds by flatness, slope and edge distance for the footstep planner.

hx-loc-com-trajectory.Subject: Gait generation
hx-loc-com-trajectory.Skill Name: Center of mass trajectory from footsteps
hx-loc-com-trajectory.Prerequisite Names: Swing foot trajectories; Divergent component of motion; Footstep planning
hx-loc-com-trajectory.Skill Description: Center of mass trajectory from footsteps — Produce a center of mass trajectory from a footstep plan using ZMP or DCM references and convert it with swing trajectories into joint commands via leg IK.

hx-loc-actuator-model-sim.Subject: Learning-based locomotion
hx-loc-actuator-model-sim.Prerequisite Names: Record and replay robot data with rosbag; Domain randomization for locomotion; Identify a simple actuator model
hx-loc-actuator-model-sim.Skill Description: Model actuator dynamics for sim-to-real — Identify actuator bandwidth, torque limits, friction and latency from hardware logs and add them to simulation, or train an actuator network, to narrow the reality gap.

hx-loc-sim-to-real.Subject: Learning-based locomotion
hx-loc-sim-to-real.Skill Name: Transfer a locomotion policy to hardware
hx-loc-sim-to-real.Prerequisite Names: Deploy models on edge hardware; Domain randomization for locomotion; Model actuator dynamics for sim-to-real
