hx-loc-sim-to-real.Skill Description: Transfer a locomotion policy to hardware — Deploy a trained locomotion policy on hardware at a fixed control rate, match observations and action scaling to simulation and gate it with torque and attitude limits.

rob3:N07.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation
rob3:N07.Prerequisite Names: Generate bounded joint trajectories; Model differential-drive motion; Plan a feasible grid route; Implement practical PID behavior
rob3:N07.Skill Description: Track a mobile path — Track a mobile path

hx-loc-pure-pursuit.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-pure-pursuit.Prerequisite Names: Base velocity, acceleration and jerk limits; Track a mobile path
hx-loc-pure-pursuit.Skill Description: Regulated pure pursuit path following — Implement pure pursuit by steering toward a lookahead point, then regulate speed near curves and obstacles and tune lookahead distance for stability.

rob3:N08.Subject: Wheeled mobility and navigation
rob3:N08.Prerequisite Names: Implement bounded fault response; Process depth and range observations; Track a mobile path
rob3:N08.Skill Description: Respond to changing obstacles — Respond to changing obstacles

hx-loc-drive-torque-sizing.Subject: Wheels, traction and base hardware
hx-loc-drive-torque-sizing.Prerequisite Names: Inclined-plane dynamics; Rolling resistance of wheels; Traction-limited base acceleration; Forces on an accelerating rolling wheel; Size an actuator from joint load, speed and duty cycle
hx-loc-drive-torque-sizing.Skill Description: Size base drive motors — Size drive motor torque, speed and gear ratio from robot mass, target speed, acceleration, ramp grade and rolling resistance coefficient, with a stated margin and duty cycle.

hx-loc-thresholds-ramps.Subject: Nav2 and navigation behavior
hx-loc-thresholds-ramps.Prerequisite Names: Select drive wheels and casters; Stability on ramps; Size base drive motors
hx-loc-thresholds-ramps.Skill Description: Cross thresholds and ramps — Determine from wheel diameter, ground clearance and approach angle which thresholds and ramps a base can cross, then cross them at controlled speed with stability checks.

hx-loc-hub-motor.Subject: Wheels, traction and base hardware
hx-loc-hub-motor.Skill Name: Drive a base with BLDC hub motors
hx-loc-hub-motor.Prerequisite Names: Brushless DC motor operation and commutation; Size base drive motors
hx-loc-hub-motor.Skill Description: Drive a base with BLDC hub motors — Select brushless hub motors and matching field-oriented controllers for a mobile base and command them in velocity mode with correct direction, limits and encoder feedback.

hx-loc-wheel-velocity-pid.Subject: Base motion control and odometry
hx-loc-wheel-velocity-pid.Prerequisite Names: Read a quadrature encoder in firmware; Drive a brushed motor with an H-bridge and PWM; Tune PID position control of a joint
hx-loc-wheel-velocity-pid.Skill Description: Closed-loop wheel velocity control — Implement and tune a per-wheel velocity PI loop using encoder speed estimates, feedforward from the motor model and output saturation handling.

hx-loc-standing-balance.Subject: Balance and walking models
hx-loc-standing-balance.Prerequisite Names: Center of pressure; Linear inverted pendulum model; Tune PID position control of a joint
hx-loc-standing-balance.Skill Description: Ankle and hip balance strategies — Implement ankle and hip strategies that shift the center of pressure or swing the upper body to keep a standing robot balanced after small pushes.

hx-loc-ros2-control-base.Subject: Base motion control and odometry
hx-loc-ros2-control-base.Skill Name: Configure ros2_control for a mobile base
hx-loc-ros2-control-base.Prerequisite Names: Write a URDF robot description; Convert body twist commands to wheel speeds; Closed-loop wheel velocity control
hx-loc-ros2-control-base.Skill Description: Configure ros2_control for a mobile base — Write a ros2_control hardware interface for the base motors and configure the diff-drive controller with wheel geometry, limits and odometry publishing.

hx-loc-sim-biped-walk.Subject: Gait generation
hx-loc-sim-biped-walk.Prerequisite Names: Simulate a robot model in Gazebo or MuJoCo; Center of mass trajectory from footsteps; Ankle and hip balance strategies
hx-loc-sim-biped-walk.Skill Description: Make a simulated biped walk — Make a simulated biped stand, walk forward, turn and stop on flat ground using a model-based gait or a learned policy, with logged ZMP or stability margins.

hx-loc-stepping-recovery.Subject: Gait generation
hx-loc-stepping-recovery.Prerequisite Names: Capture point; Footstep planning; Ankle and hip balance strategies
hx-loc-stepping-recovery.Skill Description: Push recovery by stepping — Adjust the next footstep location and timing from the capture point so the robot recovers from pushes too large for ankle or hip strategies.

hx-loc-base-bringup.Subject: Base motion control and odometry
hx-loc-base-bringup.Skill Name: Bring up a mobile base on blocks
hx-loc-base-bringup.Prerequisite Names: Commission a subsystem in stages; Stop on stale velocity commands; Configure ros2_control for a mobile base
hx-loc-base-bringup.Skill Description: Bring up a mobile base on blocks — Commission a new base with wheels off the ground, verifying motor direction, encoder sign, odometry scale, command timeout and e-stop before driving on the floor.

hx-loc-leg-torque-requirements.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-leg-torque-requirements.Prerequisite Names: Quasi-direct-drive actuator design; Size an actuator from joint load, speed and duty cycle; Make a simulated biped walk
hx-loc-leg-torque-requirements.Skill Description: Leg actuator requirements from walking — Extract peak and RMS joint torque, speed and power for each leg joint from simulated walking, stairs and falls to specify leg actuators.

hx-loc-uneven-terrain.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-uneven-terrain.Prerequisite Names: Foot contact detection; Make a simulated biped walk
hx-loc-uneven-terrain.Skill Description: Walk on uneven ground — Keep walking over small unexpected height changes using contact-timing adaptation, compliant ankles and posture correction rather than assuming flat ground.

hx-loc-teleop-base.Subject: Base motion control and odometry
hx-loc-teleop-base.Skill Name: Teleoperate a base with a deadman switch
hx-loc-teleop-base.Prerequisite Names: Base velocity, acceleration and jerk limits; Bring up a mobile base on blocks
hx-loc-teleop-base.Skill Description: Teleoperate a base with a deadman switch — Drive the base from a gamepad through a teleop node that requires a held deadman button, applies speed limits and stops when the controller disconnects.

hx-loc-leg-design.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-leg-design.Prerequisite Names: Legged robot anatomy and degrees of freedom; Design a humanoid torso, shoulder and head structure; Leg actuator requirements from walking
hx-loc-leg-design.Skill Description: Design a humanoid leg — Design a leg with proximal actuator placement, low distal mass, joint ranges for walking and getting up, and a foot sized for the support polygon needed.

hx-loc-slopes-stairs.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-slopes-stairs.Prerequisite Names: Contact forces and friction cones; Elevation mapping for footholds; Walk on uneven ground
hx-loc-slopes-stairs.Skill Description: Walk on slopes and stairs — Adapt foot orientation, swing clearance, step height and center of mass placement to walk up and down slopes and perceived stairs with friction margins.

hx-loc-centroidal-dynamics.Subject: Legged foundations
hx-loc-centroidal-dynamics.Prerequisite Names: Angular momentum conservation; Reaction torque on the robot body; Legged robot anatomy and degrees of freedom; Center-of-mass acceleration and ground reaction; Rigid-body dynamics of a manipulator
hx-loc-centroidal-dynamics.Skill Description: Centroidal dynamics — Relate contact forces to the rate of change of linear and angular momentum about the center of mass and compute centroidal momentum from joint velocities.

hx-loc-safe-falling.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-safe-falling.Prerequisite Names: Detect an imminent fall; Impedance control
hx-loc-safe-falling.Skill Description: Safe falling — Execute a fall response that crouches, turns toward padded surfaces, protects the head and joints with compliant control and manages motor power at impact.

hx-loc-contact-force-qp.Subject: Legged control
hx-loc-contact-force-qp.Prerequisite Names: Constrained extrema; Contact forces and friction cones; Centroidal dynamics
hx-loc-contact-force-qp.Skill Description: Contact force distribution by optimization — Formulate a quadratic program that distributes desired centroidal wrench across feet in contact while respecting friction cones and torque limits.

hx-loc-walking-mpc.Subject: Legged control
hx-loc-walking-mpc.Prerequisite Names: Model predictive control; Linear inverted pendulum model; Centroidal dynamics
hx-loc-walking-mpc.Skill Description: Model predictive control for walking — Formulate a receding-horizon controller on a ZMP or centroidal model that replans center of mass motion and footstep positions every cycle under constraints.

hx-loc-map-building.Subject: Localization on a map
hx-loc-map-building.Skill Name: Build a 2D map of a building
hx-loc-map-building.Prerequisite Names: Simultaneous localization and mapping; Teleoperate a base with a deadman switch
hx-loc-map-building.Skill Description: Build a 2D map of a building — Drive the base through a building while running a 2D lidar SLAM package, then save, inspect and clean the resulting occupancy grid for navigation use.

hx-loc-costmap-layers.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-costmap-layers.Prerequisite Names: Process depth and range observations; Represent maps and robot footprint; Build a 2D map of a building
hx-loc-costmap-layers.Skill Description: Layered costmaps — Configure static, obstacle, voxel and inflation layers in global and local costmaps and explain how sensor marking and clearing produce the final cost grid.

hx-loc-get-up.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-get-up.Prerequisite Names: Generate smooth joint trajectories; Safe falling
hx-loc-get-up.Skill Description: Get up after a fall — Design and verify get-up motions from face-down and face-up positions, keeping joint torques within limits and the center of mass over changing support.

hx-loc-amcl.Subject: Localization on a map
hx-loc-amcl.Prerequisite Names: Map, odom and base frame conventions; Particle filter localization; Build a 2D map of a building
hx-loc-amcl.Skill Description: Tune AMCL localization — Configure AMCL with initial pose, particle limits, motion noise and laser model parameters, judge quality from particle spread and scan alignment, and recover when localization is lost.

hx-loc-dwa.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-dwa.Prerequisite Names: Base velocity, acceleration and jerk limits; Respond to changing obstacles; Layered costmaps
hx-loc-dwa.Skill Description: Dynamic window local planning — Sample velocity commands inside the dynamic window set by acceleration limits, forward-simulate trajectories and score them for obstacle cost, path alignment and progress.

hx-loc-global-planner.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-global-planner.Prerequisite Names: Plan a feasible grid route; Layered costmaps
hx-loc-global-planner.Skill Description: Global path planners on costmaps — Run and compare Dijkstra, A-star and Theta-star planners on a costmap, explaining path cost, heuristics, smoothing and why planned paths hug or avoid walls.

hx-loc-3d-obstacles.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-3d-obstacles.Skill Name: Mark 3D obstacles for a tall robot
hx-loc-3d-obstacles.Prerequisite Names: Build and process point clouds from depth; Layered costmaps
hx-loc-3d-obstacles.Skill Description: Mark 3D obstacles for a tall robot — Project depth camera or 3D lidar points into a voxel costmap so table tops, shelves and overhangs at torso and head height block the tall robot's path.

hx-loc-inflation-tuning.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-inflation-tuning.Skill Description: Tune footprint and inflation — Set the robot footprint polygon, inflation radius and cost scaling so paths keep a sensible clearance without blocking doorways the robot can physically fit through.

hx-loc-harness-gantry.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-harness-gantry.Prerequisite Names: Design an emergency stop and safe power-off circuit; Robot risk assessment
hx-loc-harness-gantry.Skill Description: Safety harness and gantry testing — Set up an overhead gantry or harness with fall-arrest slack, quick release and e-stop so legged experiments cannot damage the robot or people nearby.

hx-loc-nav2-bringup.Subject: Nav2 and navigation behavior
hx-loc-nav2-bringup.Prerequisite Names: Simulate a robot model in Gazebo or MuJoCo; Map, odom and base frame conventions; Layered costmaps
hx-loc-nav2-bringup.Skill Description: Bring up Nav2 in simulation — Launch Nav2 with a parameter file, map and lifecycle-managed nodes on a simulated base, send a goal and diagnose missing transforms or inactive nodes.

hx-loc-dynamic-obstacles.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-dynamic-obstacles.Prerequisite Names: Detect and track people and faces; Dynamic window local planning
hx-loc-dynamic-obstacles.Skill Description: Navigate among moving people — Feed tracked people with predicted motion into planning so the base yields, waits or passes with clearance instead of treating people as static obstacles.

hx-loc-dynamic-footprint.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-dynamic-footprint.Prerequisite Names: Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms; Tune footprint and inflation
hx-loc-dynamic-footprint.Skill Description: Update footprint when arms extend — Recompute and publish the navigation footprint when arms reach out or a payload is carried so planners and collision checks use the true occupied area.

hx-loc-biped-test-progression.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-biped-test-progression.Prerequisite Names: Incremental integration and bring-up plan; Make a simulated biped walk; Safety harness and gantry testing
hx-loc-biped-test-progression.Skill Description: Biped hardware test progression — Plan and run staged biped tests from suspended leg motions to supported standing, stepping in place, harnessed walking and finally free walking with exit criteria.

hx-loc-nav2-bt.Subject: Nav2 and navigation behavior
hx-loc-nav2-bt.Prerequisite Names: Behavior tree fundamentals; Bring up Nav2 in simulation
hx-loc-nav2-bt.Skill Description: Customize Nav2 behavior trees — Modify the Nav2 navigate-to-pose behavior tree to change replanning rate, order recovery behaviors such as spin, back-up and costmap clearing, and add custom action nodes.

hx-loc-social-nav.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-social-nav.Prerequisite Names: Legible and predictable robot motion; Navigate among moving people
hx-loc-social-nav.Skill Description: Socially aware navigation — Apply passing-side conventions, corridor yielding, approach angles and speed reduction so a humanoid base moves legibly and politely around people.

hx-loc-hardware-biped-walk.Subject: Falls, terrain and legged testing
hx-loc-hardware-biped-walk.Prerequisite Names: Legged state estimation; Transfer a locomotion policy to hardware; Design a humanoid leg; Safe falling; Biped hardware test progression
hx-loc-hardware-biped-walk.Skill Description: Walk a physical biped — Make a physical biped walk, turn and stop on flat floor for a set distance without the harness bearing load, logging falls, interventions and stability margins.

hx-loc-nav-stack.Subject: Nav2 and navigation behavior
hx-loc-nav-stack.Prerequisite Names: Regulated pure pursuit path following; Configure ros2_control for a mobile base; Tune AMCL localization; Tune footprint and inflation; Customize Nav2 behavior trees
hx-loc-nav-stack.Skill Description: Autonomous navigation with Nav2 — Run Nav2 on the physical base so it localizes on a saved map, plans and follows paths to goals, avoids new obstacles and recovers when blocked.

hx-loc-docking.Subject: Nav2 and navigation behavior
hx-loc-docking.Prerequisite Names: Detect fiducial markers (AprilTag, ArUco); Battery management system functions; Autonomous navigation with Nav2
hx-loc-docking.Skill Description: Autonomous docking to a charger — Approach a charging dock with navigation, switch to fiducial-guided final alignment and verify charging current, retrying when contact is not confirmed.

hx-loc-nav-evaluation.Subject: Nav2 and navigation behavior
hx-loc-nav-evaluation.Prerequisite Names: Evaluate accuracy and repeatability; Autonomous navigation with Nav2
hx-loc-nav-evaluation.Skill Description: Measure navigation performance — Run repeated navigation trials and report success rate, goal position and heading error, time to goal, interventions and near misses with logged data.

hx-loc-doorways.Subject: Nav2 and navigation behavior
hx-loc-doorways.Skill Name: Pass through doorways and narrow gaps
hx-loc-doorways.Prerequisite Names: Update footprint when arms extend; Autonomous navigation with Nav2
hx-loc-doorways.Skill Description: Pass through doorways and narrow gaps — Plan and execute passage through doorways and narrow gaps by aligning before entry, reducing speed and checking footprint clearance including extended arms.

hx-loc-checkpoint-s4.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-loc-checkpoint-s4.Prerequisite Codes: LOC-WDK-002, LOC-WDK-005, LOC-BMC-003, LOC-WTB-003, LOC-WTB-004, LOC-BMC-005, LOC-WTB-006, LOC-COP-004, LOC-NNB-006, LOC-NNB-007
hx-loc-checkpoint-s4.Prerequisite Names: Mecanum wheel kinematics; Skid-steer kinematics and effective track width; Calibrate odometry with a square-path test; Wheel suspension to keep traction; Lay out a wheeled base chassis; Fuse wheel odometry with an IMU; Drive a base with BLDC hub motors; Global path planners on costmaps; Autonomous docking to a charger; Measure navigation performance
hx-loc-checkpoint-s4.Skill Description: Locomotion & Balance checkpoint: stage 4 (wheeled base) — Demonstrate the 10 end-of-branch locomotion & balance skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 4 integration milestone.

hx-loc-speed-separation.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-speed-separation.Skill Name: Speed and separation limits near people
hx-loc-speed-separation.Prerequisite Names: Base stopping distance; Robot risk assessment; Proxemics and approach behavior
hx-loc-speed-separation.Skill Description: Speed and separation limits near people — Define speed zones and protective fields so the base slows near people and stops before contact, from stopping distance, sensing range and approach behavior.

hx-loc-collision-monitor.Subject: Costmaps and planning
hx-loc-collision-monitor.Prerequisite Names: Bumpers, cliff sensors and protective stop; Layered costmaps; Speed and separation limits near people
hx-loc-collision-monitor.Skill Description: Independent collision monitor — Add a collision monitor between planner and base that slows or stops on raw sensor points inside configured zones, independent of costmap correctness.

hx-loc-mobile-safety-standards.Subject: Mobile base safety and tip-over
hx-loc-mobile-safety-standards.Prerequisite Names: Write measurable robot requirements; Speed and separation limits near people
hx-loc-mobile-safety-standards.Skill Description: Apply mobile robot safety standards — Extract applicable requirements from mobile robot safety standards such as ISO 3691-4 and ANSI/RIA R15.08 and map them to measurable requirements for the base.

hx-loc-keepout-zones.Subject: Nav2 and navigation behavior
hx-loc-keepout-zones.Prerequisite Names: Autonomous navigation with Nav2; Speed and separation limits near people
hx-loc-keepout-zones.Skill Description: Keepout and speed-limit zones — Draw keepout and speed-limit masks over the map and apply them with costmap filters so the robot avoids stairs and slows in busy areas.

hx-loc-checkpoint-s6.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-loc-checkpoint-s6.Skill Name: Locomotion & Balance checkpoint: stage 6 (humanoid protocol droid)
hx-loc-checkpoint-s6.Prerequisite Codes: LOC-MBS-009, LOC-MBS-010, LOC-NNB-002, LOC-COP-005, LOC-COP-009, LOC-NNB-008, LOC-COP-010, LOC-NNB-009, LOC-MBS-012
hx-loc-checkpoint-s6.Prerequisite Names: Stability-aware base acceleration limits; Verify tip-over margin physically; Cross thresholds and ramps; Mark 3D obstacles for a tall robot; Socially aware navigation; Pass through doorways and narrow gaps; Independent collision monitor; Keepout and speed-limit zones; Apply mobile robot safety standards
hx-loc-checkpoint-s6.Skill Description: Locomotion & Balance checkpoint: stage 6 (humanoid protocol droid) — Demonstrate the 9 end-of-branch locomotion & balance skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 6 integration milestone.

hx-loc-walking-wbc.Subject: Legged control
hx-loc-walking-wbc.Prerequisite Names: Center of mass trajectory from footsteps; Contact force distribution by optimization; Whole-body control with task priorities
hx-loc-walking-wbc.Skill Description: Whole-body walking controller — Combine center of mass or DCM tracking, swing foot tracking, torso posture and contact constraints in a prioritized whole-body controller that outputs joint torques.

hx-loc-checkpoint-s7.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-loc-checkpoint-s7.Prerequisite Names: Push recovery by stepping; Walk on slopes and stairs; Model predictive control for walking; Get up after a fall; Whole-body walking controller
hx-loc-checkpoint-s7.Skill Description: Locomotion & Balance checkpoint: stage 7 (legs) — Demonstrate the 5 end-of-branch locomotion & balance skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 7 integration milestone.

hx-man-arm-dof-count.Subject: Arm configuration
hx-man-arm-dof-count.Skill Name: Degrees of freedom needed for a manipulation task
hx-man-arm-dof-count.Prerequisite Names: Count independent coordinates of an unconstrained serial joint chain; Distinguish configuration, workspace and constraints
hx-man-arm-dof-count.Skill Description: Degrees of freedom needed for a manipulation task — Explain why six independent joints are needed to place a tool at an arbitrary position and orientation, and what fewer or extra joints cost or buy for a given task.

hx-man-joint-layouts.Subject: Arm configuration
hx-man-joint-layouts.Prerequisite Names: Recognize links, joints and constrained motion; Degrees of freedom needed for a manipulation task
hx-man-joint-layouts.Skill Description: Common arm joint layouts — Compare articulated, SCARA, Cartesian and cylindrical arm layouts by workspace shape, stiffness, singularities and suitability for desktop, industrial and humanoid use.

rob3:G01.Subject: Manipulation and combined tasks
rob3:G01.Prerequisite Names: Draw and balance simple planar forces; Apply a stated dry-friction contact model; Calculate a planar moment; Estimate planar gravity holding torque
rob3:G01.Skill Description: Estimate grasp and contact requirements — Estimate grasp and contact requirements

hx-man-reach-workspace-spec.Subject: Arm configuration
hx-man-reach-workspace-spec.Skill Name: Specify reach and workspace from the task envelope
hx-man-reach-workspace-spec.Prerequisite Names: Write measurable robot requirements; Common arm joint layouts
hx-man-reach-workspace-spec.Skill Description: Specify reach and workspace from the task envelope — Derive required arm reach and workspace from table heights, shelf depths and torso position, and express them as measurable requirements a design can be checked against.

hx-man-wrist-types.Subject: Arm configuration
hx-man-wrist-types.Prerequisite Names: Common arm joint layouts; Compare orientation representations
hx-man-wrist-types.Skill Description: Wrist types and wrist offsets — Distinguish spherical, offset and roll-pitch-roll wrists, and explain how intersecting wrist axes simplify inverse kinematics while offset wrists trade that for packaging and range.

hx-man-eoat-overview.Subject: End-effector types
hx-man-eoat-overview.Prerequisite Names: Recognize links, joints and constrained motion; Estimate grasp and contact requirements
hx-man-eoat-overview.Skill Description: End-effector families and task fit — Match parallel-jaw, adaptive, suction, magnetic and multi-finger end-effectors to object shape, material, surface and required precision, stating each family's main failure modes.

hx-man-payload-spec.Subject: Arm configuration
hx-man-payload-spec.Skill Name: Rated payload from joint torque limits
hx-man-payload-spec.Prerequisite Names: Estimate planar gravity holding torque; Specify reach and workspace from the task envelope
hx-man-payload-spec.Skill Description: Rated payload from joint torque limits — Compute the payload an arm can hold at full extension from shoulder and elbow torque limits, link masses and a stated margin, identifying the limiting joint.

hx-man-hand-grasp-taxonomy.Subject: Dexterous hands
hx-man-hand-grasp-taxonomy.Skill Name: Human hand anatomy and grasp taxonomy
hx-man-hand-grasp-taxonomy.Prerequisite Names: Recognize links, joints and constrained motion; End-effector families and task fit
hx-man-hand-grasp-taxonomy.Skill Description: Human hand anatomy and grasp taxonomy — Describe human finger and thumb joints and classify grasps into power, precision and intermediate types to set functional goals for a robot hand.

hx-man-parallel-jaw-mech.Subject: End-effector types
hx-man-parallel-jaw-mech.Prerequisite Names: Calculate transmission ratio and direction; End-effector families and task fit
hx-man-parallel-jaw-mech.Skill Description: Parallel-jaw gripper mechanisms — Explain rack-and-pinion, lead-screw, parallelogram-linkage and cam mechanisms for parallel jaws, comparing stroke, force amplification, backdrivability and part count.

hx-man-contact-models.Subject: Grasp theory
hx-man-contact-models.Prerequisite Names: Apply a stated dry-friction contact model; Represent spatial motion and force
hx-man-contact-models.Skill Description: Contact models for grasping — Distinguish frictionless point, point-with-friction and soft-finger contact models by the forces and torques each can transmit to a grasped object.

hx-man-adaptive-gripper.Subject: End-effector types
hx-man-adaptive-gripper.Prerequisite Names: Force and torque equilibrium; Parallel-jaw gripper mechanisms
hx-man-adaptive-gripper.Skill Description: Adaptive underactuated grippers — Explain how linkage or tendon fingers with fewer motors than joints wrap around irregular objects, and predict when they pinch instead of envelop.

hx-man-suction-cup.Subject: End-effector types
hx-man-suction-cup.Prerequisite Names: Apply a stated design margin; Pressure and hydrostatics; End-effector families and task fit; Holding force from a pressure difference
hx-man-suction-cup.Skill Description: Size a vacuum suction gripper — Calculate holding force from vacuum level and cup area, apply a safety factor for acceleration and peel loads, and choose cup material for porous or curved surfaces.

hx-man-friction-grip-force.Subject: Gripper mechanics and control
hx-man-friction-grip-force.Prerequisite Names: Estimate grasp and contact requirements; Determine the required static-friction force
hx-man-friction-grip-force.Skill Description: Required grip force from friction — Calculate the squeeze force a two-finger friction grasp needs to hold an object's weight, using the friction coefficient and number of contact surfaces.

hx-man-grasp-representation.Subject: Grasp planning
hx-man-grasp-representation.Skill Name: Represent a grasp as gripper pose and width
hx-man-grasp-representation.Prerequisite Names: Apply, compose and invert rigid transforms; Parallel-jaw gripper mechanisms
hx-man-grasp-representation.Skill Description: Represent a grasp as gripper pose and width — Encode a candidate grasp as a six-DOF gripper frame plus opening width and approach axis, and transform it between camera, object and robot base frames.

hx-man-finger-pad-design.Subject: End-effector types
hx-man-finger-pad-design.Skill Name: Design finger pads and jaw geometry
hx-man-finger-pad-design.Prerequisite Names: Apply a stated dry-friction contact model; Parallel-jaw gripper mechanisms; Elastomers and large elastic strain
hx-man-finger-pad-design.Skill Description: Design finger pads and jaw geometry — Choose fingertip shape, V-grooves and compliant elastomer pads to raise effective friction, center parts and tolerate pose error for a given object set.

hx-man-magnetic-gripper.Subject: End-effector types
hx-man-magnetic-gripper.Prerequisite Names: End-effector families and task fit; Magnetic material response; Inductance and stored energy
hx-man-magnetic-gripper.Skill Description: Magnetic and electromagnetic grippers — Explain holding force, air-gap sensitivity, residual magnetism and release behavior of permanent and electromagnetic grippers, and when ferrous-only handling is acceptable.

hx-man-payload-margin.Subject: Gripper mechanics and control
hx-man-payload-margin.Skill Name: Grip margin under acceleration and tilt
hx-man-payload-margin.Prerequisite Names: Newton's second law in components; Inertial forces in a linearly accelerating frame; Torque and lever arms; Required grip force from friction
hx-man-payload-margin.Skill Description: Grip margin under acceleration and tilt — Extend grip-force calculations to include arm acceleration, tilted grasps and torque about the grasp axis from an off-center object, then apply a payload safety factor.

hx-man-friction-cone.Subject: Grasp theory
hx-man-friction-cone.Skill Name: Friction cones and their linear approximation
hx-man-friction-cone.Prerequisite Names: Vector components and arithmetic; Right-triangle trigonometry; Contact models for grasping; Angle of friction and the friction cone
hx-man-friction-cone.Skill Description: Friction cones and their linear approximation — Represent the set of allowable contact forces as a friction cone and approximate it with a polyhedral pyramid of edge vectors for computation.

hx-man-eye-in-hand-vs-to-hand.Subject: Hand-eye calibration and visual servoing
hx-man-eye-in-hand-vs-to-hand.Prerequisite Names: Apply, compose and invert rigid transforms; Pinhole camera model and projection
hx-man-eye-in-hand-vs-to-hand.Skill Description: Eye-in-hand versus eye-to-hand cameras — Compare wrist-mounted and fixed external cameras by field of view, occlusion, calibration chain and accuracy near the grasp, and choose one for a task.

hx-man-pregrasp-pose.Subject: Pick-and-place pipeline
hx-man-pregrasp-pose.Prerequisite Names: Include a fixed tool offset after the final link transform; Represent a grasp as gripper pose and width
hx-man-pregrasp-pose.Skill Description: Approach, pre-grasp and retreat poses — Compute pre-grasp, grasp and retreat poses by offsetting the grasp frame along its approach axis and lifting clear of the support surface.

hx-man-antipodal-grasp.Subject: Grasp theory
hx-man-antipodal-grasp.Prerequisite Names: Dot products and projection; Friction cones and their linear approximation
hx-man-antipodal-grasp.Skill Description: Antipodal grasps for two-finger grippers — Test whether two contact points form an antipodal grasp by checking that the line between them lies inside both friction cones.

hx-man-handeye-ax-xb.Subject: Hand-eye calibration and visual servoing
hx-man-handeye-ax-xb.Prerequisite Names: Compose a chain of labeled rigid transforms in the correct order; Invert a rigid transform while rotating its translation correctly; Eye-in-hand versus eye-to-hand cameras
hx-man-handeye-ax-xb.Skill Description: Hand-eye calibration as AX = XB — Write the transform loop linking robot poses, camera observations of a target and the unknown camera mount, and show why several varied poses are needed.

hx-man-success-rate-ci.Subject: Policy evaluation
hx-man-success-rate-ci.Prerequisite Names: Bernoulli and binomial models; Confidence intervals
hx-man-success-rate-ci.Skill Description: Success rates with confidence intervals — Estimate a task success rate from repeated trials with a binomial confidence interval, and decide how many trials are needed to compare two systems.

hx-man-tipover-check.Subject: Mobile manipulation
hx-man-tipover-check.Skill Name: Tip-over check when reaching from a wheeled base
hx-man-tipover-check.Prerequisite Names: Check mobile stability and traction; Rated payload from joint torque limits; Static stability and the support polygon
hx-man-tipover-check.Skill Description: Tip-over check when reaching from a wheeled base — Check that the combined center of mass of base, torso, arm and payload stays inside the support polygon with margin at full reach and during braking.

hx-man-place-pose.Subject: Pick-and-place pipeline
hx-man-place-pose.Prerequisite Names: Center of mass; Approach, pre-grasp and retreat poses; Static stability and the support polygon; Tipping versus slipping of a pushed body
hx-man-place-pose.Skill Description: Compute a stable place pose — Choose a place pose that puts the object upright on a support surface with its center of mass over the base, a small release height and a clear retreat path.

hx-man-tactile-sensors.Subject: Force and tactile sensing
hx-man-tactile-sensors.Prerequisite Names: Contact models for grasping; Capacitance and stored energy; Hall-effect sensing
hx-man-tactile-sensors.Skill Description: Tactile sensor technologies — Compare resistive, capacitive, magnetic and camera-based tactile sensors by spatial resolution, bandwidth, durability, wiring and what contact information each provides.

hx-man-hand-eye-calibration.Subject: Hand-eye calibration and visual servoing
hx-man-hand-eye-calibration.Prerequisite Names: Hand-eye calibration as AX = XB; Calibrate a camera; Detect fiducial markers (AprilTag, ArUco); Broadcast and look up transforms with tf2
hx-man-hand-eye-calibration.Skill Description: Hand-eye calibration — Collect robot poses with fiducial observations, solve for the camera-to-gripper or camera-to-base transform, publish it as a static transform, and verify it with tool-tip touch-off tests.

hx-man-tool-changer.Subject: End-effector types
hx-man-tool-changer.Prerequisite Names: End-effector families and task fit; Size and design a bolted joint; Build a wiring harness with crimped connectors
hx-man-tool-changer.Skill Description: Tool changers and end-effector interfaces — Specify a standard tool flange, locking mechanism and power and signal pass-through so an arm can swap end-effectors repeatably and safely.

hx-man-wrist-ft-sensor.Subject: Force and tactile sensing
hx-man-wrist-ft-sensor.Prerequisite Names: Represent spatial motion and force; Resistive bridge sensing
hx-man-wrist-ft-sensor.Skill Description: Six-axis wrist force-torque sensors — Explain how strain-gauge bridges and a calibration matrix give six-axis force and torque, and read range, resolution, overload and noise specifications.

hx-man-ft-gravity-comp.Subject: Force and tactile sensing
hx-man-ft-gravity-comp.Skill Name: Remove bias and tool gravity from force-torque data
hx-man-ft-gravity-comp.Prerequisite Names: Linear least-squares fitting; Torque and lever arms; Compare orientation representations; Six-axis wrist force-torque sensors
hx-man-ft-gravity-comp.Skill Description: Remove bias and tool gravity from force-torque data — Identify tool mass, center of mass and sensor bias from several static orientations, subtract them, and transform the remaining contact wrench to the tool tip frame.

hx-man-contact-detection-ft.Subject: Force and tactile sensing
hx-man-contact-detection-ft.Prerequisite Names: Normal distributions and standard scores; Passive low-pass filters; Remove bias and tool gravity from force-torque data
hx-man-contact-detection-ft.Skill Description: Detect contact from force thresholds — Detect the moment of contact from compensated force signals using filtered thresholds set from measured noise, balancing missed contacts against false alarms.

hx-man-gripper-actuator-sizing.Subject: Gripper mechanics and control
hx-man-gripper-actuator-sizing.Skill Name: Size a gripper actuator and transmission
hx-man-gripper-actuator-sizing.Prerequisite Names: Parallel-jaw gripper mechanisms; Forces in multi-member frames and machines; Grip margin under acceleration and tilt; Gear ratio trade-off between torque and speed
hx-man-gripper-actuator-sizing.Skill Description: Size a gripper actuator and transmission — Work back from required jaw force through the gripper mechanism's mechanical advantage to motor torque, and decide whether the drive should self-lock on power loss.

hx-man-grasp-from-pointcloud.Subject: Grasp planning
hx-man-grasp-from-pointcloud.Skill Name: Sample antipodal grasps from a point cloud
hx-man-grasp-from-pointcloud.Prerequisite Names: Represent a grasp as gripper pose and width; Antipodal grasps for two-finger grippers; Build and process point clouds from depth
hx-man-grasp-from-pointcloud.Skill Description: Sample antipodal grasps from a point cloud — Estimate surface normals in a segmented point cloud, sample point pairs that satisfy antipodal conditions, and convert them into six-DOF grasp candidates.

hx-man-grasp-matrix.Subject: Grasp theory
hx-man-grasp-matrix.Prerequisite Names: Matrix arithmetic; Represent spatial motion and force; Friction cones and their linear approximation; Reduce a 3D force system to a force and couple
hx-man-grasp-matrix.Skill Description: Grasp matrix and contact wrenches — Build the grasp matrix that maps contact forces to the net wrench on an object, using contact positions, normals and the chosen contact model.

hx-man-form-closure.Subject: Grasp theory
hx-man-form-closure.Prerequisite Names: Span and linear independence; Grasp matrix and contact wrenches
hx-man-form-closure.Skill Description: Form closure — Determine whether a set of frictionless contacts geometrically immobilizes an object, and count the minimum contacts needed in the plane and in space.

hx-man-force-closure.Subject: Grasp theory
hx-man-force-closure.Skill Description: Force closure — Test whether frictional contacts can resist any external wrench by checking that contact wrench cones positively span wrench space.

hx-man-grasp-quality.Subject: Grasp theory
hx-man-grasp-quality.Skill Description: Grasp quality metrics — Compute and compare grasp quality measures such as the largest-minimum-resisted-wrench epsilon metric, wrench-space volume and grasp-matrix singular values.

rob3:G03.Subject: Manipulation and combined tasks
rob3:G03.Prerequisite Names: Create an assembly with defined motion; Implement general serial-arm forward kinematics
rob3:G03.Skill Description: Represent collision geometry and clearance — Represent collision geometry and clearance

hx-man-anthro-7dof.Subject: Arm configuration
hx-man-anthro-7dof.Prerequisite Names: Wrist types and wrist offsets; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-man-anthro-7dof.Skill Description: Anthropomorphic 7-DOF arm layout — Describe the shoulder-elbow-wrist layout of a human-like seven-joint arm, its elbow swivel angle, joint ranges and why it suits a humanoid working in human spaces.

hx-man-two-arm-kinematics.Subject: Bimanual manipulation
hx-man-two-arm-kinematics.Skill Name: Two-arm kinematics in a shared torso frame
hx-man-two-arm-kinematics.Prerequisite Names: Write a URDF robot description; Broadcast and look up transforms with tf2; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-man-two-arm-kinematics.Skill Description: Two-arm kinematics in a shared torso frame — Model both arms in one robot description with a common torso frame, and compute the relative pose between the two hands.

hx-man-finger-kinematics.Subject: Dexterous hands
hx-man-finger-kinematics.Prerequisite Names: Calculate position and orientation of an ideal two-revolute-link planar arm; Human hand anatomy and grasp taxonomy; Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
hx-man-finger-kinematics.Skill Description: Finger kinematics — Compute fingertip position from MCP, PIP and DIP joint angles, including coupled distal joints, and map each finger's reachable workspace.

rob3:G04.Subject: Manipulation and combined tasks
rob3:G04.Skill Name: Plan and time an arm motion
rob3:G04.Prerequisite Names: Generate bounded joint trajectories; Represent collision geometry and clearance; Solve numerical inverse kinematics
rob3:G04.Skill Description: Plan and time an arm motion — Plan and time an arm motion

rob3:G07.Subject: Manipulation and combined tasks
rob3:G07.Skill Name: Select a mobile base pose for reaching
rob3:G07.Prerequisite Names: Check mobile stability and traction; Localize against a known map; Represent collision geometry and clearance; Solve numerical inverse kinematics
rob3:G07.Skill Description: Select a mobile base pose for reaching — Select a mobile base pose for reaching

rob3:G05.Subject: Manipulation and combined tasks
rob3:G05.Skill Name: Transform perception into a grasp target
rob3:G05.Prerequisite Names: Estimate grasp and contact requirements; Estimate a known object's pose; Identify robot calibration parameters; Solve numerical inverse kinematics
rob3:G05.Skill Description: Transform perception into a grasp target — Transform perception into a grasp target

hx-man-closed-chain-constraint.Subject: Bimanual manipulation
hx-man-closed-chain-constraint.Skill Name: Closed-chain constraint of a shared object
hx-man-closed-chain-constraint.Prerequisite Names: Grasp matrix and contact wrenches; Manipulator Jacobian; Two-arm kinematics in a shared torso frame
hx-man-closed-chain-constraint.Skill Description: Closed-chain constraint of a shared object — Derive the constraint that keeps both hands' relative pose fixed when they rigidly hold one object, and compute compatible joint velocities for both arms.

hx-man-linkage-finger.Subject: Dexterous hands
hx-man-linkage-finger.Prerequisite Names: Build a CAD assembly with mates and motion; Finger kinematics
hx-man-linkage-finger.Skill Description: Linkage-driven finger design — Design a four-bar or multi-bar linkage that couples finger joints to one actuator, and check the resulting curl trajectory and fingertip force.

hx-man-thumb-opposition.Subject: Dexterous hands
hx-man-thumb-opposition.Skill Description: Thumb opposition and placement — Choose thumb base location and joint axes so the thumb tip can oppose each fingertip, and check opposition reach with a kinematic model.

hx-man-pbvs.Subject: Hand-eye calibration and visual servoing
hx-man-pbvs.Skill Description: Position-based visual servoing — Close a feedback loop that drives the gripper toward a target pose estimated by the camera each frame, correcting calibration and model errors.

hx-man-topdown-grasp-detections.Subject: Grasp planning
hx-man-topdown-grasp-detections.Skill Name: Top-down grasps from 2D detections and depth
hx-man-topdown-grasp-detections.Prerequisite Names: Represent a grasp as gripper pose and width; Build and process point clouds from depth; Transform perception into a grasp target; Detect objects with a neural network detector
hx-man-topdown-grasp-detections.Skill Description: Top-down grasps from 2D detections and depth — Turn a detected object's mask and depth into a top-down grasp by finding its center, principal axis yaw, height and required jaw width.

hx-man-grasp-filter-rank.Subject: Grasp planning
hx-man-grasp-filter-rank.Prerequisite Names: Sample antipodal grasps from a point cloud; Represent collision geometry and clearance; Numerical inverse kinematics
hx-man-grasp-filter-rank.Skill Description: Filter and rank grasp candidates — Reject grasps whose gripper collides with the scene or has no inverse-kinematics solution, then rank survivors by quality, approach direction and joint-limit margin.

hx-man-cartesian-approach.Subject: Pick-and-place pipeline
hx-man-cartesian-approach.Prerequisite Names: Generate smooth joint trajectories; Approach, pre-grasp and retreat poses; Numerical inverse kinematics
hx-man-cartesian-approach.Skill Description: Straight-line Cartesian approach moves — Interpolate gripper poses along a straight line, solve inverse kinematics at each step, and reject paths with joint jumps, limit violations or singularities.

hx-man-teleop-mappings.Subject: Teleoperation
hx-man-teleop-mappings.Prerequisite Names: Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms; Numerical inverse kinematics
hx-man-teleop-mappings.Skill Description: Teleoperation mappings — Compare joint-space mapping from a matching leader arm with Cartesian mapping from a pose device, including frame alignment and workspace scaling.

hx-man-dual-arm-collision.Subject: Bimanual manipulation
hx-man-dual-arm-collision.Prerequisite Names: Two-arm kinematics in a shared torso frame; Collision-free arm motion planning
hx-man-dual-arm-collision.Skill Description: Plan dual-arm motion without self-collision — Plan motions for both arms together so they avoid each other, the torso and the head while meeting timing for coordinated tasks.

hx-man-guarded-move.Subject: Contact-rich manipulation
hx-man-guarded-move.Skill Name: Guarded moves that stop on contact
hx-man-guarded-move.Prerequisite Names: Detect contact from force thresholds; Straight-line Cartesian approach moves
hx-man-guarded-move.Skill Description: Guarded moves that stop on contact — Move slowly toward an expected surface and stop or switch behavior when contact is detected, to locate tables, buttons and object tops reliably.

hx-man-task-oriented-grasp.Subject: Grasp planning
hx-man-task-oriented-grasp.Skill Description: Task-oriented grasp selection — Choose where to grasp an object based on what happens next, such as holding a mug by the body to pour or by the handle to hand it over.

hx-man-leader-follower.Subject: Teleoperation
hx-man-leader-follower.Prerequisite Names: Convert encoder counts to joint motion; Command and read a smart serial bus servo; Teleoperation mappings
hx-man-leader-follower.Skill Description: Build a leader-follower arm pair — Assemble and calibrate a leader-follower arm pair such as LeRobot SO-101, aligning joint zeros and directions so the follower mirrors the leader.

hx-man-vr-teleop.Subject: Teleoperation
hx-man-vr-teleop.Skill Name: Teleoperate with a VR headset and controllers
hx-man-vr-teleop.Prerequisite Names: Compare orientation representations; Broadcast and look up transforms with tf2; Teleoperation mappings
hx-man-vr-teleop.Skill Description: Teleoperate with a VR headset and controllers — Stream VR controller poses into the robot frame, map them to hand targets through inverse kinematics, and add deadman switches and workspace limits.

hx-man-hand-retargeting.Subject: Teleoperation
hx-man-hand-retargeting.Skill Name: Retarget human hand motion to a robot hand
hx-man-hand-retargeting.Prerequisite Names: Finger kinematics; Teleoperate with a VR headset and controllers
hx-man-hand-retargeting.Skill Description: Retarget human hand motion to a robot hand — Map data-glove or camera hand-tracking joint angles to a robot hand with different proportions, preserving fingertip contact and pinch distances.

hx-man-teleoperation.Subject: Teleoperation
hx-man-teleoperation.Skill Name: Teleoperate an arm to record demonstrations
hx-man-teleoperation.Prerequisite Names: Logging and recorded data; Timestamps and clock synchronization; Build a leader-follower arm pair
hx-man-teleoperation.Skill Description: Teleoperate an arm to record demonstrations — Teleoperate an arm through a task smoothly while synchronously recording camera images, joint states and commanded actions with consistent timestamps.

hx-man-episode-structure.Subject: Demonstration data
hx-man-episode-structure.Prerequisite Names: Datasets, features, and labels; Teleoperate an arm to record demonstrations
hx-man-episode-structure.Skill Description: Structure a demonstration episode — Define an episode's observations, actions, timestamps, task label and success flag, and store it in a standard format such as a LeRobot dataset.

hx-man-dataset-hygiene.Subject: Demonstration data
hx-man-dataset-hygiene.Skill Name: Audit and clean a demonstration dataset
hx-man-dataset-hygiene.Prerequisite Names: Prevent train-test leakage; Align and timestamp sensor streams; Structure a demonstration episode
hx-man-dataset-hygiene.Skill Description: Audit and clean a demonstration dataset — Find dropped frames, timestamp drift, failed or inconsistent episodes and camera changes, then split train and validation by session to avoid leakage.

hx-man-action-spaces.Subject: Demonstration data
hx-man-action-spaces.Prerequisite Names: Feature scaling and preprocessing; Structure a demonstration episode
hx-man-action-spaces.Skill Description: Choose observation and action spaces — Choose between absolute joint, delta joint and end-effector actions, select camera views and proprioception, and normalize them consistently for training.

hx-man-demo-protocol.Subject: Demonstration data
hx-man-demo-protocol.Prerequisite Names: Record a reproducible procedure; Sampling and bias; Structure a demonstration episode
hx-man-demo-protocol.Skill Description: Write a demonstration collection protocol — Plan how many episodes to record, how to vary object poses, lighting and distractors, and how operators keep a consistent strategy.

hx-man-behavior-cloning.Subject: Imitation learning
hx-man-behavior-cloning.Prerequisite Names: Train and evaluate a supervised model; Define and evaluate an imitation-learning task; Choose observation and action spaces
hx-man-behavior-cloning.Skill Description: Behavior cloning as supervised learning — Train a policy that regresses demonstrated actions from observations, and explain why compounding error and covariate shift make low validation loss a weak predictor of task success.

hx-man-multimodal-actions.Subject: Imitation learning
hx-man-multimodal-actions.Prerequisite Names: Continuous probability densities; Behavior cloning as supervised learning
hx-man-multimodal-actions.Skill Description: Multimodal action distributions — Explain why averaging demonstrations that pass left or right of an obstacle produces a colliding action, and which policy classes model several modes.

hx-man-act-policy.Subject: Imitation learning
hx-man-act-policy.Prerequisite Names: Train a neural network in PyTorch; Transformer architecture and attention; Multimodal action distributions
hx-man-act-policy.Skill Description: Action chunking with transformers — Train an ACT policy that predicts chunks of future actions with a transformer and temporal ensembling, and tune chunk size and inputs.

hx-man-diffusion-policy.Subject: Imitation learning
hx-man-diffusion-policy.Prerequisite Names: Train a neural network in PyTorch; Convolutional neural networks; Multimodal action distributions
hx-man-diffusion-policy.Skill Description: Diffusion policy for visuomotor control — Train a policy that generates action sequences by iterative denoising conditioned on images, and trade denoising steps against control latency.

hx-man-imitation-policy.Subject: Imitation learning
hx-man-imitation-policy.Prerequisite Names: Audit and clean a demonstration dataset; Action chunking with transformers
hx-man-imitation-policy.Skill Description: Train an imitation-learning manipulation policy — Collect, clean and train on demonstrations for a real manipulation task, then deploy the policy and iterate until it meets a stated success target.

hx-man-eval-protocol.Subject: Policy evaluation
hx-man-eval-protocol.Skill Name: Design a fair manipulation evaluation protocol
hx-man-eval-protocol.Prerequisite Names: Success rates with confidence intervals; Train an imitation-learning manipulation policy
hx-man-eval-protocol.Skill Description: Design a fair manipulation evaluation protocol — Fix initial conditions, trial counts, success criteria and partial-credit rubrics so different policies or pipelines are compared on equal terms.

hx-man-tendon-finger.Subject: Dexterous hands
hx-man-tendon-finger.Prerequisite Names: Finger kinematics; Tendon and cable drive for fingers
hx-man-tendon-finger.Skill Description: Tendon-driven finger design — Design tendon routing, pulley radii and return springs or antagonist tendons, and compute joint torques from tendon tension and moment arms.

rob3:G02.Subject: Manipulation and combined tasks
rob3:G02.Skill Name: Design and build a simple gripper
rob3:G02.Prerequisite Names: Estimate grasp and contact requirements; Assemble and inspect a joint module; Match a motor to its driver
rob3:G02.Skill Description: Design and build a simple gripper — Design and build a simple gripper

hx-man-generalization-tests.Subject: Policy evaluation
hx-man-generalization-tests.Prerequisite Names: Overfitting, underfitting, and regularization; Design a fair manipulation evaluation protocol
hx-man-generalization-tests.Skill Description: Test generalization of manipulation policies — Measure performance on unseen object instances, positions, lighting and backgrounds, separating in-distribution from out-of-distribution results.

hx-man-hand-sensing.Subject: Dexterous hands
hx-man-hand-sensing.Prerequisite Names: Tactile sensor technologies; Tendon-driven finger design
hx-man-hand-sensing.Skill Description: Sensing in a robot hand — Select and integrate joint-angle, motor-current, tendon-tension and fingertip tactile sensing within the wiring and space limits of a compact hand.

hx-man-underactuated-finger.Subject: Dexterous hands
hx-man-underactuated-finger.Prerequisite Names: Ideal springs and restoring forces; Adaptive underactuated grippers; Tendon-driven finger design
hx-man-underactuated-finger.Skill Description: Underactuated fingers and differentials — Use springs and differential mechanisms so fewer actuators drive more joints, and predict how fingers adapt their shape to objects of different sizes.

rob3:G06.Subject: Manipulation and combined tasks
rob3:G06.Prerequisite Names: Implement a robot behavior state machine; Plan and time an arm motion; Transform perception into a grasp target; Design and build a simple gripper; Coordinate multiple joint controllers
rob3:G06.Skill Description: Coordinate a pick-and-place task — Coordinate a pick-and-place task

rob3:G08.Subject: Manipulation and combined tasks
rob3:G08.Prerequisite Names: Define subsystem interfaces; Select a mobile base pose for reaching; Coordinate a pick-and-place task; Respond to changing obstacles
rob3:G08.Skill Description: Coordinate navigation and manipulation — Coordinate navigation and manipulation

hx-man-arm-config-tradeoff.Subject: Arm configuration
hx-man-arm-config-tradeoff.Skill Name: Choose a humanoid arm configuration under budgets
hx-man-arm-config-tradeoff.Prerequisite Names: Rated payload from joint torque limits; Anthropomorphic 7-DOF arm layout; Design a lightweight robot arm structure; Mass, power, compute and latency budgets
hx-man-arm-config-tradeoff.Skill Description: Choose a humanoid arm configuration under budgets — Select joint count, wrist type, link lengths and actuator placement for a humanoid arm by trading reach, payload, mass, cost and inertia against written requirements.

hx-man-gripper-position-control.Subject: Gripper mechanics and control
hx-man-gripper-position-control.Prerequisite Names: Parallel-jaw gripper mechanisms; Command and read a smart serial bus servo; Tune PID position control of a joint
hx-man-gripper-position-control.Skill Description: Position-controlled gripper opening and closing — Calibrate jaw opening against motor position and command target widths with a servo or PID loop, handling the stall that occurs when jaws meet an object.

hx-man-gripper-force-control.Subject: Gripper mechanics and control
hx-man-gripper-force-control.Prerequisite Names: Model a brushed DC motor with torque and back-EMF constants; Size a gripper actuator and transmission; Position-controlled gripper opening and closing
hx-man-gripper-force-control.Skill Description: Force-limited gripping through current limits — Convert a desired jaw force into a motor current or torque limit and close the gripper under that limit so fragile objects are not crushed.

hx-man-dexterous-hand.Subject: Dexterous hands
hx-man-dexterous-hand.Prerequisite Codes: MAN-DEH-003, MAN-DEH-004, SYS-ADP-009, MAN-DEH-006, MAN-DEH-007, MAN-GMC-005
hx-man-dexterous-hand.Prerequisite Names: Linkage-driven finger design; Thumb opposition and placement; Develop compliant or dexterous manipulation; Sensing in a robot hand; Underactuated fingers and differentials; Force-limited gripping through current limits
hx-man-dexterous-hand.Skill Description: Dexterous multi-finger hand — Design, build and control a multi-finger hand with an opposable thumb, then execute power, pinch and tripod grasps under force limits to meet grasp and payload goals.

hx-man-slip-detection.Subject: Force and tactile sensing
hx-man-slip-detection.Prerequisite Names: Friction cones and their linear approximation; Tactile sensor technologies; Force-limited gripping through current limits
hx-man-slip-detection.Skill Description: Detect and react to slip — Detect incipient slip from tangential-to-normal force ratio or vibration signals and respond by increasing grip force before the object moves.

hx-man-grasp-detection.Subject: Gripper mechanics and control
hx-man-grasp-detection.Skill Name: Detect a successful grasp from width and current
hx-man-grasp-detection.Prerequisite Names: Implement a robot behavior state machine; Force-limited gripping through current limits
hx-man-grasp-detection.Skill Description: Detect a successful grasp from width and current — Classify a closing event as holding, missed or dropped from final jaw width, motor current and their change over time, and choose robust thresholds.

hx-man-in-hand-manipulation.Subject: Dexterous hands
hx-man-in-hand-manipulation.Prerequisite Names: Grasp matrix and contact wrenches; Dexterous multi-finger hand; Detect and react to slip
hx-man-in-hand-manipulation.Skill Description: In-hand manipulation — Reposition an object within the hand by finger gaiting, rolling and controlled sliding, keeping the grasp stable while contacts change.

hx-man-motor-current-force-est.Subject: Force and tactile sensing
hx-man-motor-current-force-est.Skill Name: Estimate external force from joint currents
hx-man-motor-current-force-est.Prerequisite Names: Model a brushed DC motor with torque and back-EMF constants; Manipulator Jacobian; Rigid-body dynamics of a manipulator
hx-man-motor-current-force-est.Skill Description: Estimate external force from joint currents — Estimate external joint torques from motor currents minus modeled gravity and friction, then map them to an end-effector force with the Jacobian transpose.

hx-man-parallel-gripper.Subject: Gripper mechanics and control
hx-man-parallel-gripper.Skill Name: Design and control a parallel-jaw gripper
hx-man-parallel-gripper.Prerequisite Names: Design finger pads and jaw geometry; Design and print functional parts with tolerances; Size a gripper actuator and transmission; Design and build a simple gripper; Detect a successful grasp from width and current
hx-man-parallel-gripper.Skill Description: Design and control a parallel-jaw gripper — Design, print, assemble and wire a servo-driven parallel-jaw gripper, then command width and force and report grasp status to the arm controller.

hx-man-pick-state-machine.Subject: Pick-and-place pipeline
hx-man-pick-state-machine.Skill Name: Sequence a pick as a state machine
hx-man-pick-state-machine.Prerequisite Names: Implement a robot behavior state machine; Straight-line Cartesian approach moves; Detect a successful grasp from width and current
hx-man-pick-state-machine.Skill Description: Sequence a pick as a state machine — Implement pick as perceive, plan, approach, grasp, verify and lift states with explicit failure transitions and timeouts at every step.

hx-man-internal-force.Subject: Bimanual manipulation
hx-man-internal-force.Skill Name: Internal squeeze force in two-hand grasps
hx-man-internal-force.Prerequisite Names: Closed-chain constraint of a shared object; Impedance control
hx-man-internal-force.Skill Description: Internal squeeze force in two-hand grasps — Separate the wrench that moves a jointly held object from the internal squeeze force, and regulate squeeze with compliance so the object is neither dropped nor crushed.

hx-man-checkpoint-s3.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-man-checkpoint-s3.Prerequisite Names: Size a vacuum suction gripper; Write a demonstration collection protocol; Design and control a parallel-jaw gripper
hx-man-checkpoint-s3.Skill Description: Manipulation & Hands checkpoint: stage 3 (robot arm) — Demonstrate the 3 end-of-branch manipulation & hands skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 3 integration milestone.

hx-man-admittance-control.Subject: Contact-rich manipulation
hx-man-admittance-control.Skill Name: Admittance control for a position-controlled arm
hx-man-admittance-control.Prerequisite Names: Remove bias and tool gravity from force-torque data; Impedance control
hx-man-admittance-control.Skill Description: Admittance control for a position-controlled arm — Convert measured contact forces into small position or velocity offsets so a stiff, position-controlled arm behaves like a tunable spring and damper.

hx-man-collision-reaction.Subject: Human-safe manipulation
hx-man-collision-reaction.Prerequisite Names: Implement bounded fault response; Design an emergency stop and safe power-off circuit; Estimate external force from joint currents
hx-man-collision-reaction.Skill Description: Detect collisions and react safely — Detect unexpected arm contact from joint torque residuals and choose a safe reaction such as stopping, retracting or switching to compliant mode.

hx-man-pick-place.Subject: Pick-and-place pipeline
hx-man-pick-place.Prerequisite Names: Compute a stable place pose; Hand-eye calibration; Top-down grasps from 2D detections and depth; Coordinate a pick-and-place task; Sequence a pick as a state machine
hx-man-pick-place.Skill Description: Vision-guided pick-and-place — Integrate detection, hand-eye transforms, grasp selection, motion and gripper control so a desktop arm picks named objects and places them at target locations.

hx-man-bimanual.Subject: Bimanual manipulation
hx-man-bimanual.Prerequisite Names: Plan dual-arm motion without self-collision; Internal squeeze force in two-hand grasps
hx-man-bimanual.Skill Description: Bimanual coordination — Classify two-handed tasks as independent, asymmetric or shared-object, and coordinate two arms on them, such as holding a jar while opening it or lifting a tray, with synchronized timing and force control.

hx-man-peg-in-hole.Subject: Contact-rich manipulation
hx-man-peg-in-hole.Prerequisite Names: Fits, tolerances, and datum references; Guarded moves that stop on contact; Admittance control for a position-controlled arm
hx-man-peg-in-hole.Skill Description: Compliant peg-in-hole insertion — Insert a peg into a close-fitting hole using chamfers, compliance and spiral search, and diagnose jamming and wedging from force readings.

hx-man-open-door-drawer.Subject: Contact-rich manipulation
hx-man-open-door-drawer.Prerequisite Names: Recognize links, joints and constrained motion; Linear least-squares fitting; Sequence a pick as a state machine; Admittance control for a position-controlled arm
hx-man-open-door-drawer.Skill Description: Open doors and drawers — Model a door as a revolute and a drawer as a prismatic constraint, grasp the handle, and pull compliantly while estimating the hinge axis or slide direction online.

hx-man-tool-use.Subject: Contact-rich manipulation
hx-man-tool-use.Prerequisite Names: Include a fixed tool offset after the final link transform; Task-oriented grasp selection; Admittance control for a position-controlled arm
hx-man-tool-use.Skill Description: Use a held tool — Define a tool frame for a grasped tool, apply controlled contact forces at its tip, and perform tasks such as wiping, pressing or scooping.

hx-man-place-accuracy.Subject: Pick-and-place pipeline
hx-man-place-accuracy.Skill Name: Place objects accurately with an error budget
hx-man-place-accuracy.Prerequisite Names: Tolerance stack analysis; Evaluate accuracy and repeatability; Vision-guided pick-and-place
hx-man-place-accuracy.Skill Description: Place objects accurately with an error budget — Budget placement error from calibration, perception, grasp offset and slip, then reduce it by re-measuring the object pose in the hand before placing.

hx-man-two-hand-carry.Subject: Bimanual manipulation
hx-man-two-hand-carry.Skill Name: Carry an object with two hands
hx-man-two-hand-carry.Prerequisite Names: Grip margin under acceleration and tilt; Bimanual coordination
hx-man-two-hand-carry.Skill Description: Carry an object with two hands — Lift and carry a box or tray with both hands, checking combined payload, squeeze margin and level orientation while the torso or base moves.

hx-man-collab-safety-modes.Subject: Human-safe manipulation
hx-man-collab-safety-modes.Prerequisite Names: Identify hazards and protective functions; Robot risk assessment
hx-man-collab-safety-modes.Skill Description: Collaborative robot safety modes — Explain safety-rated monitored stop, hand guiding, speed and separation monitoring, and power and force limiting as defined for collaborative robots in ISO 10218 and ISO/TS 15066.

hx-man-pfl-limits.Subject: Human-safe manipulation
hx-man-pfl-limits.Skill Name: Power and force limits for human contact
hx-man-pfl-limits.Prerequisite Names: Kinetic energy and work-energy balance; Collision models; Peak impact force from contact stiffness; Effective mass of an arm at a contact point; Collaborative robot safety modes
hx-man-pfl-limits.Skill Description: Power and force limits for human contact — Estimate an arm's effective moving mass and permissible speed so a possible contact with each body region stays within published force and pressure limits.

hx-man-speed-separation.Subject: Human-safe manipulation
hx-man-speed-separation.Prerequisite Names: Constant-acceleration motion; Detect and track people and faces; Collaborative robot safety modes
hx-man-speed-separation.Skill Description: Speed and separation monitoring — Compute a protective separation distance from human and robot speeds, reaction and stopping times, and slow or stop the arm when a person comes closer.

hx-man-policy-deployment.Subject: Imitation learning
hx-man-policy-deployment.Skill Name: Run a learned policy on the robot safely
hx-man-policy-deployment.Prerequisite Names: Deploy models on edge hardware; Train an imitation-learning manipulation policy; Guardrails on AI-commanded robot actions
hx-man-policy-deployment.Skill Description: Run a learned policy on the robot safely — Run policy inference at control rate on robot hardware with action clipping, workspace limits and a human stop, logging every rollout for review.

hx-man-checkpoint-s5.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-man-checkpoint-s5.Prerequisite Codes: MAN-EET-006, MAN-MOM-001, MAN-EET-007, MAN-GRT-007, MAN-HEC-004, MAN-IML-004, MAN-POE-003, MAN-CRM-003, MAN-PPP-006, MAN-IML-006
hx-man-checkpoint-s5.Prerequisite Names: Magnetic and electromagnetic grippers; Tip-over check when reaching from a wheeled base; Tool changers and end-effector interfaces; Grasp quality metrics; Position-based visual servoing; Diffusion policy for visuomotor control; Test generalization of manipulation policies; Compliant peg-in-hole insertion; Place objects accurately with an error budget; Run a learned policy on the robot safely
hx-man-checkpoint-s5.Skill Description: Manipulation & Hands checkpoint: stage 5 (mobile manipulator) — Demonstrate the 10 end-of-branch manipulation & hands skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 5 integration milestone.

hx-man-stationary-base-manip.Subject: Mobile manipulation
hx-man-stationary-base-manip.Prerequisite Names: Coordinate navigation and manipulation; Vision-guided pick-and-place; Autonomous navigation with Nav2
hx-man-stationary-base-manip.Skill Description: Manipulate with the base stationary — Navigate to a base pose, stop and hold position, re-perceive the target from the new viewpoint, then pick or place before moving again.

hx-man-handover.Subject: Human-safe manipulation
hx-man-handover.Skill Name: Hand objects to and from a person
hx-man-handover.Prerequisite Names: Legible and predictable robot motion; Detect contact from force thresholds; Task-oriented grasp selection; Speed and separation monitoring; Proxemics and approach behavior
hx-man-handover.Skill Description: Hand objects to and from a person — Offer an object at a reachable, legible pose, release only when the person's pull is sensed, and receive objects by tracking the hand and confirming the grasp.

hx-man-moving-base-manip.Subject: Mobile manipulation
hx-man-moving-base-manip.Skill Name: Reach while the base is moving
hx-man-moving-base-manip.Prerequisite Names: Manipulate with the base stationary; Coordinate base and arm motion simultaneously; Whole-body control with task priorities
hx-man-moving-base-manip.Skill Description: Reach while the base is moving — Coordinate base and arm motion so the hand tracks a target while the base moves, accounting for base odometry error and arm workspace limits.

hx-man-checkpoint-s6.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-man-checkpoint-s6.Skill Name: Manipulation & Hands checkpoint: stage 6 (humanoid protocol droid)
hx-man-checkpoint-s6.Prerequisite Codes: MAN-TEL-004, MAN-ARC-007, MAN-DEH-009, MAN-HSM-001, MAN-CRM-004, MAN-CRM-005, MAN-BIM-006, MAN-HSM-003, MAN-HSM-005, MAN-MOM-003
hx-man-checkpoint-s6.Prerequisite Names: Retarget human hand motion to a robot hand; Choose a humanoid arm configuration under budgets; In-hand manipulation; Detect collisions and react safely; Open doors and drawers; Use a held tool; Carry an object with two hands; Power and force limits for human contact; Hand objects to and from a person; Reach while the base is moving
hx-man-checkpoint-s6.Skill Description: Manipulation & Hands checkpoint: stage 6 (humanoid protocol droid) — Demonstrate the 10 end-of-branch manipulation & hands skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 6 integration milestone.

hx-per-sensor-transfer-function.Subject: Sensor fundamentals
hx-per-sensor-transfer-function.Skill Name: Sensor transfer function, range and sensitivity
hx-per-sensor-transfer-function.Prerequisite Names: Distinguish accuracy from precision; Interpreting physical graphs
hx-per-sensor-transfer-function.Skill Description: Sensor transfer function, range and sensitivity — Read a sensor's transfer curve to state its measurement range, sensitivity, offset and saturation limits, and convert raw readings into physical units.

hx-per-noise-characterization.Subject: Sensor fundamentals
hx-per-noise-characterization.Skill Name: Measure a sensor noise floor from a static log
hx-per-noise-characterization.Prerequisite Names: Distinguish random and systematic measurement errors; Sensor transfer function, range and sensitivity; Interpret an empirical noise distribution
hx-per-noise-characterization.Skill Description: Measure a sensor noise floor from a static log — Record a stationary sensor, compute mean, standard deviation and histogram of the readings, and separate random noise from offset and slow drift.

hx-per-smoothing-filters.Subject: Sensor fundamentals
hx-per-smoothing-filters.Skill Name: Smooth sensor data with averaging and median filters
hx-per-smoothing-filters.Prerequisite Names: Mean, median, and mode; Numerical arrays and vectorized computation; Measure a sensor noise floor from a static log

hx-per-audio-capture-linux.Subject: Audio perception
