hx-per-audio-capture-linux.Skill Description: Capture audio on Linux — Capture multichannel audio with ALSA or PipeWire, select devices, set buffer sizes, and measure capture latency and dropouts.

hx-per-mic-array-geometry.Subject: Audio perception
hx-per-mic-array-geometry.Skill Name: Microphone array geometry and time differences
hx-per-mic-array-geometry.Prerequisite Names: Speed of sound and its temperature dependence; Dot products and projection; Convert between time delay and phase shift; Microphones and digital audio sampling
hx-per-mic-array-geometry.Skill Description: Microphone array geometry and time differences — Compute time differences of arrival for a source direction given array geometry, and relate microphone spacing to spatial aliasing frequency.

hx-per-load-cell-bridge.Subject: Joint, current and force sensing
hx-per-load-cell-bridge.Skill Name: Read a strain-gauge load cell through a bridge amplifier
hx-per-load-cell-bridge.Prerequisite Names: Calibrate a scalar sensor; Resistive bridge sensing
hx-per-load-cell-bridge.Skill Description: Read a strain-gauge load cell through a bridge amplifier — Wire a strain-gauge load cell to a bridge amplifier ADC, tare and calibrate it with known masses, and assess creep and temperature drift.

hx-per-camera-imu-calibration.Subject: Time synchronization and fusion
hx-per-camera-imu-calibration.Skill Name: Calibrate camera-IMU extrinsics and time offset
hx-per-camera-imu-calibration.Prerequisite Names: Calibrate a camera; Timestamp sources and clock domains; Calibrate IMU bias and scale factors
hx-per-camera-imu-calibration.Skill Description: Calibrate camera-IMU extrinsics and time offset — Estimate the rotation, translation and time offset between a camera and IMU with a calibration target and excitation motion, and validate the result.

hx-per-echo-cancellation.Subject: Audio perception
hx-per-echo-cancellation.Skill Name: Cancel the robot's own voice with echo cancellation
hx-per-echo-cancellation.Prerequisite Names: Linear least-squares fitting; Discrete Fourier transform and spectra; Reverberation time with Sabine's formula; Capture audio on Linux
hx-per-echo-cancellation.Skill Description: Cancel the robot's own voice with echo cancellation — Use the playback signal as reference for an adaptive echo canceller so the robot hears users while speaking, and test barge-in performance.

hx-per-gcc-phat.Subject: Audio perception
hx-per-gcc-phat.Prerequisite Names: Discrete Fourier transform and spectra; Microphone array geometry and time differences
hx-per-gcc-phat.Skill Description: Estimate time delay with GCC-PHAT — Estimate the delay between two microphone signals with phase-transform weighted cross-correlation, and convert delays to a direction of arrival.

hx-per-vad.Subject: Audio perception
hx-per-vad.Prerequisite Names: Short-time Fourier transform and spectrograms; Capture audio on Linux
hx-per-vad.Skill Description: Voice activity detection — Detect speech segments with an energy-based detector and a neural detector, set hangover times, and measure missed speech and false triggers in noise.

hx-per-joint-torque-sensing.Subject: Joint, current and force sensing
hx-per-joint-torque-sensing.Skill Name: Sense joint torque from strain or deflection
hx-per-joint-torque-sensing.Prerequisite Names: Measure backlash and compliance; Read an absolute encoder and establish joint zero; Series elastic actuator design; Read a strain-gauge load cell through a bridge amplifier
hx-per-joint-torque-sensing.Skill Description: Sense joint torque from strain or deflection — Measure joint torque with in-joint strain gauges, series-elastic spring deflection, or the difference between motor-side and output-side encoders across the gearbox.

hx-per-ft-sensor-wrist.Subject: Joint, current and force sensing
hx-per-ft-sensor-wrist.Skill Name: Use a six-axis force-torque sensor at the wrist
hx-per-ft-sensor-wrist.Prerequisite Names: Represent spatial motion and force; Read a strain-gauge load cell through a bridge amplifier
hx-per-ft-sensor-wrist.Skill Description: Use a six-axis force-torque sensor at the wrist — Read a six-axis force-torque sensor, remove bias, compensate the gravity of the attached tool, and express the wrench in the end-effector frame.

hx-per-beamforming.Subject: Audio perception
hx-per-beamforming.Prerequisite Names: Discrete Fourier transform and spectra; Microphone array geometry and time differences; Room modes, early reflections and critical distance
hx-per-beamforming.Skill Description: Delay-and-sum beamforming — Steer a microphone array toward a talker with delay-and-sum beamforming, compute the beam pattern, and measure the signal-to-noise gain.

hx-per-mag-iron-calibration.Subject: Inertial sensing
hx-per-mag-iron-calibration.Skill Name: Calibrate a magnetometer and compute heading
hx-per-mag-iron-calibration.Prerequisite Codes: MTH-GET-010, MTH-LIA-012, PHY-FWL-013, PHY-MAN-005, PHY-MAN-013, PER-INS-007, PHY-MMC-013
hx-per-mag-iron-calibration.Prerequisite Names: Inverse trigonometry and quadrants; Linear least-squares fitting; Magnetic fields and forces; Earth's magnetic field; Stray fields from robot wiring near a magnetometer; Read and scale raw IMU data; Hard-iron and soft-iron distortion physics
hx-per-mag-iron-calibration.Skill Description: Calibrate a magnetometer and compute heading — Fit hard- and soft-iron corrections to magnetometer data collected over many orientations, compute heading, and recognize distortion from motors and steel frames.

hx-per-tof-point-sensor.Subject: Range sensing
hx-per-tof-point-sensor.Skill Name: Read a single-point optical time-of-flight sensor
hx-per-tof-point-sensor.Prerequisite Codes: PHY-FWL-004, PHY-WAV-002, PHY-CSO-001, PHY-CSO-002, EMB-ERT-011, PHY-CSO-015
hx-per-tof-point-sensor.Prerequisite Names: Electromagnetic spectrum; Calculate distance from round-trip echo time; Laser safety classes and eye hazard; Pulsed time-of-flight timing resolution; UART, SPI, and I²C in firmware; Diffuse versus specular returns in active sensing
hx-per-tof-point-sensor.Skill Description: Read a single-point optical time-of-flight sensor — Configure a laser time-of-flight distance sensor for range and timing budget, read distances, and measure accuracy across target colours and distances.

hx-per-mic-array.Subject: Audio perception
hx-per-mic-array.Skill Name: Microphone array capture and sound localization
hx-per-mic-array.Prerequisite Names: Microphone polar patterns and directivity; Capture audio on Linux; Estimate time delay with GCC-PHAT; Voice activity detection; Delay-and-sum beamforming
hx-per-mic-array.Skill Description: Microphone array capture and sound localization — Capture a multichannel array on the robot, localize and track active talkers by direction, and output an enhanced beamformed channel for speech recognition.

hx-per-madgwick-filter.Subject: Inertial sensing
hx-per-madgwick-filter.Skill Name: Estimate attitude with a Madgwick or Mahony filter
hx-per-madgwick-filter.Prerequisite Names: Fuse gyro and accelerometer tilt with a complementary filter; Quaternions for orientation and rate integration; Calibrate a magnetometer and compute heading
hx-per-madgwick-filter.Skill Description: Estimate attitude with a Madgwick or Mahony filter — Run a Madgwick or Mahony filter on gyroscope, accelerometer and optional magnetometer data, tune its gain, and compare drift against a complementary filter.

hx-per-current-shunt-sensing.Subject: Joint, current and force sensing
hx-per-current-shunt-sensing.Skill Name: Measure motor current with a shunt and amplifier
hx-per-current-shunt-sensing.Prerequisite Names: Condition a sensor signal; Differential and instrumentation amplification; Drive a brushed motor with an H-bridge and PWM
hx-per-current-shunt-sensing.Skill Description: Measure motor current with a shunt and amplifier — Size a shunt resistor and differential amplifier for motor phase or supply current, and sample it synchronized with PWM to avoid switching artefacts.

hx-per-range-failure-modes.Subject: Range sensing
hx-per-range-failure-modes.Prerequisite Names: Apply the law of specular reflection; Measure range with an ultrasonic sensor; Read a single-point optical time-of-flight sensor
hx-per-range-failure-modes.Skill Description: Range sensor failure modes — Predict range errors from specular surfaces, glass, dark absorbers, multipath, sunlight and crosstalk between sensors, and design tests that expose them.

hx-per-tof-depth-camera.Subject: Stereo and depth cameras
hx-per-tof-depth-camera.Prerequisite Names: Pulsed time-of-flight timing resolution; Convert between time delay and phase shift; Near-infrared light and silicon sensor response; Read a single-point optical time-of-flight sensor
hx-per-tof-depth-camera.Skill Description: Time-of-flight depth cameras — Explain continuous-wave phase measurement in time-of-flight cameras and predict range ambiguity, multipath and flying-pixel artefacts.

hx-per-current-to-torque.Subject: Joint, current and force sensing
hx-per-current-to-torque.Skill Name: Estimate joint torque from motor current
hx-per-current-to-torque.Prerequisite Names: Model a brushed DC motor with torque and back-EMF constants; Gear ratio trade-off between torque and speed; Measure motor current with a shunt and amplifier
hx-per-current-to-torque.Skill Description: Estimate joint torque from motor current — Convert measured motor current into output torque using the torque constant and gear ratio, and account for friction and efficiency losses that bias the estimate.

hx-per-sensor-health-monitor.Subject: Perception systems on robot hardware
hx-per-sensor-health-monitor.Skill Name: Monitor sensor health and degrade safely
hx-per-sensor-health-monitor.Prerequisite Names: Implement bounded fault response; Synchronize and interpolate sensor messages; Range sensor failure modes
hx-per-sensor-health-monitor.Skill Description: Monitor sensor health and degrade safely — Detect stale, frozen, saturated or implausible sensor streams at runtime and switch the robot to a safe degraded behaviour with a clear report.

hx-per-lidar-2d-scans.Subject: Range sensing
hx-per-lidar-2d-scans.Skill Name: Convert 2D lidar scans to Cartesian points
hx-per-lidar-2d-scans.Prerequisite Codes: PHY-CSO-001, PER-SEF-003, MTH-GET-014, PER-SCE-007, PHY-CSO-015, PER-RAS-003
hx-per-lidar-2d-scans.Prerequisite Names: Laser safety classes and eye hazard; Smooth sensor data with averaging and median filters; Polar coordinates; Process depth and range observations; Diffuse versus specular returns in active sensing; Range sensor failure modes
hx-per-lidar-2d-scans.Skill Description: Convert 2D lidar scans to Cartesian points — Interpret a 2D laser scan's angle increment, range limits and invalid values, filter bad returns, and convert ranges into points in sensor and robot frames.

hx-per-depth-camera-setup.Subject: Stereo and depth cameras
hx-per-depth-camera-setup.Skill Name: Run and tune an RGB-D camera
hx-per-depth-camera-setup.Prerequisite Names: Publish images and camera info in ROS 2; Align depth images to the colour camera; Time-of-flight depth cameras
hx-per-depth-camera-setup.Skill Description: Run and tune an RGB-D camera — Run an RGB-D camera driver in ROS 2, choose resolution and depth presets, enable spatial and temporal filters, and verify depth against measured distances.

hx-per-checkpoint-s3.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-per-checkpoint-s3.Prerequisite Names: Estimate joint torque from motor current
hx-per-checkpoint-s3.Skill Description: Sensing & Perception checkpoint: stage 3 (robot arm) — Demonstrate the 1 end-of-branch sensing & perception skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 3 integration milestone.

hx-per-scan-matching.Subject: Mapping and SLAM
hx-per-scan-matching.Prerequisite Names: Apply, compose and invert rigid transforms; Singular value decomposition; Convert 2D lidar scans to Cartesian points
hx-per-scan-matching.Skill Description: Align consecutive lidar scans — Estimate relative robot motion by aligning consecutive 2D lidar scans with ICP or correlative matching, and detect degenerate cases such as long featureless corridors.

hx-per-occupancy-grid.Subject: Mapping and SLAM
hx-per-occupancy-grid.Skill Name: Build an occupancy grid with log-odds updates
hx-per-occupancy-grid.Prerequisite Names: Bayesian updating; Logarithms; Represent maps and robot footprint; Convert 2D lidar scans to Cartesian points
hx-per-occupancy-grid.Skill Description: Build an occupancy grid with log-odds updates — Ray-trace lidar beams from known poses through a grid and update free and occupied cell beliefs with log-odds Bayesian updates.

hx-per-point-clouds.Subject: Point clouds and 3D perception
hx-per-point-clouds.Skill Name: Build and process point clouds from depth
hx-per-point-clouds.Prerequisite Names: Back-project pixels to rays and 3D points; Process depth and range observations; Run and tune an RGB-D camera
hx-per-point-clouds.Skill Description: Build and process point clouds from depth — Convert depth images into organized and unorganized point clouds with colour, store and visualize them, and crop them to a region of interest.

hx-per-lidar-3d.Subject: Range sensing
hx-per-lidar-3d.Skill Name: 3D lidar scan structure and motion distortion
hx-per-lidar-3d.Prerequisite Names: Cylindrical and spherical coordinates; Convert 2D lidar scans to Cartesian points
hx-per-lidar-3d.Skill Description: 3D lidar scan structure and motion distortion — Describe how multi-beam 3D lidars build point clouds from rings, convert returns with spherical coordinates, and correct scan distortion from robot motion during a sweep.

hx-per-pose-graph.Subject: Mapping and SLAM
hx-per-pose-graph.Prerequisite Names: Solve a small nonlinear least-squares problem; Align consecutive lidar scans
hx-per-pose-graph.Skill Description: Pose-graph optimization — Formulate robot poses and relative measurements as a graph and solve it by nonlinear least squares to distribute accumulated drift.

hx-per-voxel-outlier-filtering.Subject: Point clouds and 3D perception
hx-per-voxel-outlier-filtering.Prerequisite Names: Build and process point clouds from depth
hx-per-voxel-outlier-filtering.Skill Description: Downsample and denoise point clouds — Apply voxel-grid downsampling, pass-through cropping and statistical or radius outlier removal, and choose voxel size for speed versus detail.

hx-per-pointcloud-ros.Subject: Point clouds and 3D perception
hx-per-pointcloud-ros.Prerequisite Names: Broadcast and look up transforms with tf2; Build and process point clouds from depth
hx-per-pointcloud-ros.Skill Description: Use point clouds in ROS 2 — Publish and subscribe PointCloud2 messages, transform clouds into the base frame with tf2, and visualize them in RViz while monitoring message size and rate.

hx-per-loop-closure.Subject: Mapping and SLAM
hx-per-loop-closure.Skill Name: Detect loop closures and recognize places
hx-per-loop-closure.Skill Description: Detect loop closures and recognize places — Recognize a previously visited place from scan or image signatures, verify the match geometrically, and add the constraint to the pose graph to correct drift.

hx-per-surface-normals.Subject: Point clouds and 3D perception
hx-per-surface-normals.Skill Name: Estimate surface normals in a point cloud
hx-per-surface-normals.Prerequisite Names: Covariance and correlation; Eigenvalues and eigenvectors; Downsample and denoise point clouds
hx-per-surface-normals.Skill Description: Estimate surface normals in a point cloud — Estimate per-point normals from local neighbourhood covariance, orient them consistently toward the sensor, and pick neighbourhood radius for noisy depth.

hx-per-self-filtering.Subject: Point clouds and 3D perception
hx-per-self-filtering.Skill Name: Remove the robot's own body from sensor data
hx-per-self-filtering.Prerequisite Names: Write a URDF robot description; Convert 2D lidar scans to Cartesian points; Use point clouds in ROS 2
hx-per-self-filtering.Skill Description: Remove the robot's own body from sensor data — Use the robot description and current joint states to mask out points and scan returns that hit the robot's own arms, head or base.

hx-per-ransac-plane.Subject: Point clouds and 3D perception
hx-per-ransac-plane.Prerequisite Names: Lines and planes in space; Robust model fitting with RANSAC; Downsample and denoise point clouds
hx-per-ransac-plane.Skill Description: Segment planes with RANSAC — Fit and remove dominant planes such as floors and tables from a point cloud with RANSAC, and extract the points that lie above a support surface.

hx-per-slam.Subject: Mapping and SLAM
hx-per-slam.Prerequisite Names: Localize against a known map; Build an occupancy grid with log-odds updates; Detect loop closures and recognize places
hx-per-slam.Skill Description: Simultaneous localization and mapping — Explain how SLAM jointly estimates robot trajectory and map through front-end matching and back-end optimization, and identify its failure modes in practice.

hx-per-icp-registration.Subject: Point clouds and 3D perception
hx-per-icp-registration.Prerequisite Names: Singular value decomposition; Align consecutive lidar scans; Estimate surface normals in a point cloud
hx-per-icp-registration.Skill Description: Align point clouds with ICP — Register two point clouds with point-to-point and point-to-plane ICP, explain its need for a good initial guess, and evaluate fitness and residual error.

hx-per-euclidean-clustering.Subject: Point clouds and 3D perception
hx-per-euclidean-clustering.Prerequisite Names: Trees and binary search trees; Singular value decomposition; Segment planes with RANSAC
hx-per-euclidean-clustering.Skill Description: Cluster point clouds into objects — Group points into object clusters with k-d tree neighbour search or DBSCAN, filter by size, and fit centroids and oriented bounding boxes.

hx-per-lidar-slam-ros.Subject: Mapping and SLAM
hx-per-lidar-slam-ros.Skill Name: Map a building with 2D lidar SLAM
hx-per-lidar-slam-ros.Prerequisite Names: Differential-drive kinematics and wheel odometry; Convert 2D lidar scans to Cartesian points; Simultaneous localization and mapping
hx-per-lidar-slam-ros.Skill Description: Map a building with 2D lidar SLAM — Configure and run a ROS 2 lidar SLAM package on the wheeled base, drive a mapping run, save and reuse the map, and switch to localization mode.

hx-per-visual-slam.Subject: Mapping and SLAM
hx-per-visual-slam.Prerequisite Names: Estimate motion with visual odometry; Simultaneous localization and mapping
hx-per-visual-slam.Skill Description: Visual SLAM with cameras — Run a feature-based visual or RGB-D SLAM system, interpret its keyframes and map points, and diagnose tracking loss from blur, texture or lighting.

rob3:P07.Subject: Sensing, calibration and estimation
rob3:P07.Prerequisite Names: Compare orientation representations; Inertial measurement units; Align and timestamp sensor streams; Model noise and covariance; What an accelerometer measures
rob3:P07.Skill Description: Estimate orientation from inertial data — Estimate orientation from inertial data

hx-per-checkpoint-s4.Subject: Checkpoints
hx-per-checkpoint-s4.Prerequisite Names: Map a building with 2D lidar SLAM
hx-per-checkpoint-s4.Skill Description: Sensing & Perception checkpoint: stage 4 (wheeled base) — Demonstrate the 1 end-of-branch sensing & perception skills this checkpoint gathers, as a combined review before the stage 4 integration milestone.

hx-per-imu-orientation.Subject: Inertial sensing
hx-per-imu-orientation.Prerequisite Names: Apply, compose and invert rigid transforms; Stray fields from robot wiring near a magnetometer; Calibrate IMU bias and scale factors; Estimate attitude with a Madgwick or Mahony filter; Estimate orientation from inertial data
hx-per-imu-orientation.Skill Description: Estimate orientation from an IMU — Deliver a quaternion orientation estimate from a calibrated IMU aligned to the robot body frame, publish it in ROS 2, and validate it against known poses.

hx-per-ekf-imu-odometry.Subject: Time synchronization and fusion
hx-per-ekf-imu-odometry.Skill Name: Fuse IMU and wheel odometry with an EKF
hx-per-ekf-imu-odometry.Prerequisite Names: Synchronize and interpolate sensor messages; Differential-drive kinematics and wheel odometry; Fuse nonlinear mobile-robot measurements; Estimate orientation from an IMU
hx-per-ekf-imu-odometry.Skill Description: Fuse IMU and wheel odometry with an EKF — Configure an extended Kalman filter to fuse wheel odometry and IMU orientation and rate into a smooth base pose estimate, and validate it on a closed loop.

rob3:P10.Subject: Sensing, calibration and estimation
rob3:P10.Prerequisite Names: Solve a small nonlinear least-squares problem; Calibrate a scalar sensor; Implement general serial-arm forward kinematics
rob3:P10.Skill Description: Identify robot calibration parameters — Identify robot calibration parameters

hx-per-fusion-tuning.Subject: Time synchronization and fusion
hx-per-fusion-tuning.Prerequisite Names: Measure a sensor noise floor from a static log; Detect an inconsistent measurement innovation; Fuse IMU and wheel odometry with an EKF
hx-per-fusion-tuning.Skill Description: Tune fusion covariances from data — Set process and measurement covariances from measured sensor noise, then refine them by checking innovation statistics and consistency on recorded data.

hx-per-image-classification.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-image-classification.Skill Name: Classify images with a pretrained network
hx-per-image-classification.Prerequisite Names: Load, process and display images with OpenCV; Convolutional neural networks
hx-per-image-classification.Skill Description: Classify images with a pretrained network — Run a pretrained convolutional or transformer classifier on camera frames with correct preprocessing, and interpret top-k scores and their calibration.

hx-per-detection-concepts.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-detection-concepts.Skill Name: Bounding boxes, IoU and non-maximum suppression
hx-per-detection-concepts.Prerequisite Names: Classification and decision thresholds; Classify images with a pretrained network
hx-per-detection-concepts.Skill Description: Bounding boxes, IoU and non-maximum suppression — Compute intersection over union between boxes, apply confidence thresholds and non-maximum suppression, and explain anchor-based and anchor-free detectors.

hx-per-image-labeling.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-image-labeling.Skill Name: Collect and label an image dataset
hx-per-image-labeling.Prerequisite Names: Datasets, features, and labels; Capture camera frames and measure frame rate; Prevent train-test leakage; Bounding boxes, IoU and non-maximum suppression
hx-per-image-labeling.Skill Description: Collect and label an image dataset — Capture robot images covering viewpoints, lighting and backgrounds, annotate boxes and masks to written guidelines, audit labels, and split without leakage.

hx-per-object-detection.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-object-detection.Skill Name: Detect objects with a neural network detector
hx-per-object-detection.Prerequisite Names: Capture camera frames and measure frame rate; Bounding boxes, IoU and non-maximum suppression
hx-per-object-detection.Skill Description: Detect objects with a neural network detector — Run a YOLO-family detector on live camera frames, filter detections by class and confidence, and publish labelled boxes for downstream robot behaviours.

hx-per-detection-metrics.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-detection-metrics.Skill Name: Evaluate detectors with precision, recall and mAP
hx-per-detection-metrics.Prerequisite Names: Evaluating models with metrics and held-out data; Bounding boxes, IoU and non-maximum suppression
hx-per-detection-metrics.Skill Description: Evaluate detectors with precision, recall and mAP — Compute precision, recall and mean average precision on a labelled set, and choose an operating threshold from the cost of misses versus false alarms.

hx-per-detector-finetune.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-detector-finetune.Skill Name: Fine-tune an object detector on custom data
hx-per-detector-finetune.Prerequisite Names: Train a neural network in PyTorch; Evaluate detectors with precision, recall and mAP; Collect and label an image dataset; Detect objects with a neural network detector
hx-per-detector-finetune.Skill Description: Fine-tune an object detector on custom data — Fine-tune a pretrained detector on custom labelled data with realistic augmentation, monitor validation metrics, and compare against the base model on held-out robot images.

hx-per-keypoint-pose-estimation.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-keypoint-pose-estimation.Skill Name: Human body keypoint and pose estimation
hx-per-keypoint-pose-estimation.Prerequisite Names: Detect objects with a neural network detector
hx-per-keypoint-pose-estimation.Skill Description: Human body keypoint and pose estimation — Run a 2D human pose estimator to obtain body keypoints with confidences, and handle partial occlusion and multiple people in the frame.

hx-per-instance-segmentation.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-instance-segmentation.Prerequisite Names: Contours, connected components and shape properties; Detect objects with a neural network detector
hx-per-instance-segmentation.Skill Description: Instance segmentation masks — Run an instance segmentation model to obtain per-object masks, and use masks rather than boxes to compute object extent and grasp regions.

hx-per-detection-to-3d.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-detection-to-3d.Prerequisite Names: Back-project pixels to rays and 3D points; Align depth images to the colour camera; Detect objects with a neural network detector
hx-per-detection-to-3d.Skill Description: Lift 2D detections into 3D positions — Combine detection boxes or masks with aligned depth to compute 3D object positions in the robot frame, rejecting background and invalid depth pixels.

hx-per-open-vocab-detection.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-open-vocab-detection.Prerequisite Names: Transformer architecture and attention; Detect objects with a neural network detector
hx-per-open-vocab-detection.Skill Description: Open-vocabulary object detection — Detect objects named in free text with an open-vocabulary detector, tune prompts and thresholds, and verify reliability before letting it drive robot actions.

hx-per-multi-object-tracking.Subject: Learned vision
hx-per-multi-object-tracking.Prerequisite Names: Linear Kalman filter; Detect objects with a neural network detector
hx-per-multi-object-tracking.Skill Description: Track detections across frames — Associate detections over time with a Kalman motion model and assignment by IoU or distance, maintaining stable track IDs through brief misses.

hx-per-face-detection.Subject: People perception
hx-per-face-detection.Prerequisite Names: Detect objects with a neural network detector
hx-per-face-detection.Skill Description: Detect faces in camera images — Run a neural face detector on live video, filter by size and confidence, and measure detection range and failure under pose and lighting changes.

hx-per-perception-regression-tests.Subject: Perception systems on robot hardware
hx-per-perception-regression-tests.Prerequisite Names: Create logs and replayable tests; Record and replay robot data with rosbag; Evaluate detectors with precision, recall and mAP
hx-per-perception-regression-tests.Skill Description: Regression-test perception with recorded data — Record representative sensor logs with ground truth, replay them through the perception stack after each change, and track metrics over versions.

hx-per-semantic-map.Subject: Mapping and SLAM
hx-per-semantic-map.Skill Name: Attach object and place labels to a map
hx-per-semantic-map.Prerequisite Names: Simultaneous localization and mapping; Lift 2D detections into 3D positions
hx-per-semantic-map.Skill Description: Attach object and place labels to a map — Anchor detected objects and named places in the map frame, merge repeated observations, and expire stale entries so the robot can answer where things are.

hx-per-object-pose-6d.Subject: Point clouds and 3D perception
hx-per-object-pose-6d.Prerequisite Names: Estimate a known object's pose; Align point clouds with ICP; Instance segmentation masks
hx-per-object-pose-6d.Skill Description: Estimate 6D object pose — Estimate an object's full position and orientation by fitting a CAD model to segmented points or using a learned pose estimator, and verify the pose before grasping.

hx-per-person-tracking.Subject: People perception
hx-per-person-tracking.Skill Name: Detect and track people and faces
hx-per-person-tracking.Prerequisite Names: Lift 2D detections into 3D positions; Detect faces in camera images; Human body keypoint and pose estimation; Track detections across frames
hx-per-person-tracking.Skill Description: Detect and track people and faces — Locate nearby people in 3D from detections, keypoints and depth, and keep stable identities for them and their faces over time with a motion model.

hx-per-face-landmarks-head-pose.Subject: People perception
hx-per-face-landmarks-head-pose.Prerequisite Names: Estimate camera pose with PnP; Detect faces in camera images
hx-per-face-landmarks-head-pose.Skill Description: Facial landmarks and head pose — Detect facial landmarks and estimate head yaw, pitch and roll by fitting a 3D face model with PnP, and report confidence of the estimate.

hx-per-gesture-recognition.Subject: People perception
hx-per-gesture-recognition.Skill Name: Recognize gestures from body and hand keypoints
hx-per-gesture-recognition.Prerequisite Names: Classification and decision thresholds; Human body keypoint and pose estimation
hx-per-gesture-recognition.Skill Description: Recognize gestures from body and hand keypoints — Detect hand landmarks and classify gestures such as waving, pointing and stop from body and hand keypoint sequences, measuring false triggers.

hx-per-gaze-estimation.Subject: People perception
hx-per-gaze-estimation.Skill Description: Estimate a person's gaze direction — Estimate where a person is looking from head pose and eye appearance, and judge whether they are looking at the robot within an angular tolerance.
